current.employee_description:
In 2015, I founded Rcubers, an initiative with a goal to make a positive impact on the community. One of the main projects under Rcubers is R_Jyoti, where we come together to help the less fortunate and encourage others to do the same.

Since its inception, we have conducted over 100 visits to various NGOs in Delhi and the NCR region. These visits have included childcare centers, orphanages, old age homes, animal hospitals, small villages, and backward areas. Through these visits, we aim to bring aid and support to those in need, and raise awareness about the importance of community service.

Rcubers is more than just an organization, it's a community of individuals who are dedicated to making a difference. I am proud of the work we have done and the impact we have made. I am constantly looking for opportunities to expand our reach and continue to make a positive impact in the community.

BHAIDI is a community-driven platform designed to help students grow and learn in both personal and professional life. Founded in April 2020, the community has grown to 25,000+ members across multiple social media platforms. Our mission is to provide quality and relevant information to students and guide them in choosing the right career path and succeeding.

At BHAIDI, we understand the importance of education and career in shaping one's life, and we're dedicated to making that journey easier for students. Our platform is a one-stop-shop for students who want to make informed decisions about their education and career.

Our team of experienced professionals and experts share valuable information and resources on various topics including education, career, and personal development. We also provide personalized counseling and guidance to help students make the right choices for their future.

In addition to providing valuable resources and guidance, we also promote an engaged and supportive community where students can connect, collaborate, and support each other on their journey.

Joining BHAIDI gives students access to a wealth of knowledge, resources, and support to help them reach their full potential. Whether you're just starting your education or looking to make a career change, BHAIDI is here to help you succeed.

Based in Gurugram with volunteers joining in from across the country, the NGO works on the fields of education, health ,hygiene, employment, self defence, animal welfare, road safety and so much more.Expanding day by day to have 800+ community volunteers under its ambit, Teens of God NGO works with the Municipal Corporation of Gurugram and the Gurugram Metropolitan Development Authority, along with many corporates as well.It offers you numerous opportunities to explore yourself and the world you live in.
current.employee_description:
As a founding member and Operations Coordinator at Teens of God (https://teensofgod.org/), a registered youth-oriented NGO, I am responsible for ensuring the smooth running of operations and overseeing the implementation of our programs and initiatives.

Our mission is to achieve educational equality, social justice, and holistic development for those in need. We strive to establish a sense of responsibility in the youth and raise awareness about social issues. With a team of over 300 young volunteers from across India, we have been successful in reaching out to more than 5000 people in the Delhi NCR region.

One of our main programs is "SUSHIKSHA," an education program that aims to provide equal opportunities for education. Additionally, we regularly organize social upliftment drives targeting various issues. During the time of Covid-19, Teens of God distributed ration and food to around 2200 families in Gurugram City.

Being a part of Teens of God has been a fulfilling experience, as I am able to make a positive impact on the community and work alongside a dedicated team of volunteers to achieve our mission. It is an honor to be part of an organization that is making a difference in people's lives.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Established in 1996, formerly known as ITM University, The NorthCap University is a progressive multidisciplinary university located in the city-centre of Gurugram, Haryana. The university’s rich heritage of 25+ years, 13,000+ alumni, 150+ faculty, 250+ placement partners and robust academic infrastructure enables deep linkages with government, industry and research bodies.The university operates multiple schools and departments in its state-of-the-art urban campus and hosts a diverse student body of engineering, technology, management, liberal arts, law, media and entertainment, online learning, business and applied science aspirants. NCU is a National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) Grade A accredited university that serves as a research as well as talent catalyst between students and industry. Guided by eminent academicians and industry leaders, it follows an immersive pedagogy to deliver undergraduate, postgraduate as well as doctoral programmes.The university is a comprehensive partner of Arizona State University (#1 University in the U.S. for innovation, outreach and stewardship) and benefits from a strategic collaboration which focuses on innovation, internationalisation and digitisation. NCU students enjoy accelerated master’s programmes in the US given this partnership. NCU is recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and the Bar Council of India (BCI). It is a Member of the Association of Indian Universities (AIU), a Member of the American Society for Quality and is accredited by Accreditation Services for International Colleges (ASIC), UK. With a 5-Star QS Ranking for Teaching, Employability & Online Learning, NCU ranks among the Top 30 Best Performing Universities as per ARIIA rankings.

current.employer_linkedin_description: The Interaction Design Foundation (IxDF) is a global design education institution. Established in 2002, we pioneered online video-based courses a decade before online learning became mainstream, at a time when AI, user experience (UX), and user interface (UI) design were barely recognized as distinct disciplines.Today, IxDF offers evidence-based curricula taught by 250+ industry leaders, grounded in both industry practice and peer-reviewed research. With 1.2 million+ enrollments and local chapters in 500+ cities across 100+ countries, IxDF is the largest and longest-running design education institution in the world.IxDF is where leading practitioners and researchers in design and AI come together to build online education that sets the gold standard for the industry. Our entire institution is built around a singular focus on design and AI. This allows us to build curricula of depth and rigor with industry leaders.Learn from 40 courses and 155 master classes, from beginner to advanced. Trusted by 1,576 companies.
current.employee_description: As an IxDF Local Leader in Delhi, I aim to build a strong and vibrant community of UI/UX designers, students, and design enthusiasts by organizing meetups, discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions. The focus is on fostering collaboration, continuous learning, and meaningful conversations around design, HCI, emerging technologies, and real-world UX challenges.

past.employee_description:
As a Frontend Developer at Gemini Solutions, I was responsible for designing and developing a wide range of web-based applications and platforms. My responsibilities included:

Analytical Tool Development: Designing and developing an analytical tool using HTML5, CSS3, and jQuery to study the dynamics of financial markets and forecast changes in regime. This included creating wireframes, graphics, prototypes, and static pages to ensure an intuitive user experience.

E-commerce Website Design and Development: Designing and developing a website for a leading Canadian pharmacy. This involved working with a cross-functional team to create a visually appealing and user-friendly e-commerce platform.

Customer Experience Platform: Developing an innovative customer experience-centric platform that helped find and analyze business challenges, and devise action plans.

Website Re-design: Designed and developed Gemini's website.

Throughout my two-year tenure, I was able to work on various projects with different clients and industries, which helped me to gain a wide range of experience and knowledge in front-end development. I enjoyed the opportunity to work with a talented team of developers and designers, and I am proud of the impact my contributions have had on the success of these projects and the satisfaction of our clients. It was a great learning experience and I have grown professionally and technically.

I am honored to have been selected as a prospective youth delegate for the inaugural India-Czech Republic Youth Dialogue 2019. The dialogue was organized by the Confederation of Young Leaders and the Embassy of the Czech Republic, and brought together young leaders from both countries to discuss issues of mutual interest and explore ways to strengthen bilateral ties.

As a youth delegate, I had the opportunity to participate in various activities including the opening ceremony, panel discussions, and a cultural exchange program. It was a great opportunity to represent my country, connect with young leaders from Czech Republic and learn from their experiences.

I am excited to have been selected for this opportunity and I am looking forward to participating in this meaningful dialogue and contributing to the strengthening of the relationship between our two countries. It was a great opportunity for me to learn more about the culture and society of Czech Republic and also to share my own perspectives.

past.employer_name: Embassy of the Peoples Republic of China
past.employee_description: As a top 50 Youth Delegate selected from 1450 applicants from all over India, I participated in the historic 2nd China-India Youth Dialogue 2020. Co-hosted by the Embassy of the People's Republic of China and the Confederation of Young Leaders (CYL), the event was presided over by H.E Mr. Sun Weidong, Ambassador of the People's Republic of China to India. The Dialogue aimed to design a master plan for forging closer people-to-people ties, deepening cooperation, and expanding development opportunities for youth empowerment. The event was endorsed by India's Prime Minister, Shri. Narendra Modi, along with several Union Ministers, Governors, Chief Ministers, Bureaucrats, and Vice-Chancellors. It was a great opportunity to be a part of an event which was organized to celebrate the 70 years of diplomatic ties between India and China.

Established in 1996, formerly known as ITM University, The NorthCap University is a progressive multidisciplinary university located in the city-centre of Gurugram, Haryana. The university’s rich heritage of 25+ years, 13,000+ alumni, 150+ faculty, 250+ placement partners and robust academic infrastructure enables deep linkages with government, industry and research bodies.The university operates multiple schools and departments in its state-of-the-art urban campus and hosts a diverse student body of engineering, technology, management, liberal arts, law, media and entertainment, online learning, business and applied science aspirants. NCU is a National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) Grade A accredited university that serves as a research as well as talent catalyst between students and industry. Guided by eminent academicians and industry leaders, it follows an immersive pedagogy to deliver undergraduate, postgraduate as well as doctoral programmes.The university is a comprehensive partner of Arizona State University (#1 University in the U.S. for innovation, outreach and stewardship) and benefits from a strategic collaboration which focuses on innovation, internationalisation and digitisation. NCU students enjoy accelerated master’s programmes in the US given this partnership. NCU is recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and the Bar Council of India (BCI). It is a Member of the Association of Indian Universities (AIU), a Member of the American Society for Quality and is accredited by Accreditation Services for International Colleges (ASIC), UK. With a 5-Star QS Ranking for Teaching, Employability & Online Learning, NCU ranks among the Top 30 Best Performing Universities as per ARIIA rankings.
past.employee_title: Creative and Design Lead - Google Students' Club NCU
past.employee_description:
As the Creative and Design Lead at the Google Students' Club of The NorthCap University, I led a team of students to educate and enlighten others about Google technologies, internet apps, and more.

I was responsible for overseeing all creative activities within the club, including designing and implementing marketing campaigns, creating visual materials, and organizing events. I utilized my design skills to develop visually appealing and effective materials that helped to increase engagement and awareness of the club's activities.

In this role, I gained experience in leading and managing a team, developing marketing strategies, and utilizing design software to create visual materials. I also had the opportunity to learn more about Google technologies and internet apps, and share that knowledge with others.

It was a great opportunity for me to use my skills and interests to contribute to the community and help educate others about technology. Additionally, I was able to work with a team and learn about the importance of teamwork and leadership.

I am proud to have been elected as the Lok-Sabha Election Ambassador for The Northcap University Gurgaon in 2014. In this role, I was responsible for organizing and leading various campaigns in the college and nearby areas to encourage voter registration and voter education.

I was actively involved in creating awareness about the importance of voting and encouraging students to exercise their right to vote. I also worked to educate students about the various political parties and their manifestos, and helped to create a more informed electorate.

During my tenure as the Lok-Sabha Election Ambassador, I was featured in a local newspaper for my efforts in promoting voter registration and voter education. It was a great honor and a privilege to serve as an ambassador and to be recognized for my efforts. It was a great learning experience for me as I got to know about the political system of India and also about how to conduct a successful campaign.

past.employee_description:
During my summer training at Bharti Airtel, a leading telecommunications company in India, I had the opportunity to work on a development project using the Struts and MVC framework.

As part of a team, I was involved in the design and development of a web-based application, utilizing the Struts framework to implement the MVC design pattern. The project required me to work on various aspects of the software development process, including requirement gathering, design, coding, testing, and deployment.

The Struts framework was chosen for the project because of its ability to separate the presentation logic from the business logic, making it easier to maintain the application. It was a great learning experience for me, as I was able to apply the theoretical concepts I learned in class to a real-world project, and to understand how a large-scale application is developed using MVC framework.

Working with a leading telecommunications company gave me an insight into the industry and how it operates. I also got to know about the software development process in a corporate environment, which helped me to understand how the software development industry works.

basic_profile.summary: MuleSoft Platform Architect | API & Integration Platform Leader | Cloud, Kubernetes & DevOps SpecialistWith 14+ years of experience in enterprise technology, I specialize in designing, building, and operating scalable integration and API platforms that empower development teams to deliver secure, reliable, and reusable digital services at scale.As a MuleSoft Platform Architect, I lead the architecture, governance, automation, and operational excellence of enterprise API platforms across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. basic_profile.name: Abhinav Srivastava
basic_profile.headline: VP Engineering | Developer Platforms, DevSecOps & Language Frameworks | Published Researcher-ASI,DQS
basic_profile.summary: Platforms are products. Developers are the customers. I'm a VP Engineering with 13 years across product and platform work in regulated, enterprise-grade environments — most of it in BFSI. My focus is the systems that decide how fast and how safely software ships: developer platforms, language frameworks, and DevSecOps. Three things I spend my time on: Paved roads over guardrails. Making the secure, compliant, well-tested path also the easiest one. Shift-left security, automated release gates, consistent tooling across teams. Healthy runtimes at scale. Keeping polyglot estates — Java, Python, Node — modern, patched, and boring. Technical currency as a continuous practice, not a yearly fire drill. AI where it earns its place. Bringing AI-assisted workflows into the SDLC in ways that move cycle time, not ways that demo well. I also publish. My most recent peer-reviewed work, Assessing Application Stability — The Application Stability Index (ASI), was published in IJECS in March 2026. A few more papers are in review. I lead a cross-functional engineering org spanning platforms, quality, DevOps, and security — hiring, mentoring, and partnering with client executives to shape direction, not just deliver scope. Happy to compare notes with anyone building internal platforms, modernizing a polyglot runtime estate, or trying to make DevSecOps something engineers actually want to use.

Established in 1964, BHEL is one of India's largest engineering and manufacturing enterprises in the energy and infrastructure sectors, and a leading power equipment manufacturer globally. BHEL serves the core sectors of the economy and provides a comprehensive portfolio of products, systems and services to customers in power, transmission, transportation, renewables, water, defence & aerospace, oil & gas, and industry. BHEL has created value for its stakeholders due to the scale and depth of its operations, rich experience, competent manpower, innovative ecosystem, diverse product-mix and focus on sustainable business solutions. BHEL’s greatest asset- its highly skilled and committed workforce of more than 34,000 employees is the cornerstone of its success.BHEL’s commitment to nation building reflects in many ways- in its contribution to the country’s installed power generation capacity; bringing the latest state-of-the-art technology to the country; consistent highest expenditure of more than 2.5% of its turnover on R&D and innovation in the Indian engineering segment; pan-India presence; establishment of world-class assets with presence in over 84 country across the globe, and contribution to the society at large through initiatives in skilling youth, health & hygiene, education, cleanliness and environment protection, to name a few.With a widespread network of 16 manufacturing facilities, 2 repair units, 4 regional offices, 8 service centres, 1 subsidiary, 3 active joint ventures, 15 regional marketing centres, 3 overseas offices and current project execution at more than 150 project sites across India and abroad, BHEL manufactures a wide range of high quality & reliable products adhering to national & international standards. BHEL has installed over 1000 utility sets worldwide with its installed base of supplied power generating equipment exceeding 185 GW. BHEL has also commissioned 200+ electric substations & 5 major HVDC projects in the country.

basic_profile.name: Chris Whitby
basic_profile.headline: SVP, Financial Technology Delivery | Enterprise Transformation | Client Strategy | Digital Platforms
basic_profile.summary:
Proven executive leader with 15+ years of experience driving customer success, client retention, and revenue expansion in B2B SaaS and FinTech environments. I’ve built and scaled global teams across Customer Success, Account Management, Support, and Implementation, consistently delivering improvements in Net Revenue Retention (NRR), product adoption, and client satisfaction.

At Beacon, I bootstrapped and scaled a post-sale organization of 40+, driving 115%+ NRR YoY. Prior to that, I led a 80+ person team at ION across six product lines, overseeing key global client relationships and optimizing service delivery for a large portfolio.

I specialize in aligning Customer Success with Product and Go-To-Market strategy, ensuring that client insights directly shape product roadmaps and feature prioritization. This approach has unlocked significant upsell opportunities, deepened client partnerships, and reduced churn.

Core Competencies:

- Executive Leadership & Team Scaling
- Customer Success Strategy & Client Outcomes
- Revenue Growth, Retention & Expansion (NRR/GRR)
- Customer Experience (CX) Optimization
- Product-Led Growth & GTM Collaboration
- Client Advocacy & Stakeholder Engagement
- Post-Sale Operations & Transformation

After a successful tenure scaling teams and driving growth in SaaS and FinTech, I’m currently on a professional break to support my family. I remain open to leadership opportunities where I can apply my expertise in Customer Success and cross-functional growth strategy.

ReactiveCore's mission is to address the $1+ trillion annual fraud, waste and abuse in healthcare by providing our customers with trusted data on a modern, cloud-based platform, setting the stage for innovation. Healthcare data accumulation starts with a patient transaction but claims provide an incomplete view; the root cause of rising healthcare costs.AI MetaData FactoryTM curates big data quickly, accurately, and securely. Our Enterprise Architecture (on premise or in the cloud) is the foundation for ReactiveCore’s National Data-as-a-Service, IDNames.Services. This web service offers on-demand access to an authoritative identity source for ~6M providers (practitioners and healthcare organizations), ~300M individuals and ~20M organizations. Endless variations of names, addresses, and relationships complicate the task of rendering healthcare services. With IDNames.Services’ patented algorithms, traditional and non-traditional data sources, and hundreds of data elements of historical insights, we turn the identity crisis into precision data. Healthcare entities can easily correct records and integrate precise identities that are assigned a Unique Universal Identification to accurately identify every individual, provider and organization. The ReactiveCore platform provides the highest levels of data security and has been successfully validated against rigorous security controls, (i.e. NIST 800-53 and HIPAA). Unlike legacy technologies that must be retrofitted to meet today’s security controls, each of our platform components are securely designed from inception, with end-to-end encryption, and modern access control features such as role-based access and multi-factor authentication.ReactiveCore’s solutions create a pathway to develop high-performing provider networks and make precise clinical and financial recommendations with a complete patient 360 view, including non PHI data. Our offerings enable digital transformation faster, at a lower cost and at scale.

It was that nothing connected both worlds in one place, written for someone living this life.So I built NewsCue — an AI news app for Indians in the US. It pulls from Indian and American sources and surfaces what actually matters to the diaspora. Free on the App Store.Built it on my own while working full time as a VP at Gemini Solutions. Started mid-February, tested for a month, shipped end of April.I'm documenting the build here — the technical decisions, what broke, what I learned. If you're an NRI in the US or building AI products solo, follow along.

Before Gemini i had spent couple of years in Global Logic where i worked as a C++ developer.

basic_profile.summary:
Senior Technical Program Manager and IT Project Leader with 21+ years of experience delivering complex enterprise programs within Financial Services and Capital Markets environments.

• Enterprise Financial Systems & Capital Markets
• Trade Lifecycle & Post-Trade Processing
• Fixed Income Trading Platforms
• Cloud Migration & Data Platform Modernization
• Systems Integration & API-driven architectures

I am currently open to Senior Technical Program Manager and Senior IT Project Manager opportunities focused on enterprise transformation, data platforms, cloud modernization, and financial systems delivery.

Technical Program Management | Capital Markets | Fixed Income | Trade Lifecycle | Cloud Migration | Data Platforms | AI Integration | Systems Integration | Agile | Risk & Governance

past.employee_description:
Genpact Headstrong Services | Los Angeles, CA
Clients: Cox Communications, Western Asset Management, Franklin Templeton

Lead enterprise Technical Program Management initiatives across Capital Markets and Telecommunications clients, delivering fixed-bid and multi-year programs spanning trade lifecycle modernization, cloud data platforms, and AI-enabled analytics.

Manage global cross-functional teams (onshore/offshore) driving end-to-end SDLC execution across financial systems, post-trade platforms, and cloud integrations.

• Directed full program lifecycle from chartering and roadmap planning through deployment using Agile and hybrid delivery models.
• Established governance frameworks, prioritization (RICE, MoSCoW), capacity planning, and RAID risk tracking.
• Partnered with executive sponsors to define scope, KPIs, and success criteria; ensured transparent stakeholder communication.
• Translated business requirements into functional specs, workflow documentation, and Jira user stories.
• Led integration and UAT validation to ensure quality delivery.

Key Impact:
• Migrated fixed income confirmation workflows to DTCC Omgeo CTM; improved efficiency by 20% and increased transaction accuracy to 99% across US, London, and Asia.
• Designed STP processing for MBS and F&O collateral workflows (MT540/542), eliminating 40% manual interventions.
• Refactored settlement workflows reducing error rate from 1% to near zero.
• Delivered fee calculation engine for cleared futures generating ~$1M operational savings.
• Implemented AWS data pipeline (Lambda, S3, RDS) for CCaaS APIs enabling real-time dashboards.
• Led development of LLM-powered conversational analytics agent improving productivity by 30%.
• Directed AUM data governance and workflow documentation improving reporting accuracy and compliance.

basic_profile.name: Saurabh Bansal
basic_profile.headline: Building AI Stack for India at ConveGenius | Strategic Builder & Operator | IIM Bangalore | X-Wiom · MSDF · Zomato · Jabong · Kearney · TCNS
basic_profile.summary: Over 18 years across high-growth startups and business, strategy consulting and impact investing, I've consistently chosen hard problems over comfortable ones: building India's first asset-heavy ecommerce supply chain at Jabong, creating a D2C business worth hundreds of crores from scratch at TCNS, and now designing the operational and supply chain infrastructure for Wiom — India's first pay-as-you-go home internet model for Bharat.My core is the combination of strategy-depth and execution-accountability for building and transforming high ambiguity businesses. I worked at Kearney and Michael & Susan Dell foundation, designing strategies that delivered revenue growth, company scale, and large deals along with deep, lasting impact on society. Then I chose the other side of the table — getting into the trenches and each time building new-to-India businesses with real P&L, real customers, and real operational complexity at Jabong, Zomato and Wiom.Three moments define what I build:→ Jabong (founding team): Built operations for 500K+ monthly transactions and took NPS to 60%+ — best across all Indian ecommerce at the time — by designing India's first asset-heavy supply chain. Reduced cost per transaction by 30% while scaling.→ TCNS (started D2C): Built the D2C business from zero to hundreds of crores — contributing one-fifth of total company revenue — while leading the full digital and data transformation of India's leading women's fashion brand.→ Wiom (now): Building the systems, supply chain, and internet experience layer that powers India's first recharge-based home broadband — a genuinely new category designed for Bharat's next-billion users. AI is woven into how we design and operate.Educated at IIM Bangalore. T Thomas Scholar. CAT 99.98 percentile - first attempt. Open to board, advisory, or senior leadership conversations with founders and organisations building at scale in digital, consumer, or new-age technology businesses.

past.employee_description:
TCNS (now Aditya Birla Fashion Retail) is India's leading women's fashion company — home to brands W, Aurelia, and Wishful. 
When I joined as Head of Digital, it was a brand-led, wholesale-first business with no D2C presence. By the time I left, it had one of India's fastest-scaling fashion D2C operations — and the supply chain architecture to sustain it.


Key responsibilities:

Built the D2C business from zero to hundreds of crores in 3 years, reaching one-fifth of total company revenue — while improving online profitability simultaneously

Transformed the company's relationship with digital. Moved TCNS from treating online as a discount channel to making it a core growth engine:
- Built omni-channel capability with a single view of inventory across 500+ stores and all warehouses — letting consumers buy anywhere, fulfill anywhere
- Introduced ML-based demand sensing to reduce the chronic industry problem of inventory surplus in some locations and shortages in others
- Set up the company's first Consumer Data Platform — enabling personalized engagement at scale 

With additional responsibility as head of Core IT, modernized the technology foundation. TCNS was running on legacy infrastructure that couldn't support the Digital businesses. Built the cloud front-end and back-end stack — not as a technology project, but as a business enablement initiative for the next decade of growth.

Part of the core strategic team through one of India's largest fashion M&As — the ABFRL acquisition. Contributed to M&A pitch, partner search and due diligence as part of the core team alongside the CEO and CFO.

past.employee_description:
Jabong was India's first premium fashion ecommerce brand — and in 2011, we were building it entirely from scratch during India's first internet commerce wave, with no domestic playbook to follow.

As a founding team member and single-point owner of customer experience and operations, I built the infrastructure that made Jabong India's most trusted fashion destination. 

- Took Jabong's NPS to 60%+ — best across all Indian ecommerce at the time — by making a deliberate, contrarian bet: building India's first asset-heavy, asset-controlled supply chain instead of outsourcing logistics. The insight was that in premium fashion, experience is the product — and experience requires controlling the last mile, not delegating it

- Scaled operations from zero to 500,000+ transactions per month across 6 functions built from scratch: Customer Experience, Analytics, Third-party Logistics, Production, Order Fulfilment, and Returns

- Reduced cost per transaction by 30% while scaling volume — driving ~10% bottomline improvement — proving that experience and efficiency are not a trade-off when the system is designed correctly from the start
 
- Hired 150+ people across all levels — from operations staff and fashion photographers to IIT/IIM senior managers — and built a culture of precision and ownership that became Jabong's operational identity

The supply chain principles I built here — asset control, measurable experience, data-driven operations — are the same ones I've reapplied at TCNS and now at Wiom

past.employee_title: Head, Internet Experience and Supply Chain
past.employee_description:
Wiom is building India's first pay-as-you-go home internet: Recharge-wala Ghar ka Net — designed for households that need flexible, affordable internet without fixed monthly commitments. It is empowered in this endeavour by marquee investors such as Prosus, Accel and RTP Global.

My role is to make that model work reliably, at scale, from the supply chain to the last-mile internet experience. Managing internet experience across 50+ cities, 1500+ partners, and ~2Lac devices — in a model where every recharge is a retention decision

past.employer_linkedin_description: Softcell Technologies Private Limited (STPL) is an authorised Authentication Service Agency (ASA) and KYC Service Agency(KSA) of UIDAI. We have multiple partners (AUAs and KUAs) who leverage our platform to offer Aadhaar based services and offerings that benefit their end consumers/beneficiaries.As an ASA we play a key role in the Aadhaar ecosystem, enabling requesting entities - Authentication User Agencies (AUAs) and e-KYC User Agencies (KUAs) - to connect with UIDAI's Central Identities Data Repository (CIDR) servers."e-KYC authentication facility" means a type of authentication facility in which the biometric information and/or OTP and Aadhaar number securely submitted with the consent of the Aadhaar number holder through a requesting entity, is matched against the data available in the CIDR, and the Authority returns a digitally signed response containing e-KYC data along with other technical details related to the authentication transaction."Yes/No authentication facility" means a type of authentication facility in which the identity information and Aadhaar number securely submitted with the consent of the Aadhaar number holder through a requesting entity, is then matched against the data available in the CIDR, and the Authority responds with a digitally signed response containing "Yes" or "No", along with other technical details related to the authentication transaction, but no identity information.STPL leverages on the 30+ years of experience and technical know-how to deliver reliable and robust Aadhaar authentication solutions to AUAs and KUAs. At STPL we pride ourselves in our ability to go the extra mile and get the job done. Our team is motivated, driven and extremely capable of managing a range of requirements and is our single, biggest asset.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Quikr, which now operates leading transaction marketplaces built on top of India’s largest classifieds platform, is India’s largest platform that is used by over 30 million unique users a month. It is present in 1200 cities in India and operates several large classifieds businesses across C2C, Cars, Education, Homes, Jobs, and Services. We are the only classifieds platform not just in India but globally to go in for verticalization. The change in strategy has helped us go deeper into our key verticals - QuikrC2C for goods, QuikrCars for cars and bikes, QuikrHomes for residential and commercial properties, QuikrJobs for blue/grey collar jobs and QuikrServices for daily and long term services need to offer a richer consumer experience.  The Quikr platform operates across desktop, laptop and mobile phones, and allows consumers as well as small businesses to sell, buy, rent and find things across its multiple categories with great ease. Flexibility has always been key to our success and the essence of this is captured by our motto: ‘Aasaan Hai Badalna’ (Change is Easy).  We have always strived to understand and meet the needs of Indian consumers with consumer insights forming the backbone of everything we do. We introduced a series of innovations such as Quikr Nxt, Maximum Sales Price (MSP) calculator, Missed call, Car inspection report, Vernacular Support and the QuikrScanner app to help lift the consumer experience to a whole new level and be a game-changer for the industry. In yet another pioneering move, we have also brought the convenience of ecommerce for pre-owned goods with Quikr Doorstep. Founded by Pranay Chulet in 2008, our investors include Warburg Pincus, Kinnevik, Tiger Global Management, Matrix Partners India, Norwest Venture Partners, Nokia Growth Partners, Steadview Capital, Omidyar Network, Ebay Inc.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Generation is a global employment non-profit with a mission to transform education to employment systems to prepare, place, and support people into life-changing careers that would otherwise be inaccessible. We do this through intensive training, coaching, and job placement support, which begins with local employers and is custom built for the actual job roles in demand in each market. Through our programs, adults of all ages and backgrounds whether unemployed, underemployed, or in need of a career change can successfully gain employment in a career building role for which they have passion.To date, we have supported 37,000+ graduates, at an 80% job placement rate, and 70% continue to be employed six months later. Graduates typically earn 2-6x more than their income prior to Generation; and have cumulatively earned $300M in salary to date.In Singapore, Generation's flagship program is the Work-Study Certificate, conducted in collaboration with SkillsFuture SG, post-secondary institutions (5 Polys & 3 ITEs) and private institutions (HMI) to develop demand-driven "train & place" programmes in various job functions (Digital Marketing, Engineering 4.0, Customer Service, Healthcare). We will also be launching more programs soon, so watch this space.We are excited to be working with our partners in Singapore to empower individuals to build thriving careers!

past.employer_linkedin_description: XSEED Education is a Singapore based organization globally transforming K-8 education from rote to learning. past.employer_linkedin_description: Utsaha, the grand annual marketing fest of Central India organized by the students of the Indian Institute of Management Indore, is a vibrant celebration where people immerse themselves in games and activities crafted by the student team. Traditionally held at Janapav Kuti on Kartik Purnima, this year's event will adapt to changing circumstances, promising new experiences!One of the fest's unique features is the innovative use of concealed marketing survey techniques to gather authentic customer feedback on products, companies, and services. By gamifying questionnaires and conducting surveys in natural settings, the team ensures unbiased insights for partner companies. Additionally, the team undertakes client-custom projects to deliver comprehensive syndicate reports, offering valuable industry data.The Utsaha team's expertise spans consumer behavior, brand management, rural marketing, qualitative market research, and various analytical tools for deep customer insights. With a strong network of 25+ associations and over 60 successful projects, major clients like Cadbury, Unilever, Vodafone, and others trust the team's strategic capabilities.An integral part of the fest is the community engagement with villages and neighborhoods in and around Indore. Ummeed, a part of Utsaha, has significantly impacted by conducting workshops in rural government schools, benefiting over 500 students with educational sessions, career counseling, and essential water facilities. The team's overarching goal is to address societal issues and contribute to the holistic upliftment of communities.

basic_profile.name: Shikhar Gupta
basic_profile.headline: Co-Founder | Chief Product Officer - Leading AI-Driven EdTech Products for Social Impact
basic_profile.summary:
Hi, I'm Shikhar Gupta, Chief Product Officer with 8+ years of experience delivering ed tech products. My passion for bringing quality education to the masses began several years ago when I visited a government shelter home and witnessed the challenges faced by underprivileged children. 

This experience inspired me to start a non-profit organization and assemble a team of volunteers to improve shelter homes. Through this experience, I learned the power of education and skills in making social impact, and the importance of resilience and bouncing back from failures.

Since then, I've dedicated my career to developing innovative solutions that enhance the learning experience for students of all ages. My expertise lies in leveraging AI and other emerging technologies to create personalized, data-driven products that meet the needs of today's learners. Whether it's designing an adaptive learning solution, creating evidence-driven assessments, or training teachers on technology and effective teaching methods, I'm passionate about using cutting-edge technology to transform education and make a real difference in the world.

If you're interested in the new age ed-tech products that drive meaningful impact, let's connect and explore our interests

current.employer_linkedin_description: ConveGenius Insights (previously Gray Matters India - GMI) is a social enterprise that aspires to make education more child-centric using diagnostic assessments and analytics.We believe that child-specific feedback is one of the key things that is needed for children to fix their learning gaps and move ahead in life. Our assessments and reports are designed to meet this goal. We have worked with 10000+ schools across the country, assessing 350,000+ students and 25,000 teachers.
current.employee_description:
I am currently heading ConveGenius Insights (Previously known as Gray Matters India).

ConveGenius Insights is one of the fastest-growing assessments company in the country. In the last 2 years, CGI has collected a few billion data points from learning and assessments data of over 10 million children and worked with about 16 state governments to identify learning gaps from students all over the country. Some of these states include Himachal Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, and Gujarat.

The organization has pioneered models to develop modern measurement techniques in education that are actionable on the ground and contextualized to the diversity of India. From conducting parent surveys to actively seeking client feedback, we are committed to raising standards for education data and customer service.
With a deep focus on functional technology CGI plans to tap on to the growing number of smart phones in the country to create meaningful learning fingerprints of every child to reduce learning gaps.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Make A Difference (MAD) is one of India's largest millennial-driven, non-profit organizations working to transform outcomes for children in need of care and protection.MAD's Vision is that all children that grow up in care in India are able to realize equitable outcomes on par with the middle class.MAD’s Mission is to ensure that all children in shelters across India are able to realize equitable outcomes within the next 25 years, by mobilizing the community, empowering the child, enabling the sector, and changing the ecosystem. We are building new holistic, integrated, and long-term developmental methodologies that enable us to work with children in an age-transitional way, all the way from young childhood into adulthood, from age 10 to 28.As of today Make a Difference works with approximately 3500 children in partnership with 60 shelters across 23 cities in India, through a highly efficient and unique operating model that is almost entirely volunteer-driven with an overall workforce size of 4000 in flat, distributed structure that runs on virtual infrastructure. We operate at less than 1/10th the cost of an equivalent sized non-profit, with no loss in continuity, retention or quality, and are pioneers in both culture and organisational design that is specialized for impact. Make A Difference consistently ranks in the Top 10 Best NGOs to Work For in India, and most recently ranked in India's Top 10 Great Mid-size Workplaces across all sectors in the Great Place To Work Institute's 2018 Survey.

basic_profile.name: Sri Nitya A.
basic_profile.headline: AVP @ ConveGenius | Building for Bharat | Curious about people, orgs & incentives | Writing to think, sharing to learn
basic_profile.summary:
I build products for learners, teachers, and administrators in India’s public education system — people who’ve historically been underserved by mainstream edtech.

At ConveGenius.AI, I’ve spent the last few years helping transform SwiftChat into a statewide administrative and governance solution — powering facial-recognition attendance for teachers, geo-fenced compliance, OCR-based assessments, real-time data dashboards, teacher development communities, and more.

More recently, I led product development for Swiftee, our multimodal AI companion that supports chat, voice, video, and screen-share interactions, building AI behaviours that feel simple, trustworthy, and usable in low-bandwidth classrooms.

Before this, I worked across curriculum, assessments, and digital learning at OUP, CSSL, and ClassKlap — years that shaped my empathy for the Indian classroom and the constraints real users live with.

I’m curious about:
📌 AI-powered products in high-constraint environments
📌 What actually works (and doesn’t) in Indian education
📌 People systems inside organisations
📌 How women build financial independence

If you think about these things too — I’d love to talk.

Ask me about:
📌 Building edtech for low-resource, multilingual environments
📌 AI UX for chat/voice/video/screen-share
📌 Scaling product teams with empathy and rigour
📌 CV reviews, negotiation advice, and sustainable careers in mission-driven spaces

past.employer_name: Centre for Science of Student Learning
past.employer_linkedin_description: The Centre for Science of Student Learning is a Not for Profit with a mission to improve the way our children learn by building capacity to measure learning through high quality assessments & conducting research into the science of student learning. CSSL strives to be a truly meritocratic environment where innovation and entrepreneurship are valued and celebrated. We supply and implement new ideas to the education sector, drawing from a deep base of knowledge that cuts across multiple fields like cognitive and affective sciences, psychometrics, gender perspectives, statistics, mathematical modelling and economics.CSSL is a unique HYBRID model between an institution for learning, research and implementation. The closest analogy is a Medical College Hospital where one would get a theoretical grounding of the science and also get hands-on-practise for developing the art. CSSL strives to achieve this by  1. Building Assessment Capacity- Systemic, Institutional, and Individual2. Research into Science of Student Learning3. Building Open Source Tools What we are striving for is a fundamental shift in the behaviour of stakeholders in the system to approach learning diagnostically and to build insights into the learning process. We believe that behavioural shift is aided by conducive external conditions, one of which is the availability and accessibility to resources that supports the new behaviour. Our open resources and tools will add strength to the cause of diagnostic measurement of learning and drive data based decision making in the classroom.CSSL's team of experts have experience of building large scale diagnostic assessment tools in multiple languages, executing data collection and analysing more than 15 million students' data across South Asia, researching on student cognitive and affective learning, impact evaluation, randomised control trials, cross sectional and longitudinal surveys in government and private schools.

basic_profile.name: Rhythm Behl
basic_profile.headline: Entrepreneurship | Impact Consulting | Driving Large-Scale Government Reforms
basic_profile.summary: I am a curious human who has spent 9+ years designing and executing a billion dollar worth public programs across the country. I will always be found thinking, problem solving, building solutions in the shadows - very like the batman! Working with highly committed and driven team members to foster positive societal change keeps me motivated. I am a doer, a policy to execution leader, who has put multiple hats across research, strategy, operations, people, product, and technology, shaping ideas into scalable solutions.- In addition, I have led multi-disciplinary teams working with Chief Secretary offices and other senior leadership to deliver $1B+ public programs across Punjab, Haryana, and J&K.- Led the end-to-end conceptualisation, design, and approval of India’s first state-wide air quality reform, Haryana Clean Air Project for Sustainable Development, a $438M World Bank supported program.- Supported design of ARJUN, Haryana’s dedicated government Special Purpose Vehicle for executing all externally aided projects.- Helped scale GDi Partners, a social impact consulting start-up, 10X by expanding into newer domains like institution design and AI-for-employment, while strengthening CEO’s office, internal L&D and recruitment systems.I started my journey as a policy researcher. However, through consistent hard work and the ability to chase my dreams, I have helped build firms from its early stages and worked with multiple governments and ecosystem partners to strengthen governance systems at scale. I am a strong cheerleader of women navigating personal and professional barriers to build agency, confidence and courage to lead.Building on these successes, I am pivoting to take my next professional bet. I am currently in the early stages of shaping my own idea into a successful business. If you’re also a founder, navigating through the start-up ecosystem, or an early stage professional looking to build a successful career in impact consulting, I’d love to connect. Feel free to message me here on LinkedIn.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian School of Public Policy (ISPP) is India's first public policy institution with a design thinking focus. The Indian School of Public Policy (ISPP) is developed by distinguished policymakers, experts, and influencers from around the world, and its core values center on exceptional faculty, extensive industry connections, and innovative methods for designing and managing policies. Our esteemed Academic Advisory Council comprises distinguished individuals, including Vijay Kelkar, the Former Finance Secretary of India and a recipient of the Padma Vibhushan award in 2011, Shekhar Shah, the former Director-General of the National Council of Applied Economic Research, Arvind Panagariya, the former Vice Chairman of NITI Aayog, and Maya Tudor, an Associate Professor of Government and Public Policy at the prestigious Blavatnik School of Government, University of Oxford, among several other noteworthy members.We have a partnership with the Harris School of Public Policy at the University of Chicago and our scholars receive a certificate from them upon successfully completing 10 workshops with UChicago faculty and affiliates. basic_profile.name: Nibedita Hatibaruah
basic_profile.headline: General Manager - Growth & Impact at ConveGenius.AI
basic_profile.summary: With 10 years of experience across government, philanthropy, consulting and tech for social good, I lead complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives that translate policy intent into measurable outcomes — from grassroots institution-building to national platforms, cross-sector partnerships and strengthening public systems.Currently as GM - Growth & Impact at ConveGenius, my role focuses on strengthening large-scale public systems through technology, bringing together government, technology and programme stakeholders to translate digital infrastructure into effective implementation and meaningful human development outcomes.As Strategy Manager at the British Asian Trust, I managed large donor-funded portfolios and anchored initiatives spanning child protection, safeguarding, digital safety, and systems strengthening. I co-created and scaled the Digital Champions Program, reaching 20,000+ young people across three states, convened partnerships across government, technology companies, civil society and UN agencies, and contributed to resource mobilisation and donor strategy.Previously, at Sattva Consulting, I helped launch the Urban Collective Action Network (UCAN), a multi-organisation platform advancing citizen-centric urban governance. My work also included strengthening knowledge systems for NITI Aayog, supporting G20-aligned development priorities with the Gates Foundation, and co-creating capacity-building initiatives reaching 3M+ government officials under Mission Karmayogi.At the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC), I worked at the intersection of policy and large-scale implementation, strengthening performance and accountability systems across 60+ partners under a national skilling programme and supporting employment outcomes for lakhs of young people.I began my career as a Young Professional in rural Rajasthan, working closely with communities and grassroots institutions on financial inclusion, livelihoods, and micro-entrepreneurship.I am a Chevening Scholar driven by a commitment to building impact that outlast programs. past.employer_linkedin_description: National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) is a one-of-its-kind, Public Private Partnership (PPP) model in India, under the aegis of Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (MSDE). It aims to promote skill development by catalyzing creation of large, quality and for-profit vocational institutions. NSDC provides funding to build scalable and profitable vocational training initiatives. Its mandate is to enable support system which focuses on quality assurance, information systems and train-the-trainer academies either directly or through partnerships. NSDC acts as a catalyst in skill development by providing funding to enterprises, companies and organizations that provide skill training. It will also develop appropriate models to enhance, support and coordinate private sector initiatives. The differentiated focus on 21 sectors under NSDC’s purview and its understanding of their viability will make every sector attractive to private investment.

The Government of Assam is the governing authority of Assam, a state of India. It consists of the Governor nominated by the Government of India as the head of the state. The head of government is the Chief Minister. who is the leader of the group that commands a majority in the unicameral Assam Legislative Assembly. The Assam Assembly is elected by universal adult suffrage for a period of five years. The Chief Minister is assisted by a Council of Ministers that he nominates, the size of which is restricted.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The World Bank is a vital source of financial and technical assistance to developing countries around the world. Our vision is to create a world free of poverty on a livable planet. We are not a bank in the common sense; we are made up of two unique development institutions owned by 189 member countries: the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) and the International Development Association (IDA).Each institution plays a different but collaborative role in advancing the vision of inclusive and sustainable globalization. The IBRD aims to reduce poverty in middle-income and creditworthy poorer countries, while IDA focuses on the world's poorest countries.Their work is complemented by that of the International Finance Corporation (IFC), Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency (MIGA) and the International Centre for the Settlement of Investment Disputes (ICSID).Together, we provide low-interest loans, interest-free credits and grants to developing countries for a wide array of purposes that include investments in education, health, public administration, infrastructure, financial and private sector development, agriculture and environmental and natural resource management.

The Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) was established in 1936 as the Sir Dorabji Tata Graduate School of Social Work. In 1944, it was renamed as the Tata Institute of Social Sciences. The year 1964 was an important landmark in the history of the Institute, when it was declared Deemed to be a University under Section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act (UGC), 1956. Since its inception, the Vision of the TISS has been to be an institution of excellence in higher education that continually responds to changing social realities through the development and application of knowledge, towards creating a people-centred, ecologically sustainable and just society that promotes and protects dignity, equality, social justice and human rights for all.

past.employer_linkedin_description: CARE has been working in India for over 70 years, focusing on ending poverty and social injustice . We do this through well-planned and comprehensive programmes in health, education, livelihoods and disaster preparedness and response. Our overall goal is the empowerment of women and girls from poor and marginalised communities leading to improvement in their lives and livelihoods. We are a member of the CARE International Confederation working in 100 countries for a world where all people live in dignity and security. Why Women & GirlsWe choose to focus on women and girls because women are disproportionately affected by poverty and discrimination; we aim to ensure gender equality through the realisation of full rights and entitlements. Further, our experience shows us that, when equipped with the proper resources, women have the power to help whole families and entire communities overcome poverty.

RGAVP is an autonomous society established in October2010 by the Government of Rajasthan under the administrative control of Department of Rural Development. Registered under Society Registration Act, 1956 it is mandated to implement all rural livelihoods programs associated with SHG based institutional architecture in the state. The Society aims at creating financially sustainable and effective institutional platforms of the rural poor, enabling them to increase household income through sustainable livelihood enhancements and improved access to financial and selected public services and to build their capacities to deal with the rapidly changing external socio-economic and political world. Its approach is to support the development of livelihood opportunities for the rural poor, especially women and marginalized groups, through community institutions.

basic_profile.name: Manish Mittal
basic_profile.headline: Vice President - Programs at ConveGenius empowering the education ecosystem in India through programmatic implementation of AI-based Ed-tech solutions for varied stakeholders.
basic_profile.summary:
To summarize, it's been a humbling journey of 20 years of dedicated effort professionally & personally stretching across varied industries, MNCs and leadership positions. During the initial 12 years, I managed OEM Sales in RICOH, Corporate Salary Account sales in HDFC, lead channel sales for Travel Documentation Services in Thomas Cook across North & East India; and handled Administration Management in Jabong (Gurugram). 

Thereafter, I tasted success & failure in my own Travel venture (Travelkart Excursions Pvt. Ltd.) for almost 4 years before I finally stepped into the Education sector in March 2019 by leading the world's first DIB Project (funded by MSDF, BAT, Comic Relief, etc.) for SARD (NGO) with the objective to enhance the learning outcomes of Primary & Upper-Primary students of 30 schools across North & North-west Delhi. My team over-exceeded its targets by record margin year on year for the next 2 years of the program.
 
Finally, I joined ConveGenius in March 2021 as Sr. Program Manager just before the second wave of the pandemic. These last 4 years have been mesmerizing, rejuvenating & fulfilling for me wherein professionally I have proved my skills in multi-tasking, tech understanding, govt. liaisoning, programmatic implementation, data management and visualizations, team management, capacity building and much more. Here, I have managed & successfully implemented: 
a) Mission Buniyaad Project in Rajasthan (funded by CIFF & MSDF) for impacting learning outcomes of 10 Lakh girl Students in Secondary & Sr. Secondary grades.
b) Led the Personalized Adaptive Learning (PAL) initiatives across India (CSR & Govt. Projects).
c) Led the successful implementation of chatbots, Swiftchat App and Vidya Samiksha Kendra initiatives across 15 states & UTs; plus, managed the content solutioning & scheduling across different AI-based chatbot solutions for multiple VSKs.
d) Managed the implementation of Rashtriya Vidya Samiksha Kendra at NCERT by liaisoning with NCERT, NIC, MoE and senior representatives of all States & UTs; Successfully integrated LIVE Student & Teacher Attendance at the National level for 24 States & UTs till October 2024.
e) Presently, leading the User Success vertical across all states as well as handling business growth through the PSU vertical.

Extremely thankful to my mentors, leaders, colleagues & team members who have guided, helped and partnered me in this journey. I look forward to excel in AI-based innovations as well as undertake more responsibilities for CG in the best possibly way.

basic_profile.name: Krishna Chaitanya
basic_profile.headline: AVP, Value & Delivery @ ConveGenius.AI | Building the Operating Engine Behind Business Delivery | From Strategy to Scale
basic_profile.summary: Every role I've taken has had one thing in common: I get handed something messy — a stalled project delivery, a new market, a function that doesn't exist yet — and I build the structure that makes it run. 10+ years in, that's now the people, the systems and the delivery P&L behind two verticals at ConveGenius Group.My career has been one continuous move toward owning more of what makes delivery actually work. It started in a classroom, quite literally — building K-10 digital content and learning how programs land with real students. From there, I moved into large-scale projects execution, then into my first team leadership role leading India's first outcomes-based education financing evaluation. Along the way, I was personally named by my company's Founders and CEO as one of five people critical to keeping the business running through its acquisition — a moment that shaped how I think about what it actually takes to be indispensable to an organization, not just good at a job.Since then, I've built things from zero (a B2C service vertical, taken 0→1 in under six months), led delivery on some of India's most complex outcomes-based financing programs — including contributing to a blockchain-enabled model that ties fund disbursement directly to learning data — and spearheaded a company's first-ever international market entry into the UAE, which I built into a recurring revenue business.What I'm building toward is simple: I want to run the operating engine of a business — not just a function inside it. Every role on this path has added a layer toward that, deliberately.If you're working on delivery at scale, outcomes-based financing, or building the operational backbone of a fast-growing business — I'd love to connect.

basic_profile.name: Shikhar Gupta
basic_profile.headline: Co-Founder | Chief Product Officer - Leading AI-Driven EdTech Products for Social Impact
basic_profile.summary:
Hi, I'm Shikhar Gupta, Chief Product Officer with 8+ years of experience delivering ed tech products. My passion for bringing quality education to the masses began several years ago when I visited a government shelter home and witnessed the challenges faced by underprivileged children. 

This experience inspired me to start a non-profit organization and assemble a team of volunteers to improve shelter homes. Through this experience, I learned the power of education and skills in making social impact, and the importance of resilience and bouncing back from failures.

Since then, I've dedicated my career to developing innovative solutions that enhance the learning experience for students of all ages. My expertise lies in leveraging AI and other emerging technologies to create personalized, data-driven products that meet the needs of today's learners. Whether it's designing an adaptive learning solution, creating evidence-driven assessments, or training teachers on technology and effective teaching methods, I'm passionate about using cutting-edge technology to transform education and make a real difference in the world.

If you're interested in the new age ed-tech products that drive meaningful impact, let's connect and explore our interests

current.employee_description:
I am currently heading ConveGenius Insights (Previously known as Gray Matters India).

ConveGenius Insights is one of the fastest-growing assessments company in the country. In the last 2 years, CGI has collected a few billion data points from learning and assessments data of over 10 million children and worked with about 16 state governments to identify learning gaps from students all over the country. Some of these states include Himachal Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, and Gujarat.

The organization has pioneered models to develop modern measurement techniques in education that are actionable on the ground and contextualized to the diversity of India. From conducting parent surveys to actively seeking client feedback, we are committed to raising standards for education data and customer service.
With a deep focus on functional technology CGI plans to tap on to the growing number of smart phones in the country to create meaningful learning fingerprints of every child to reduce learning gaps.

professional_network.summary: Over 18 years across high-growth startups and business, strategy consulting and impact investing, I've consistently chosen hard problems over comfortable ones: building India's first asset-heavy ecommerce supply chain at Jabong, creating a D2C business worth hundreds of crores from scratch at TCNS, and now designing the operational and supply chain infrastructure for Wiom — India's first pay-as-you-go home internet model for Bharat.My core is the combination of strategy-depth and execution-accountability for building and transforming high ambiguity businesses. I worked at Kearney and Michael & Susan Dell foundation, designing strategies that delivered revenue growth, company scale, and large deals along with deep, lasting impact on society. Then I chose the other side of the table — getting into the trenches and each time building new-to-India businesses with real P&L, real customers, and real operational complexity at Jabong, Zomato and Wiom.Three moments define what I build:→ Jabong (founding team): Built operations for 500K+ monthly transactions and took NPS to 60%+ — best across all Indian ecommerce at the time — by designing India's first asset-heavy supply chain. Reduced cost per transaction by 30% while scaling.→ TCNS (started D2C): Built the D2C business from zero to hundreds of crores — contributing one-fifth of total company revenue — while leading the full digital and data transformation of India's leading women's fashion brand.→ Wiom (now): Building the systems, supply chain, and internet experience layer that powers India's first recharge-based home broadband — a genuinely new category designed for Bharat's next-billion users. AI is woven into how we design and operate.Educated at IIM Bangalore. T Thomas Scholar. CAT 99.98 percentile - first attempt. Open to board, advisory, or senior leadership conversations with founders and organisations building at scale in digital, consumer, or new-age technology businesses.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Zomato’s mission statement is “better food for more people.” Since our inception in 2010, we have grown tremendously, both in scope and scale - and emerged as India’s most trusted brand during the pandemic, along with being one of the largest hyperlocal delivery networks in the country.Today, Zomato represents a wide range of cultures through its diversified 5000+ team members, 3.5 lakh+ delivery partners, and our biggest collective of the finest restaurant partners. We are grateful that our business is able to provide upward social and economic movement for millions of households – of our delivery partners, as well as restaurant staff. We think of all of us as one big family!Our passion is driven by purpose and we take immense pride in our initiative ‘Feeding India’, one of India’s largest not-for-profits working to ensure that nobody in India goes to bed hungry. As of now, Feeding India provides over 150,000 nutritious meals to the underprivileged every day.In April 2020, Feeding India ran one of the largest food distribution drives in the world during the first wave of COVID, and distributed 78 million meals to daily wagers across the length and breadth of the country.During the second wave of COVID-19, Feeding India was again the first to act. We were able to source over 9,000 oxygen concentrators and distributed them for free to government hospitals across the country. This helped save millions of lives during one of the worst humanitarian crises faced by India in the recent times.We’re innovating hard to make last-mile delivery carbon neutral, to eliminate the use of plastic packaging, create meaningful opportunities in the gig economy, and to feed our country’s ever-growing appetite for high-quality, affordable, and hygienic food, one delivery at a time!

past.employee_description:
TCNS (now Aditya Birla Fashion Retail) is India's leading women's fashion company — home to brands W, Aurelia, and Wishful. 
When I joined as Head of Digital, it was a brand-led, wholesale-first business with no D2C presence. By the time I left, it had one of India's fastest-scaling fashion D2C operations — and the supply chain architecture to sustain it.


Key responsibilities:

Built the D2C business from zero to hundreds of crores in 3 years, reaching one-fifth of total company revenue — while improving online profitability simultaneously

Transformed the company's relationship with digital. Moved TCNS from treating online as a discount channel to making it a core growth engine:
- Built omni-channel capability with a single view of inventory across 500+ stores and all warehouses — letting consumers buy anywhere, fulfill anywhere
- Introduced ML-based demand sensing to reduce the chronic industry problem of inventory surplus in some locations and shortages in others
- Set up the company's first Consumer Data Platform — enabling personalized engagement at scale 

With additional responsibility as head of Core IT, modernized the technology foundation. TCNS was running on legacy infrastructure that couldn't support the Digital businesses. Built the cloud front-end and back-end stack — not as a technology project, but as a business enablement initiative for the next decade of growth.

Part of the core strategic team through one of India's largest fashion M&As — the ABFRL acquisition. Contributed to M&A pitch, partner search and due diligence as part of the core team alongside the CEO and CFO.

past.employer_linkedin_description: A young and vibrant company that aims to provide good quality branded products, Jabong.com caters to the fashion and lifestyle needs of men, women, and kids. Launched in 2012, and having been acquired by Flipkart through its Myntra unit, Jabong.com now carries over 1000 brands, 90,000 products and over 2 lakh styles. At Jabong, we strive to achieve the highest level of 'Customer Satisfaction'. Our cutting edge e-commerce platform, agile warehouse systems, innovative & enterprising teams and state of the art customer care centre ensures that it is possible. Jabong.com believes in igniting the passion in people who are looking to learn, grow and enjoy, while working in an environment that's always buzzing with energy and enthusiasm for what the brand stands for - to just Be You.
past.employee_description:
Jabong was India's first premium fashion ecommerce brand — and in 2011, we were building it entirely from scratch during India's first internet commerce wave, with no domestic playbook to follow.

As a founding team member and single-point owner of customer experience and operations, I built the infrastructure that made Jabong India's most trusted fashion destination. 

- Took Jabong's NPS to 60%+ — best across all Indian ecommerce at the time — by making a deliberate, contrarian bet: building India's first asset-heavy, asset-controlled supply chain instead of outsourcing logistics. The insight was that in premium fashion, experience is the product — and experience requires controlling the last mile, not delegating it

- Scaled operations from zero to 500,000+ transactions per month across 6 functions built from scratch: Customer Experience, Analytics, Third-party Logistics, Production, Order Fulfilment, and Returns

- Reduced cost per transaction by 30% while scaling volume — driving ~10% bottomline improvement — proving that experience and efficiency are not a trade-off when the system is designed correctly from the start
 
- Hired 150+ people across all levels — from operations staff and fashion photographers to IIT/IIM senior managers — and built a culture of precision and ownership that became Jabong's operational identity

The supply chain principles I built here — asset control, measurable experience, data-driven operations — are the same ones I've reapplied at TCNS and now at Wiom
