past.employee_title: Head, Internet Experience and Supply Chain
past.employee_description:
Wiom is building India's first pay-as-you-go home internet: Recharge-wala Ghar ka Net — designed for households that need flexible, affordable internet without fixed monthly commitments. It is empowered in this endeavour by marquee investors such as Prosus, Accel and RTP Global.

My role is to make that model work reliably, at scale, from the supply chain to the last-mile internet experience. Managing internet experience across 50+ cities, 1500+ partners, and ~2Lac devices — in a model where every recharge is a retention decision

Key Responsibilites: 

- Owner of internet experience that determines whether Wiom's customers recharge again — including firmware decisions that reduce complaints, and the recharge-to-connectivity flow design that makes every plan renewal feel instant and reliable.

- Drove the shift from reactive to proactive network operations — instrumenting with real-time performance telemetry, enabling Wiom to detect and resolve network degradation before customers experience it, protecting retention in a model where each recharge is a purchase decision.

- Designed and setup Wiom's pan-India supply chain architecture — forward and reverse logistics across metros (such as Delhi, Mumbai) and Bharat (50+ towns and cities).  Built end-to-end device logistics — from dispatch accuracy (now 100%) and on-time delivery (97%+) to a reverse/RMA process that cut device failure rates by 44%.

- Built AI-native partner servicing tools that eliminated 80%+ friction in device operations,  redesigned the entire partner servicing model — call volume down 25%, repeat calls down 67%.

- Developed AI readiness framework for the IX and Supply Chain teams; actively building AI-assisted workflows across partner operations and customer experience

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Michael & Susan Dell Foundation (dell.org) builds pathways that change lives for people and communities around the world. Through their philanthropy, Michael and Susan Dell have committed more than $10 billion to improve education, health, and economic mobility, with a focus on delivering measurable, long-term impact.
past.employee_description:
MSDF's mandate is education transformation at government scale — not NGO pilots. The question they were trying to answer: how do you move outcomes for millions of children, not thousands

I spent nearly 4 years applying the same strategic rigour I'd built at Kearney to a fundamentally different kind of problem — and building the financial and institutional structures to make change stick.


 Created India's first state-wide education reform programs — partnering with the governments of Rajasthan, Haryana, and Himachal Pradesh to redesign how public schools operate. This wasn't advising from the outside — it was co-creating solutions  embedded within government machinery, reaching millions of students.

Structured India's first learning-outcome-linked Development Impact Bond — a first-of-its-kind financial instrument where investors get returns only if measurable learning outcomes improve. Pioneered the model that has since been replicated manifold in the country. 

Built a portfolio of transformative ed-tech social enterprises and Not-for-profits — led the full investment lifecycle from sourcing to structuring to portfolio management, using a diverse toolkit (equity, grants, NCDs, consulting contracts) to back ventures like ConveGenius, Samagra Consulting, Kaivalya, Naandi and Akanksha etc. Objective was to catalyze high impact solutions which can scale.

past.employer_linkedin_description: As one of the original firms, we’ve never lost sight of the fact that consulting is a people business. A global partnership in more than 40 countries, our people make us who we are. We’re individuals with different passions and strengths who take as much joy in the work we do as from those we work with.Our strategic operations heritage means we’ve always known that a plan is only as good as the outcome it inspires. In practice, our teams bring the perspective, understanding, and hands-on know-how to build the future as you see it. Working together we’ll see big ideas through to working realities, helping you move from keeping up to breaking through. By your side, we deliver—value, results, impact.---There has been a significant increase in fraudulent outreach and phishing attempts across the recruiting landscape. Please be aware that Kearney will never request personal or financial information through social media or messaging platforms. You should only respond to communications from official Kearney email domains (e.g., @kearney.com), or through our authorized recruiting platforms such as Yello or Taleo.
past.employee_description:
Kearney is where I built the strategic and analytical foundation that has shaped every operator decision I've made since: how to diagnose a system before you try to change it, how to make the case for transformation, and how to design strategies that survive contact with reality.

4.5 years designing growth and market entry strategies across India, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East — across industries with almost nothing in common except complexity.


Select B2C:
- Developed strategy for India's largest gas utility: 3X revenue growth and 2X profit growth over 5 years
- Designed end-to-end growth strategy (branding, channels, operations, manufacturing) for Indian luxury building products company: 10X growth in 5 years, named 'Superbrand' 2015
- Developed product concept, value proposition, and market sizing for ultra-low-cost vehicle globalisation strategy for Indian Auto OEM

Select B2B:
- Led post-merger integration for 3 leading Malaysian conglomerates: asset rationalisation, practice harmonisation, organisational restructuring
- Designed India market entry for global Oil & Gas supermajor: one of India's top 3 FDI deals
- Developed growth strategy for global top-5 logistics player: 50% YoY growth in first two years post-project

What Kearney gave me was not sector knowledge — it was the habit of thinking at the system level before acting at the execution level. That instinct is in everything I've built since.

Hi, I'm Shikhar Gupta, Chief Product Officer with 8+ years of experience delivering ed tech products. My passion for bringing quality education to the masses began several years ago when I visited a government shelter home and witnessed the challenges faced by underprivileged children. 

This experience inspired me to start a non-profit organization and assemble a team of volunteers to improve shelter homes. Through this experience, I learned the power of education and skills in making social impact, and the importance of resilience and bouncing back from failures.

Whether it's designing an adaptive learning solution, creating evidence-driven assessments, or training teachers on technology and effective teaching methods, I'm passionate about using cutting-edge technology to transform education and make a real difference in the world.

If you're interested in the new age ed-tech products that drive meaningful impact, let's connect and explore our interests

basic_profile.name: Thillai Rajan
basic_profile.headline: Institute Chair Prof. and Head, Centre for Research on Startups, IIT Madras; Anchor for Untold Pages (Sollappadaatha Pakkangal) for The Hindu 360; Associate @The Lakshmi Mittal and Family South Asia Institute @Harvard.
basic_profile.summary:
I am a Professor in the Department of Management Studies at IIT Madras, where I teach Financial Management and Electives in Corporate Finance. My research work primarily focuses on Venture Capital, Start-ups, Infrastructure Finance, and Public Private Partnerships. For 10 years, from 2009 - 18, I have had the opportunity to lead the publishing of the annual India Venture Capital & Private Equity Report. In February 2020, I conceptualized the setting up of Innovation, Venturing, and Entrepreneurship in India (IVEIN) Network, a unique partnership between leading institutions, IIT Madras, IIT Bombay, IIM Calcutta, IIM Bangalore and IIM Kozhikode.

I have also founded YNOS Venture Engine (www.ynos.in), which has now emerged as the most comprehensive information platform for early stage start-ups and investors. At IIT Madras, I head the Centre for Research on Start-ups and Risk Financing (CREST), a leading global centre for scholarly research in the areas of entrepreneurship and venture capital.  In the past, I have been fortunate to be a recipient of the Chevening Gurukul Fellowship at the London School of Economics, Endeavour Executive Award at the Macquarie Graduate School of Management, and the Fulbright Nehru Senior Research Fellowship at the Harvard Kennedy School. I have also been chosen for the Young Faculty Recognition Award of IIT Madras, Young Faculty Award of the Association of Indian Management Schools, P. K. Das Memorial Best Faculty Award, Outstanding Young Management Teacher Award of the Association of Indian Management Scholars’ International, Dewang Mehta Award for Best Teacher in Financial Management, Young Management Researcher Award of the Association of Indian Management Scholars’ International, and Dr. Harisingh Gour Award for Teaching Excellence in Management. 

I received my degrees from Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani and the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Indian Institute of Technology Madras is one among the foremost institutes of national importance in higher technological education, basic and applied research. In 1956, the German Government offered technical assistance for establishing an institute of higher education in engineering in India. The first Indo-German agreement in Bonn, West Germany for the establishment of the Indian Institute of Technology at Madras was signed in 1959.The Institute was formally inaugurated in 1959 by Prof. Humayun Kabir, Union Minister for Scientific Research and Cultural Affairs. The IIT system has sixteen Institutes of Technology. The first of these to be instituted are at Kharagpur (estb. 1951), Mumbai (estb. 1958), Chennai (estb. 1959), Kanpur (estb. 1959), Delhi (estb. 1961), Guwahati (estb. 1994) and Roorkee (estb. 1847, joined IITs in 2001).IIT Madras is a residential institute with nearly 550 faculty, 8000 students and 1250 administrative & supporting staff and is a self-contained campus located in a beautiful wooded land of about 250 hectares. It has established itself as a premier centre for teaching, research and industrial consultancy in the country.The Institute has sixteen academic departments and a few advanced research centres in various disciplines of engineering and pure sciences, with nearly 100 laboratories organised in a unique pattern of functioning. A faculty of international repute, a brilliant student community, excellent technical & supporting staff and an effective administration have all contributed to the pre-eminent status of IIT Madras. The campus is located in the city of Chennai, previously known as Madras. Chennai is the state capital of Tamilnadu, a southern state in India.

current.employer_linkedin_description: The Entrepreneurship Cell (E-Cell) is a non-profit organization run by students of IIT Bombay. We create awareness among students & professionals about Entrepreneurship through our various programs like workshops, speaker sessions, business plan competitions, and other such events. We support upcoming Entrepreneurs by providing them necessary resources such as mentors, consultancy, seed funds and networking. The summit has had speaker sessions from great entrepreneurs like Travis Kalanick, Kiran Majumdar Shaw, Sachin Bansal, Ritesh Agarwal, Bhavish Aggarwal, Bharat Desai, and personalities like Rajat Sharma, Nandan Nilekani, Amitabh Kant, Anurag Kashyap and Ashish Chanchalani.

past.employer_linkedin_description: National Service Scheme (NSS) is a permanent youth programme under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India and funded by Government of Tamil Nadu and Government of India in the ratio of 5:7.The motto of NSS is “NOT ME BUT YOU“. It underlines that the welfare of an individual is ultimately dependent on the welfare of the society as a whole. This expresses the essence of democratic living and upholds the need of selfless service and appreciation of the other man’s point of view and also consideration for fellow human beings.

The ‘Aims’ of the NCC laid out in 1988 have stood the test of time and continue to meet the requirements expected of it in the current socio–economic scenario of the country. The NCC aims at developing character, comradeship, discipline, a secular outlook, the spirit of adventure and ideals of selfless service amongst young citizens. Further, it aims at creating a pool of organized, trained and motivated youth with leadership qualities in all walks of life, who will serve the Nation regardless of which career they choose. Needless to say, the NCC also provides an environment conducive to motivating young Indians to join the armed forces.

The American Finance Association (AFA) is the premier academic organization devoted to the study and promotion of knowledge about financial economics.The AFA was planned at a meeting in December 1939 in Philadelphia. The first journal, published in 1942, was called American Finance (link to first issue). It was renamed The Journal of Finance and became a regular serial journal in August 1946. Association membership has grown steadily over time. The AFA sponsors an annual meeting each January, where papers are presented, covering the gamut of financial topics, and the AFA’s current president speaks on a chosen subject. The Association has officers and a board of directors who assist in key decisions, and a set of bylaws governing those decisions.Purpose of the AFA: *To provide for the mutual association of persons with an interest in finance  to improve public understanding of financial problems*To provide for the exchange of financial ideas through the distribution of a  periodical and other media*To encourage the study of finance in colleges and universities*To conduct such other activities as may be appropriate for a non-profit,   professional society in the field of finance.

A non-profit entity aimed at providing a common platform to both academia and industry working in the area of finance and accounting to debate and research, exchange views on matters of corporate finance, accounting and corporate governance, financial market and risk management.

basic_profile.summary:
I am a Professor in the Department of Management Studies at IIT Madras, where I teach Financial Management and Electives in Corporate Finance. My research work primarily focuses on Venture Capital, Start-ups, Infrastructure Finance, and Public Private Partnerships. For 10 years, from 2009 - 18, I have had the opportunity to lead the publishing of the annual India Venture Capital & Private Equity Report. In February 2020, I conceptualized the setting up of Innovation, Venturing, and Entrepreneurship in India (IVEIN) Network, a unique partnership between leading institutions, IIT Madras, IIT Bombay, IIM Calcutta, IIM Bangalore and IIM Kozhikode.

I have also founded YNOS Venture Engine (www.ynos.in), which has now emerged as the most comprehensive information platform for early stage start-ups and investors. At IIT Madras, I head the Centre for Research on Start-ups and Risk Financing (CREST), a leading global centre for scholarly research in the areas of entrepreneurship and venture capital.  In the past, I have been fortunate to be a recipient of the Chevening Gurukul Fellowship at the London School of Economics, Endeavour Executive Award at the Macquarie Graduate School of Management, and the Fulbright Nehru Senior Research Fellowship at the Harvard Kennedy School. I have also been chosen for the Young Faculty Recognition Award of IIT Madras, Young Faculty Award of the Association of Indian Management Schools, P. K. Das Memorial Best Faculty Award, Outstanding Young Management Teacher Award of the Association of Indian Management Scholars’ International, Dewang Mehta Award for Best Teacher in Financial Management, Young Management Researcher Award of the Association of Indian Management Scholars’ International, and Dr. Harisingh Gour Award for Teaching Excellence in Management. 

I received my degrees from Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani and the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Indian Institute of Technology Madras is one among the foremost institutes of national importance in higher technological education, basic and applied research. In 1956, the German Government offered technical assistance for establishing an institute of higher education in engineering in India. The first Indo-German agreement in Bonn, West Germany for the establishment of the Indian Institute of Technology at Madras was signed in 1959.The Institute was formally inaugurated in 1959 by Prof. Humayun Kabir, Union Minister for Scientific Research and Cultural Affairs. The IIT system has sixteen Institutes of Technology. The first of these to be instituted are at Kharagpur (estb. 1951), Mumbai (estb. 1958), Chennai (estb. 1959), Kanpur (estb. 1959), Delhi (estb. 1961), Guwahati (estb. 1994) and Roorkee (estb. 1847, joined IITs in 2001).IIT Madras is a residential institute with nearly 550 faculty, 8000 students and 1250 administrative & supporting staff and is a self-contained campus located in a beautiful wooded land of about 250 hectares. A faculty of international repute, a brilliant student community, excellent technical & supporting staff and an effective administration have all contributed to the pre-eminent status of IIT Madras. The campus is located in the city of Chennai, previously known as Madras. Chennai is the state capital of Tamilnadu, a southern state in India.

The first journal, published in 1942, was called American Finance (link to first issue). It was renamed The Journal of Finance and became a regular serial journal in August 1946. Association membership has grown steadily over time. The AFA sponsors an annual meeting each January, where papers are presented, covering the gamut of financial topics, and the AFA’s current president speaks on a chosen subject. The Association has officers and a board of directors who assist in key decisions, and a set of bylaws governing those decisions.Purpose of the AFA: *To provide for the mutual association of persons with an interest in finance  to improve public understanding of financial problems*To provide for the exchange of financial ideas through the distribution of a  periodical and other media*To encourage the study of finance in colleges and universities*To conduct such other activities as may be appropriate for a non-profit,   professional society in the field of finance.

A non-profit entity aimed at providing a common platform to both academia and industry working in the area of finance and accounting to debate and research, exchange views on matters of corporate finance, accounting and corporate governance, financial market and risk management.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Shaastra means science. The word has a deeper connotation here, being the annual technical festival of the Indian Institute of Technology Madras. Jodo is a fintech start-up building payment solutions to make education payments convenient & affordable for parents while simplifying fee collections for education institutes. Typically, parents/students end up paying education fees in lump sums as institutes don’t have the right payment solutions to offer flexible payment options. Jodo’s suite of products - Jodo Cred, Jodo Flex, and Jodo Pay - are custom-built recurring payment solutions that allow parents/students to pay their fees in a manner most convenient to them. Our products increase fee realization for institutes by locking in cashflows while taking away the hassle of fee collection. We seamlessly enable the entire fee collection process - fee structure creation, notification, settlements, and reconciliation - and give fee collection visibility via smart analytics to management and finance teams. By opting to pay via Jodo’s payment plans, parents also become a part of Jodo’s parent community and get access to high-quality content, exclusive events, and curated awards - all aimed at enriching the student’s learning journey.Jodo is started by three co-founders, who have a pedigreed education background (IIT/IIM) and relevant experience in financial services (ex-Nomura, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Barclays, Edelweiss Capital). basic_info.name: Kiritra
basic_info.description: Kiritra is SaaS platform that offers digital services to small and medium banks and financial enterprises with an aim to power their digital strategy. In the current environment most organizations need to have a strong digital offerings to engage, retain and attract customers. However small organizations and those in the remote corners of India often do not have the financial capacity to  create their own infrastructure. In the last few years maturing  technologies have democratized access to the complex platforms. Leveraging these, we at Kiritra have begun building services that can be used by the community at large to develop their own digital services fabric. Our platform makes it effortless to choose the desired services needed to  build a robust offering by our customers for their customers.

basic_profile.name: Chandrasekhar Turlapati
basic_profile.headline: Vibe Coding | Digital | Blockchain | Investment Banking | Wealth Management| Stock Exchanges | AI Tooling | No Code Development | Vibe Coder
basic_profile.summary:
Chandrasekhar has over 25 years of professional experience in the financial services industry across organizations ranging from global banks, startups and stock exchanges (Credit Suisse, Oracle Financial Services, Elind, ISE and NSCCL). An acclaimed delivery lead he has been instrumental in building multiple products and platforms in the stock exchange, investment banking and wealth management space. At Credit Suisse he was recognized as one of the top 3 Business Analysts globally. He has built successful global teams from ground up leading them to become some of the most impactful teams. Many of his colleagues whom he has coached and mentored have transitioned into key leadership roles.

Currently he is on a mission to improve and develop the digital footprint in the banking and financial services industry through his startup Kiritra. He is driving this by leveraging smart automation and AI/ML with a “human in the loop” philosophy. 

Chandrasekhar is a management graduate having studied at VAMNICOM, Cornell and IIIT-H. He has a passion for business analysis and was one of the instrumental members in setting up the IIBA chapter in Singapore. He is a keen believer in the importance of giving back to society and has collaborated on multiple projects with Habitat for Humanity across the world. He co-created the Requirements Management curriculum for the industry interaction elective at the Wrocław University of Science and Technology and was the guest faculty as well.

Chandrasekhar us a firm believer in the ability of technology to impact lives at the lowest denomination and foresees distributed technologies pushing the boundaries of inclusion further. Trained in blockchain from IITH, he has been spreading the knowledge by successfully conducting training sessions in the domain.

basic_profile.name: Santonu Goswami
basic_profile.headline: Associate Director at Azim Premji University | Climate & Sustainability Educator | Researcher | Shaping the Next Generation of Climate & Sustainability Professionals
basic_profile.summary:
As a dedicated climate scientist and Senior Faculty at the School of Climate Change and Sustainability at Azim Premji University, Bangalore, I work at the forefront of advancing India’s climate resilience through data-driven modeling and policy insights. My research focuses on leveraging CMIP6 datasets and geospatial analytics to support actionable climate responses for policymakers and communities across India.

I have over two decades of international research experience working across government and research organizartions across multiple countries. At NRSC-ISRO, as a Senior Scientist, my work spanned modeling diverse ecosystems—including coastal, riverine, and Himalayan regions—using advanced statistical and open-source tools. I initiated the Community Climate Lab (https://cclindiaofficial.wixsite.com/cclindia) to foster a network of undergraduate researchers using AI/ML and data analytics to solve pressing environmental challenges. Supporting and mentoring young researchers to grow India’s capacity in climate and environmental science is central to my work, and I am always open to connecting with those interested in this field.

Internationally, I have contributed to the Centre for Urban Science and Progress in NYC, analyzing urban datasets to model neighborhood baseline scenarios, and conducted impactful climate research on Arctic ecosystems as a Postdoctoral Research Scientist with the U.S. Department of Energy at ORNL. I bring a proven track record of reviewing, securing and managing multi-million-dollar research projects from agencies like NASA, US NSF, ISRO.

Let’s connect if you’re passionate about climate action, geospatial analytics, and fostering climate resilience through innovative science and technology.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) is the space agency of the Government of India headquartered in the city of Bengaluru. Our vision is to "harness space technology for national development", while pursuing space science research and planetary exploration. ISRO is managed by the Department of Space (DoS) of the Government of India.Indian Space Research Organisation, formed in 1969, superseded the erstwhile INCOSPAR. ISRO is one of the six largest space agencies in the world. ISRO maintains one of the largest fleet of communication satellites (INSAT) and remote sensing (IRS) satellites, that cater to the ever growing demand for fast and reliable communication and earth observation respectively. ISRO develops and delivers application specific satellite products and tools to the Nation: broadcasts, communications, weather forecasts, disaster management tools, Geographic Information Systems, cartography, navigation, telemedicine, dedicated distance education satellites being some of them. The PSLV was developed as a cost efficient and reliable launch system which went on to become a favoured carrier for satellites of various countries due to its reliability and cost efficiency, promoting unprecedented international collaboration. The Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV) was developed keeping in mind the heavier and more demanding Geosynchronous communication satellites.Future readiness is the key to maintaining an edge in technology and ISRO endeavours to optimise and enhance its technologies as the needs and ambitions of the country evolve. Thus, ISRO is moving forward with the development of heavy lift launchers, human spaceflight projects, reusable launch vehicles, semi-cryogenic engines, single and two stage to orbit (SSTO and TSTO) vehicles, development and use of composite materials for space applications etc.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) is the space agency of the Government of India headquartered in the city of Bengaluru. Our vision is to "harness space technology for national development", while pursuing space science research and planetary exploration. ISRO is managed by the Department of Space (DoS) of the Government of India.Indian Space Research Organisation, formed in 1969, superseded the erstwhile INCOSPAR. ISRO is one of the six largest space agencies in the world. ISRO maintains one of the largest fleet of communication satellites (INSAT) and remote sensing (IRS) satellites, that cater to the ever growing demand for fast and reliable communication and earth observation respectively. ISRO develops and delivers application specific satellite products and tools to the Nation: broadcasts, communications, weather forecasts, disaster management tools, Geographic Information Systems, cartography, navigation, telemedicine, dedicated distance education satellites being some of them. The PSLV was developed as a cost efficient and reliable launch system which went on to become a favoured carrier for satellites of various countries due to its reliability and cost efficiency, promoting unprecedented international collaboration. The Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV) was developed keeping in mind the heavier and more demanding Geosynchronous communication satellites.Future readiness is the key to maintaining an edge in technology and ISRO endeavours to optimise and enhance its technologies as the needs and ambitions of the country evolve. Thus, ISRO is moving forward with the development of heavy lift launchers, human spaceflight projects, reusable launch vehicles, semi-cryogenic engines, single and two stage to orbit (SSTO and TSTO) vehicles, development and use of composite materials for space applications etc.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Centuri AB äger och utvecklar produkten Centuri — ett system för dokumenthantering, avvikelsehantering och avtalshantering. Under de mer än 25 år som vi har funnits har vi till dags datum levererat ledningssystem till drygt 100 000 slutanvändare. Alla införandeprojekt av Centuri genomförs av oss. Detsamma gäller support efter leverans. Det innebär att våra kunder får en tydlig samarbetspartner som tar ansvar för helheten.Våra samarbeten präglas av kundorientering, kunskap, omtanke och effektivitet.Sedan starten 1998 har vi på Centuri AB arbetat för att ha marknadens mest nöjda kunder. Under resans gång har vi samlat på oss en hel del erfarenheter som hjälper oss att nå det målet. Den kanske viktigaste är att enbart en bra produkt inte är någon garanti för framgång. Det krävs nämligen lite mer än så. En engagerad ledning hos kunden och ett välorganiserat projekt är minst lika viktiga faktorer för att lyckas. Att införa ett system för dokumenthantering, avtalshantering eller ärendehantering innebär ett förändrat arbetssätt för organisationen. Hur stor förändringen blir och hur mottaglig organisationen är varierar från fall till fall. Att varje kund är unik är i detta fall ingen klyscha. Det gäller att matcha förutsättningarna med ett införandeprojekt som är anpassat efter situationen. Med vår erfarenhet från mer än 120 implementeringar kan vi för varje situation erbjuda ett projektupplägg som innefattar de aktiviteter som behövs men heller inget mer! Vår roll är att se till att du som kund får den hjälp du behöver för att säkerställa ett framgångsrikt projekt. Som stöd i projektet använder vi vår egen projektmodell. Den innehåller ett antal väldefinierade aktiviteter för att ta ett projekt från förstudie till en validerad installation som sedan kan övergå i en förvaltningsfas.

basic_profile.name: Maria Axente
basic_profile.headline: Making the invisible visible | Seeing around the corners of technological change | Founder, Responsible Intelligence
basic_profile.summary:
I founded Responsible Intelligence to help AI companies, investors, and enterprises turn Responsible AI into growth, not red tape.

My work today is centred on advisory - supporting AI builders to prove they are enterprise-ready, helping investors protect and grow their portfolios, and guiding leaders who need to bring trust into their systems without losing momentum.

Alongside this, I am shaping the roadmap for a platform that will set Responsible AI as the new standard for growth. The advisory work funds it, informs it, and keeps me close to the real challenges companies face. Every engagement, every blind spot uncovered, every conversation with leaders becomes part of the foundation for what I’m building.

I’ve spent years at the frontlines of this field leading Responsible AI at PwC, advising NATO, UNICEF, and governments, and working with global enterprises navigating AI risk. The same truth emerged everywhere: when Responsible AI is treated as paperwork, companies stall, but when it is embraced as strategy aligned with organisational goals and vision, they scale and grow. Sustainably

Responsible Intelligence is how I act on that truth. It delivers impact for clients today, while quietly building the platform that will carry this vision forward in the years to come.

basic_profile.summary: Global Talent Acquisition professional with 12+ years of experience specialising in technical and technology hiring across AI/ML, Data Engineering, Cybersecurity, Product, and Corporate functions. My career spans agency recruitment, RPO delivery, and in-house TA across India, the UAE, and global markets.  Most recently, as Senior TA Specialist at G42.ai — one of the UAE's leading AI and technology conglomerates — I exclusively supported Presight's scale-up phase, delivering 100–120 hires annually across UAE, Kazakhstan, and Jordan within a maximum 30-35 day turnaround. My hiring expertise spans a broad range of industries including but not limited to Technology, Financial Institutions, Manufacturing, Pharmaceuticals, Aerospace, Healthcare, FMCG, Chemicals,Retail, Healthcare and Diagnostics, Real Estate, EPC, Oil and Gas, EdTech, and E-Commerce — giving me the versatility to support both specialised and high-volume mandates.  What I enjoy most is stepping into complexity and bringing clarity. I look for what’s slowing things down or creating friction, fix it quickly, and make sure we’re improving the system — not just addressing the immediate issue. While my background is in TA, my work translates across people operations, HR systems, and enablement — anywhere process and people intersect.  If you’re looking for someone who can step in, simplify, and make things run better, I’d love to connect.I am currently open to TA Lead, TA Partner, and TA Manager roles — permanent, contract, hybrid, or remote — across the GCC, India, and global markets.

basic_profile.summary: I build categories, companies, and technologies that change how businesses operate.I began my career answering phones in telecom. Today, I’m an inventor with more than two dozen patents and patent applications across my career, an award-winning former B2B CMO, a TEDx speaker, and a founder building the operating layer that disconnected businesses have been missing.I’m the Founder and CEO of YOUnifiedAI. We eliminate the manual reconciliation required to understand revenue, cash, customers, and operations across disconnected business systems. Built for franchises, multi-location operators, and service SMBs, YOUnifiedAI connects the accounting, CRM, payroll, scheduling, payments, dispatch, and other tools businesses already use. Our normalization and governance layer resolves entities and relationships across those systems, giving operators accurate answers and automated workflows—without replacing their software or hiring analysts.Our first live franchise operation is already recovering 5–7 hours per week. basic_profile.name: Muhammad Aly
basic_profile.headline: Connecting Elite Product, AI & Engineering Talent with the World’s Top Hedge Funds, HFTs & AI Firms | Durlston Partners | Dubai
basic_profile.summary:
I've called the UAE home for the past 12 years, but my recruitment journey spans 18 years across APAC and MENA. Over that time, I've built a reputation as the go-to person for scaling digital and product teams across some of the region's most ambitious organisations. Now, I'm taking that same approach, and the same network, into hedge funds, HFTs, and AI-driven firms, where my focus is squarely on product, AI, and engineering talent.

My core focus is product, AI, and engineering talent. I work on senior and strategic appointments across product management, AI/ML engineering, software engineering, and technical leadership. Whether it's a Head of Product, a Principal ML Engineer, or a Founding CTO, I know how to find and engage the kind of people who don't just fill a role; they define it.

At Durlston Partners, we have partnered with some of the world's most sophisticated investment firms, quant shops, and AI-native businesses, as well as the fast-moving startups that are building the next generation of intelligent products. That's where I thrive: high-stakes, high-performance environments where the calibre of the hire genuinely moves the needle.

What sets me apart? My network. It's not just global; it's personal. I've had coffee, Zoom calls, or shisha with talent in every major tech and finance hub: product leaders in London, quant engineers in Singapore, AI researchers in San Francisco, and technical founders in Dubai.

To stay ahead in a shifting landscape, I'm constantly learning, experimenting with the latest AI tools, building side projects, and speaking with industry leaders about what's shaping the future of intelligent systems and the teams that build them.

When I'm not recruiting, I'm probably on a padel court, building Lego (with a collection that rivals most toy stores), collecting sneakers, or deep in conversation over shisha. If you want a competitive game of padel, or a chat about AI, product, and tech over a shisha or some good food, flick me a private message.

With all of the frustrated people scouring the cities for spots, why are there so many empty spaces that no one can use?!Pied Parker is the solution - keep the streets from being overrun with frustrated, parking-hungry people, and keep empty parking spots from being left lonely and desolate. Pied Parker connects the people anxiously searching for parking with the unused parking spots left by their owners, whether for a few hours, a day or a week. From driveway spots to assigned apartment or office spots, there is bound to be a vacant spot for each parking-craving driver. We just help them find each other. No more having to explain to your boss, friends, or clients why you are running 20 minutes late, and how have coffee conveniently spilled down the front of your shirt. No more friends chuckling at you from their apartment window as you circle the block for the third time. No more nausea from the incessant turns of the parking garage ramps.Pied Parker takes the hassle out of parking, so you can focus on the things that really matter.Simplify your commute, your vacation or your day tripNever guess where you are going to park again

past.employer_linkedin_description: Eurocrowd works on innovation finance systems and European programme environments, focusing on how these systems are designed and function in practice.Our work builds on long-term experience across EU programmes, European alternative finance, crowdfunding, startups and ecosystem development. We operate at the intersection of policy, capital, and execution.Its work has included contributions to European-level discussions around crowdfunding and digital finance, as well as the design and delivery of EU-funded programmes, acceleration initiatives, funding support structures, and market development activities involving platforms, investors, startups, and public institutions.This experience informs our current focus: understanding how funding systems function once they are put into operation—how they are adopted, where friction emerges, and what is needed to make them work in practice.Eurocrowd works with public institutions, programmes, and selected market actors on questions such as:How will this funding system function in practice?Will it be adopted by its intended users?Where are the structural risks in implementation?How do policy objectives translate into workable market structures?The scope of our work generally includes:funding system design and implementationsupport to EU programmes (Horizon, Erasmus+, etc.)alignment of policy, capital, and delivery structuresdevelopment of funding and acceleration approachesecosystem and stakeholder engagement where relevantThe focus is not on legal structuring or financial engineering, but on how systems behave once different actors, incentives, and operational realities interact.

basic_profile.summary: I am a founder and builder focused on creating the infrastructure layer for the AI economy. My mission is to create the foundations that enable organizations to adopt, integrate, and scale artificial intelligence — transforming emerging AI technologies into practical capabilities, platforms, and businesses. Through my ventures, I am building AI infrastructure and AI-first companies that enable businesses and developers to access, integrate, and scale advanced AI capabilities through unified, reliable, and scalable platforms. current.employee_description:
The Trilateral Commission is a global membership organization that for decades has brought together senior policymakers, business leaders, and representatives of media and academe to discuss and propose solutions to some of the world’s toughest problems. Founded in 1973 by David Rockefeller, the Commission has long been an important venue to incubate ideas and form relationships across sectors and geographies.

Yet with changing times and the proliferation of similar groups, the leadership of the organization – across its three pillars of North America, Europe, and Asia – has critically examined the Commission and instituted changes in order to rejuvenate the Commission and increase its impact. In particular, we have sharpened our mission and returned to our roots as a group of countries sharing common values and a commitment to the rule of law, open economies and societies, and democratic principles. We acknowledge that, today, our societies are grappling with difficult social, economic, technological, and political issues that are causing deep cleavages at home.

current.employer_linkedin_description: KROG is a universal mathematical framework that brings clarity, transparency, and determinism to any rule-based system.After 30 years of research, KROG answers four fundamental questions:🔵 K — Knowledge: What can you KNOW?🟢 R — Rights: What CAN you do?🟠 O — Obligation: What MUST you do?🟣 G — Governance: HOW are decisions made?The framework is built on deontic modal logic and validated by category theory. It provides:7 T-types (agent states) — what agents can/must/cannot do35 R-types (relationships) — mathematically exhaustive bilateral patternsModal operators — P() permissions, O() obligations, F() prohibitionsCross-domain reasoning — the same patterns work from physics to financeKROG serves as a meta-language. Domain-specific rule languages like ODRL, LegalRuleML, and OWL all map to KROG's relationship types, enabling cross-domain reasoning that wasn't possible before.The KROG Theorem: (K ∩ R ∩ O) ⊆ GKnowledge, Rights, and Obligations must operate within Governance.We work with organizations building:✓ AI agent authorization systems✓ Smart contracts with legal grounding✓ Business workflow compliance✓ Privacy and consent management✓ Game mechanics and DeFi protocolsIf ambiguity costs your organization time, money, or trust—KROG provides the mathematical foundation for rules that actually work.🌐 krogrules.com📧 hello@signatu.com

The Brussels and Lugano Conventions, with particular emphasis on the interpretation and application of Article 5, No. 3 in cases of copyright infringement in open digital networks, such as the Internet.

Legal Analysis: Examining the Brussels and Lugano Conventions, which deal with jurisdiction and the enforcement of judgments in civil and commercial matters.

Jurisdictional Issues: Focusing on Article 5, No. 3 of these conventions, which relates to jurisdiction in matters of tort, delict, or quasi-delict.
Digital Challenges: Exploring how traditional legal frameworks adapt to the unique challenges posed by digital networks and online copyright infringement.
Comparative Analysis: Comparing different interpretations and applications of the relevant legal provisions across various jurisdictions.

past.employer_linkedin_description: From the European Single Market to the global interweaving of multi-national businesses or financial firms to our increasingly international everyday lives, the world around us is steadily converging. current.employer_linkedin_description: Gamers now spend more time watching games than playing them. 8.5 hours watching. 7.4 hours playing. 200 billion hours a year, stuck behind glass.That's not a content problem. That's a format problem.Ludeo built the technology to solve it. Our GGM (Generative Gameplay-state Model) turns any gaming video, stream, or text description into an instantly playable moment in the real game. The GGM generates a game state data file - the game's art is never touched. That file loads into a dedicated cloud-hosted game build and renders in the real engine. Nothing approximated. Nothing modified. The real game, instantly.Trusted by the studios that define the industry. 50+ patent claims filed. Built by a team with decades inside Activision Blizzard, Microsoft Gaming, and Disney.Audio was for listening. Video was for watching. Ludeo is for playing.

basic_profile.summary: I started my career sleeping on concrete bricks. I got paid pennies for 15 hours of work, seven days a week. That job ended in late 2017 when GST and demonetization hit the construction industry. Then during the COVID pandemic I welcomed my daughter into this world, and started a delivery business with my wife, I built from nothing. We baked cakes, delivered groceries, and made it work for seven months. And when restrictions lifted, people went back to shops and the business disappeared overnight. Sitting with that, I asked myself one question: what would actually make me hireable? That question sent me into a rabbit hole; LinkedIn, resumes, job search outreach, and eventually I realized that an interview is also a sales conversation. A resume is also sales deck. I dove into sales systems and psychology. I became obsessed with understanding why most outreach fails and what actually moves a qualified prospect toward a conversation. I started writing resumes for people who felt stuck. I started building outbound systems for companies whose pipeline had dried up. The same problem kept showing up on both sides. Most people and most companies are not failing because of a lack of effort. They are doing the right things with no system underneath. So I built systems. Today I run The Ascension Company. On the GTM side, I have generated $50M+ in pipeline for B2B clients, expanded total addressable markets by 10x through data enrichment and outbound automation, and helped drive Sendr.ai to the number two spot on Product Hunt. On the career side, I have grown my LinkedIn audience to 75K+ followers organically, written 1,000+ resumes and reviewed thousands more improved, and coached jobseekers at every career stage, plus helped my clients land jobs at some of the largest companies in the world. If you are a founder or sales leader who wants outbound that works, DM me. Also DM me if you are a professional figuring out your next career move.

past.employee_description:
My first full-time role. A construction site. Early mornings. Cement dust. Sinusitis that made every shift a physical challenge. 6,500 rupees a month for 15 hours of work, seven days a week.

I supervised construction of commercial complexes from blueprint to build. I interpreted architectural, structural, electrical, and plumbing drawings. I ensured quality workmanship across block work, DPC, steel mesh, and concrete works. I managed contractor coordination, material inspections, and safety compliance. I maintained daily work records, material stock, and time sheets.

GST and demonetization hit the industry hard in late 2017, and I was laid off. That door closed and I started looking for a different one.

I taught science to 9th and 10th graders, maths to 6th graders, and English and Home Science to 11th graders. Around 200 students and 30 staff across a dual curriculum covering religious education and CBSE academics.

I designed lessons, administered tests, tracked student performance, and watched people grow over time.

Teaching confirmed something outbound later reinforced: clarity of communication is a skill you build, not a trait you either have or don't.

I led a school and managed a team of 25 staff. The job taught me that operational discipline is the same whether you are running a construction site or a classroom.

I increased company performance by over 20% in one year through operational improvements. Employee performance went up 15% through relationship building and clearer accountability structures. I saved 500+ administrative hours annually through better scheduling and process design, and saved two additional hours of combined employee time daily by reorganizing the office layout. I standardized all internal and client-facing documentation across branding, tone, and templates.

No job with a newborn daughter at a city in lockdown.

I started a delivery service out of necessity. My wife taught me to bake, we hand-delivered cakes and donuts across town, collaborated with local wholesalers, and built something real in seven months.

But when the restrictions were lifted, people went back to shops, and the need disappeared overnight.

Sitting with that uncertainty, I asked myself a question that changed everything: what would actually make me hireable? What is LinkedIn? Do resumes really matter?

That question led to everything that came after.

basic_profile.name: Giuseppe Mayer
basic_profile.headline: CEO (Chief Executive Officer), Talent Garden Italy | Founder & Managing Partner, Antifragile (5 exits) | Board Member | Professor of Agentic AI, IULM | AI & Digital Transformation | Author & Keynote Speaker
basic_profile.summary: I build and run companies where technology changes how business works. I started in 1999, rode the internet, cloud and mobile waves, and now spend my days on applied artificial intelligence (AI).  As CEO of Talent Garden Italy I lead campuses, advanced digital education and B2B transformation programs for corporates, with one priority: a disciplined, scalable business built for what comes next.  With Antifragile, the advisory and seed investment firm I founded in 2016, I advise boards and public institutions on AI adoption and invest in early-stage companies. Five exits so far, ten active investments.  I teach Agentic AI and Corporate Communication at IULM University in Milan. I wrote five books on digital business, the latest being Inspired by Data (EGEA, 2024). Every Sunday I publish Dottor Mayer, a newsletter on AI and business read by 7,000+ executives and professionals.  I use AI the way I tell others to. My company runs on it, my work runs on it, and what I learn ends up in class, on stage and in the newsletter.  I speak at corporate events and conferences, in Italian and English, about AI strategy, leadership and the future of work.  Specialties: Chief Executive Officer (CEO), digital transformation, artificial intelligence (AI), agentic AI, AI governance and adoption, P&L management, board member, M&A, venture capital, corporate education.

basic_profile.headline: Commercial growth & transformation architect & hands-on operator | Scales disruptor tech/mission-led organisations(B2C/B2B) after ​years of marketing/sales success growing small to large | AI-wise | Passionately curious
basic_profile.summary: A mission-focused, results-driven commercial transformer, I offer extensive global client-side/agency hands-on and management experience (B2B2C, B2C) of driving growth and exceeding OKRs for technology pioneers, impact organisations and disruptors. Inherently curious, I was an early proponent of digital technology and pioneered AI-driven, agile sales and marketing. Having launched professional versions of Adobe flagship products when digital was in its infancy, I led the team that introduced one of the 1st e-commerce systems at PhotoDisc, a start-up subsequently taken over by Getty Images because of its sales success (£1M/day in profits when I left). I then helped grow Alamy, an amateur content provider marketplace acquired in 2021 by PA Media, from £9K ARR when I joined the Board to £48M ARR four years later. Reflecting on my lifelong interest in health, I went on to help the NHS save  £ millions and improve outcomes by introducing the first interactive symptom checkers/body maps. I also initiated online patient research/monitoring when transitioning WPP agencies to digital, pioneered online wellbeing-at-work (Barclays) and launched the 1st healthy nutrition apps (British Heart Foundation). Additionally, I successfully introduced digital solutions and agile operational processes into legacy, regulated biotech and nutrition/food industries. Recently, I have focused on helping impact/disruptor tech SMEs thrive, with successes including B2C/B2B SaaS SkinVision($1B+valuation) and chronic health SaMD Wellthy Therapeutics (acquired with 10M+ reach), and MacRabur, an award-winning sustainable polymer provider whose products are now used in 30+ countries. I’ve also mentored C-level entrepreneurs through Virgin Startup/LinkedIn (selected from thousands), and start-up/scale-up hubs for the NHS and Hatch Enterprise. My commitment to mentorship extends into my spare time; I am a qualified England Athletics running coach and a Parkrun 'pacer'. I am told that I 'make things happen' and that I am an 'inspirational, energetic, empathetic leader'.  I've been lucky enough to collaborate with great people during my career, many of whom I have worked with more than once. I also thrive on team building and making a difference with others in challenging, uncertain circumstances with limited resources. I feel it is also essential to keep on learning; I achieved a distinction for a Fast-Track MBA I studied for while working full-time and have upgraded AI qualifications.

basic_profile.summary: It would be nice to say that I always dreamed of being a Technical Recruiter/Talent Acquisition Specialist(Headhunter), I have to be honest - as a kid, I was probably more interested in video games and sports!  However, as someone who's naturally empathetic and loves solving puzzles, I found myself drawn to the world of recruiting (the real story is I kind of stumbled into it) but the truth is, I couldn't be happier with where it's led me.My approach comes down to trying my best to understand the intrinsic needs of both candidates and clients.  While I specialize in the tech industry, I will never shy away from a challenge and navigating the fast-paced, ever evolving world with enthusiasm and adaptability.  Whether it's a cutting-edge startup or an established tech giant, I work tirelessly to ensure the right talent finds the right role!Here’s what I do best: *Help tech startups and global companies scale by finding top-tier talent across Engineering, AI/ML, Product, Cybersecurity, Big Data, and more.*Partner with stakeholders to solve hiring puzzles, refine recruiting strategies, and deliver measurable results through data-driven insights.*Guide hiring teams to navigate market challenges, from streamlining processes to fostering diverse, high-performing teams.*Provide candidates with an exceptional experience, supporting them through every stage of their career journey.*I’m also a people-focused leader, with 10 years of experience managing and mentoring recruitment teams. I love coaching others to achieve success and creating systems that make hiring smarter, faster, and more effective.Outside of work, you'll find me exploring nature and spending quailty time with my family, I also enjoy food, and the culinary world, both in restaurants and in my own kitchen.  I'm always up for adventure, and I once went spear-fishing in Mexico and managed to get a Jack-fish within the first hour of our excursion... it was the most sumptuous fish I've ever eaten in my life.  As a proud parent of three wonderful kids, family time is a huge priority. If you’re a founder or hiring leader looking for guidance - or a professional exploring your next big opportunity - let’s connect.  I’m here to listen to your story, offer advice, and, if I can’t help directly, point you in the right direction.

professional_network.summary: It would be nice to say that I always dreamed of being a Technical Recruiter/Talent Acquisition Specialist(Headhunter), I have to be honest - as a kid, I was probably more interested in video games and sports!  However, as someone who's naturally empathetic and loves solving puzzles, I found myself drawn to the world of recruiting (the real story is I kind of stumbled into it) but the truth is, I couldn't be happier with where it's led me.My approach comes down to trying my best to understand the intrinsic needs of both candidates and clients.  While I specialize in the tech industry, I will never shy away from a challenge and navigating the fast-paced, ever evolving world with enthusiasm and adaptability.  Whether it's a cutting-edge startup or an established tech giant, I work tirelessly to ensure the right talent finds the right role!Here’s what I do best: *Help tech startups and global companies scale by finding top-tier talent across Engineering, AI/ML, Product, Cybersecurity, Big Data, and more.*Partner with stakeholders to solve hiring puzzles, refine recruiting strategies, and deliver measurable results through data-driven insights.*Guide hiring teams to navigate market challenges, from streamlining processes to fostering diverse, high-performing teams.*Provide candidates with an exceptional experience, supporting them through every stage of their career journey.*I’m also a people-focused leader, with 10 years of experience managing and mentoring recruitment teams. I love coaching others to achieve success and creating systems that make hiring smarter, faster, and more effective.Outside of work, you'll find me exploring nature and spending quailty time with my family, I also enjoy food, and the culinary world, both in restaurants and in my own kitchen.  I'm always up for adventure, and I once went spear-fishing in Mexico and managed to get a Jack-fish within the first hour of our excursion... it was the most sumptuous fish I've ever eaten in my life.  As a proud parent of three wonderful kids, family time is a huge priority. If you’re a founder or hiring leader looking for guidance - or a professional exploring your next big opportunity - let’s connect.  I’m here to listen to your story, offer advice, and, if I can’t help directly, point you in the right direction.

basic_profile.headline: Co-Founder & CEO I Denting Brand Marketing & Sales AI Infra for $1 Million to $100 Billion Organizations I Meditations & Workouts Are NOT Optional
basic_profile.summary:
𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟭: 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐡𝐨𝐨𝐝
I suffered in my health for the first 16 years because at a deeper level, I didn’t know my self-worth and thus, I feel kids born in challenging families actually have a better chance to win in life. I wanted that chance; thus, I left home & that comfort at 16. 

𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟮 : 𝐌𝐮𝐦𝐛𝐚𝐢 𝐭𝐨 𝐌𝐢𝐚𝐦𝐢 - 𝐟𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐦𝐲 𝐯𝐨𝐢𝐜𝐞

Landing up in Mumbai was the Universe’s plan; I found ‘vada pavs’ and my voice. I was there when the legendary floods hit on July 26th 2005 & I saw the city fight- we all walked…the next walk in life though was a ‘7 sea leap’- to Miami, USA. One man-Xose Alvarez Alfonso, changed my life FOREVER- I lost my friend, my advisor, & the 2nd most beautiful spirit I know to cancer, but I committed to helping others. I went from being a sick introvert with doctors in childhood to being fit, positive, and capable- all because of that 1 man. I got more American than my peers & I experienced some of the best life has to offer in travel & philosophy. 

𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟯: 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐄𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐮𝐫 (𝐑𝐚𝐠𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐡𝐞𝐬)

I sold door to door from San Jose to San Fran in 2009 (no salaries, pure comission). Doing that in an economy like that for 1 year, I realized I can be an entrepreneur. So, I came back to India, sold for a while via cold calling, in person meetings, & online to eventually start my 1st business into food & coffee. I failed and fell right on the floor with $100 remaining & a credit card debt of $700…..I went to the beach, and I made the decision to start MotivationalDiaries.com in 2015 under depression….the rest, as they say, is history. I fought every day in circumstances on the dark side which build character, make you realize value of each & every penny, and build humility. I got there because I fought every day…

𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐰𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐧𝐞𝐜𝐭 ?

If you have a purpose & if you have had mental & emotional circumstances to overcome, I think you & I connecting is written. I know what it means to be rich from family, but poor inside; I know what it means to be poor in money, but rich in soul; and in this chapter of my life, I now understand what it means to be rich as self-made and healthy-emotionally, physically & spiritually. I still have to fight everyday with the ‘poverty’ out there to go to my next level, but I try to do that through my meditations, my workout & my work as a sales & leadership coach to CEOs & their teams which fuel positive energy in me. I am at coach@motivationaldiaries.com

basic_profile.summary: I build and scale technology businesses at the intersection of AI, cloud and go-to-market.My career has taken me across both sides of the table — from building companies as a founder to leading Cloud & AI businesses at Microsoft, working with founders, technology leaders and enterprises as they adopt and scale new technologies.At Microsoft, I built a first dedicated Digital Native business, working closely with Israel's startup and scale-up ecosystem, and later led AI go-to-market across Southeast Europe. Earlier in my career, I held roles spanning software development, presales, sales and business leadership — experience that shaped how I approach technology businesses today.I believe the best technology conversations start with the problem rather than the product: understand what the customer is trying to achieve, go deep enough technically to challenge how it should be built, and then create the commercial path that gets it into production and creates measurable value.As a founder myself, I've experienced the other side of that conversation — building products, finding product-market fit, raising capital, acquiring customers, scaling teams and making difficult decisions with imperfect information.Across those experiences, the principles I value have remained remarkably consistent: integrity, accountability, curiosity, persistence and trust. The best business relationships — and the best companies — are built for the long term.

Over the past decade, Israel, and the rest of the world have been developing a new approach concerning the position and the functions of the Director, with an emphasis on publicly-traded companies. The characterization of the last decade’s Directors is entirely different from his predecessors, as today they are faced with many new dilemmas. In addition, there is a lack of adequate training for this position, as well as the lack of preparation for shareholders' expectations from the Board of Directors in general, and from the Director in particular. Legislators, regulators and the courts aggravate the responsibility expected of directors, and the result is a culture in which class action law suits are the first remedy. The Israeli Directors’ Union was established under the initiative of Prof. Joseph Gross, Esq., who serves as Chairman of the Union. A number of entities has joined, including the Faculty of Management at Tel Aviv University, Israeli Corporate Governance Chair at Bar Ilan University, LAHAV Executive Education at Tel Aviv University, the Israeli Association of Publicly Traded Companies and SRI Global Group. The IDU was created in a manner similar to analogous organizations, which for years have been operating in the United States, England, Australia, New Zealand and other countries, and collaborating with them with the intention to create multinational companies, as well as to participate in international conferences, exchange information and more. IDU brings together directors and boards of directors of public companies, large private companies, state-owned companies, municipal companies and large institutions.

basic_profile.summary: I’m a founder and product-technology executive with 20+ years of experience building platforms, engineering organizations and operational systems. At Rappi, I led global product organizations spanning catalog, integrations, partner operations and data infrastructure, supporting a billion-dollar marketplace and pipelines processing more than 5 billion events per day. Earlier, I built and scaled B2B logistics and communications and automation products across CPaaS, AI and enterprise integrations.      I’m now building an AI-native infrastructure company focused on how organizations understand context, make decisions and execute work. The thesis is that fragmented information has become one of the main constraints on organizational performance. Critical context is distributed across systems, conversations, documents and people, forcing teams to repeatedly reconstruct what is happening before they can act. Existing tools store information or automate isolated tasks. The next generation of software will do more: maintain a living model of the organization, identify what matters, preserve decision context and coordinate execution across systems — with governance and human control. I work at the intersection of product strategy, systems architecture and real-world deployment. My focus is converting complex, ambiguous workflows into repeatable product capabilities through AI agents, data infrastructure, integrations and governed automation. Areas I care deeply about:AI-native systems · Organizational intelligence · Agent infrastructure · Product and data platforms · Enterprise software · Information architecture · Forward-deployed engineering Based in São Paulo and building globally.

basic_profile.name: Vasudev Lal
basic_profile.headline: Engineer | Scientist | Founder
basic_profile.summary: Hi there! I am the founder of a startup currently in stealth. My background spans AI research, large-scale AI systems and semiconductor technology.Previously, I was a Director of Applied Science at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), where I led the Multimodal GenAI and GPU training infrastructure team. Before Oracle, I led multimodal AI research at Intel Labs, working on vision-language models, generative models and interpretability. At Intel, I applied machine learning to semiconductor process modeling and computational lithography, with methods deployed in production on leading process technology nodes.My current interests center on Agentic AI—how AI systems can reason, plan and act over longer horizons, learn from interaction and feedback—including from formal verification tools—, and collaborate with people and other agents. I am interested in both advancing the capabilities of the models themselves and designing the systems around them: how agents maintain context and memory, use tools, adapt to changing environments, and recognize when to seek human input. A central question for me is how we evaluate these capabilities and translate them into reliable performance on real-world tasks.I enjoy working across research and engineering to turn these ideas into systems that solve real problems.I obtained my PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering from the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor.Thoughts and opinions are my own.

basic_profile.summary: Tyrin Ford is the GTM Sales Leader, SASE at Palo Alto Networks (NASDAQ: PANW). In this role, he leads a team of Strategic Sales Specialist (Hunters) focused on driving growth sales across North America. With a strong emphasis on net new logo penetration, Tyrin has fostered a high-performance culture centered around Pipeline Generation (PG) while successfully implementing MEDDPICC, Force Management, and Value Selling frameworks to accelerate year-over-year growth. His Player/Coach mentality is the driving force behind his teams’ success, inspiring energy, execution, and excellence.Throughout his career in Corporate America, Tyrin has helped global brands accelerate digital transformation strategies, safeguard Generative AI tools to enhance productivity and agility, and ensure regulatory compliance with cloud-native security solutions. He has a proven track record in cybersecurity with domain expertise in cloud computing and has worked on strategic technology initiatives for some of the world’s top Forbes Global 2000 (G2K) accounts.Beyond his professional achievements, service is in Tyrin’s DNA. He is an active member of Palo Alto Networks’ Employee Network Group (ENG), Ujima, and serves on the Advisory Board for the Los Angeles Urban League. He is also a dedicated mentor for the Big Brother Big Sister Program of Greater Los Angeles. Passionate about giving back, Tyrin volunteers with the Lupus Research Alliance and co-founded the Survive 2 Thrive Foundation with his wife, Marketa Ford, to provide resources for Lupus awareness, research, education, and advocacy.Tyrin holds a Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration from the University of Missouri-Saint Louis, with a concentration in Marketing and Organizational Behavior. He is a proud member of the UMSL Alumni Association and has completed advanced training through MEDDIC Academy, Value Selling, Sandler Training, Force Management, and Scotwork Negotiation Sales Methodology programs.

basic_profile.name: Dr. Kieran Arasaratnam
basic_profile.headline: | AI Advisor | Professor of Practice | 18yrs in Trading Floor | Macro Trading | Investment Banking | Finance Expert | Blockchain | Social Impact |
basic_profile.summary:
With over 18 years of experience in the banking sector, Kieran Arasaratnam is a Professor of Practice and co-director of Gandhi Center for Inclusive Innovation at Imperial College Business School in London. He is an expert in financial innovation, risk management, and emerging markets, having worked for Barclays Capital, Morgan Stanley, and HSBC across Europe, US, and Asia. He has led and contributed to various initiatives that have transformed the finance industry, such as blockchain, data science, and AI.

Kieran leverages his knowledge of finance and technology to build a global network that affects positive social change, especially in the areas of education, healthcare, energy, and economic development. He works with international partners, government policies, and local communities to address the root causes of global inequality and poverty. He is passionate about harnessing innovation, public policy, and social science to create solutions that improve the lives of millions of people around the world.

AIDA Lab is a groundbreaking initiative fostering collaboration between academia and industry in the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and related fields to modern finance and investment strategies. We bridge the gap by creating a vibrant research environment where leading academics and industry experts work together to develop and implement cutting-edge solutions for real-world challenges.

The AIDA-Health Lab is a revolutionary initiative that unites academic experts and industry leaders to advance the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and associated technologies in healthcare and medical fields. Our mission is to cultivate a collaborative research space where top scholars and industry professionals come together to develop and implement innovative solutions, creating practical applications to address the pressing issues in modern healthcare.

Module Aim

Empower students with an understanding of blockchain / distributed ledger technology from first principles, opportunities and challenges that this innovation presents. Learning Outcomes

At the end of this course, students will gain an understanding of:

The core value proposition of blockchain technology; how its etymology drives the new zeitgeist
The canonical technology (Bitcoin& Ethereum), their challenges along with current thinking about how to overcome them
How to raise capital from and value the token-based economy
Impact of blockchain on enterprise business models
Strategy to utilise Blockchain models to reinvent business processes, reduce transactional friction and create new markets
The constantly evolving legal and regulatory challenges Blockchain technology presents.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Taos Ski Valley, Inc. was founded in 1954 by Ernie and Rhoda Blake. Historically a family owned and operated ski resort, TSV was recently acquired by a private company with deep TSV enthusiast roots. With a sincere commitment to celebrate TSV’s singular offering, the new entity is investing substantially in the mountain and base village revitalization; the resort’s systems; infrastructure; and real estate offering to significantly improve the guest experience, increase annual visits and reclaim TSV’s position as one of the world’s top mountain destinations.It is located in the Sangre de Cristo range of the southern Rocky Mountains in Northern New Mexico.  Taos combines the feel of the European Alps with the charm and beauty of the Southwest.  Its world-renowned terrain, amazing food, friendly people, beautiful weather, and breathtaking scenery  has kept guests coming back for over 50 years. Taos offers a little something for everyone with 1,300 acres of skiable terrain for all ability levels; small crowds and nonexistent lift lines make it easy to explore the entire mountain at any pace.Taos Pueblo and the historic town of Taos sit just 20 miles away.  Taos Pueblo is the only living Native American community designated both as World Heritage Site by UNESCO and a National Historic Landmark. current.employer_linkedin_description: La Universidad de San Andrés se propone constituir una comunidad académica de profesores, estudiantes y egresados empeñados en la búsqueda de la verdad y en contribuir al progreso de la Argentina y al bienestar de sus habitantes. En un marco de adhesión a los valores sociales y morales legados por sus fundadores se empeña en transmitir conocimiento establecido, crear nuevo conocimiento, promover la educación en general y fortalecer las instituciones. Tiene como objetivo poner la educación que brinda a disposición de todas las personas con aptitudes intelectuales, vocación de servicio y dedicación al estudio, más allá de sus recursos económicos. Valores sociales y morales de la institución Los valores de los fundadores de la Escuela Escocesa San Andrés, establecida en 1838, y de la Universidad San Andrés, en 1989, están sustentados en la herencia presbiteriana basada en las Sagradas Escrituras. En ese marco, la Universidad de San Andrés promueve el debate orientado a la libre y honesta búsqueda de la verdad, sin intenciones proselitistas. No tiene propósitos religiosos: considera que la dimensión religiosa es parte integral de la cultura humana y merecedora, como todos los aspectos de esa cultura, de investigación y discusión. Aspira a que sus integrantes asuman un liderazgo al servicio de la comunidad y del país, que se caractericen por tener una mente abierta e inquisidora, que sean solidarios con todos los miembros de la sociedad, y que exhiban integridad moral, espíritu conciliatorio y respeto por la diversidad.

basic_profile.name: Angelique Schouten
basic_profile.headline: Founder & CEO, AI-Fan, Tech-optimist, NED, Author (Monkey Money Mind, The WealthTECH Book, Rising AI Tech Demystified)
basic_profile.summary:
What drives someone who grew up overcoming hurdles to spend her life building?

For me, it started with curiosity. I wanted to understand how things worked: systems, people, products, and once I did, I fell in love with building them. Today, I’m a tech founder, operator, and creative problem-solver who turns complex ideas into products that actually work and companies that scale fast, even when resources are limited.

Build where others hesitate. 
Execute when others debate. 
Use constraints as fuel for creativity.

I helped build the world’s first cloud-native core banking platform (Ohpen --> $100B+ AuA), launched a contract management tool (6 months --> 112 countries, 6000 B2B customers), and scaled companies across fintech, low-code, SaaS, crypto, and now AI, and today I run 10x - where we bring human judgment and AI together to change how companies hire and operate.

Execution is my edge. Creativity is the engine behind it.

I didn’t grow up in tech. I was a tall, shy, dyslexic kid in a small Dutch village who loved metal music, being outside, and building things with my hands. My mother was the entrepreneur in the family. My father vanished to a country without an extradition treaty, taking all her money with him.

So I learned early: if you want something, you take charge and do it yourself.

At 11, I was planting leeks to make ends meet. 
In my twenties, I graduated with over $115K in student debt.

Working hard wasn’t optional. It was a must have.

And somewhere in that chaos, I discovered that people who’ve been through something, the outliers, often bring the most creativity, grit, and originality. 

I’ve always felt part of that tribe.

People sometimes call me a rebel in disguise. Maybe because I question everything. Maybe because I move fast. Or maybe because life taught me to rely on execution, not entitlement. I’m drawn to unusual thinkers; the ones who refuse to fit into boxes and build their own instead.

My personal motto has never changed: Life is not about fitting in, it’s about standing out.

What I believe
- Creativity is a super power - especially when budgets are thin. 
- Execution beats theory and ego every time. 
- Outliers bring the breakthroughs. 
- Tech only matters if it improves real lives. 
- You build the conditions you want, you don’t wait for them. 
- Culture is shaped by what you do, not what you say. 
- Standing out is earned.

If you’re building, scaling, or rewriting the rules, DM me. I like working with people who carry a little fire… and use it well.

p.s. Looking for a read: Check out Monkey Money Mind ;-)

basic_profile.name: Rajat Gupta
basic_profile.headline: Building the Trust Layer for AI-Driven Commerce
basic_profile.summary:
Founder and operator with 22+ years building and scaling consumer and commerce platforms across internet, mobile, and now AI cycles.

I’ve owned product, growth, and technology with full P&L accountability - operating systems serving 100M+ MAUs, scaling businesses to multi-million dollar revenues, and managing multi-geo marketing budgets at scale. I’ve raised $20M+ in venture capital, built 200+ member teams, and wound down responsibly - returning ~50% of capital to shareholders.

Across cycles, I’ve seen a consistent pattern: growth compounds only when incentives, governance, and infrastructure are aligned. When they aren’t, scale amplifies fragility.

AI-mediated commerce is the next structural shift. I’m building the trust and verification infrastructure required for agent-driven buying decisions to work reliably at scale.

Outside work, endurance training reinforced the same principle: long-horizon systems outperform short - term intensity.
