basic_profile.name: Anthony G.
basic_profile.headline: Founder at Stealth AI Startup
basic_profile.summary: I’ve never been particularly good at accepting things the way they are.Especially when someone tells me that’s just how it’s done.I began in law and finance.But I was always more interested in building things than administering them.So I became an entrepreneur.I founded a healthcare technology company called VoyagerMed. It was eventually acquired. I helped build the commercial side of software businesses like Decile and Scoro. I worked with companies pioneering new applications of artificial intelligence.Some things worked. Others taught me more.And I like doing the work myself.Which brings me to artificial intelligence.I’ve never seen anything quite like it.For most of my career, building a company meant assembling people, raising capital, and creating an organization large enough to execute an idea. Today, much of that machinery can be replaced by software. Not ordinary software that waits for instructions, but intelligent agents that can reason, make decisions, and carry out work.That changes everything.I’m now building an AI company operating in stealth.The idea is simple.A small business should have access to the same intelligence, capabilities, and resources as a large corporation. Not by hiring more people, but by giving the people already there an intelligent workforce of their own.Imagine an AI chief of staff that knows your business as well as you do. Behind it, a team of specialized agents that understand your customers, manage operations, find opportunities, solve problems, and get things done.Not another chatbot. Not another dashboard.Something that actually works for you.I believe we’re approaching a time when the size of a company will have very little to do with what it can accomplish.That’s the future I’m building toward.I also am a fractional CEO and lead go-to-market at HedgeNova, an AI-native investment technology company. And I spend time teaching people in my community how to use AI through a program I call Holy Cow! AI Can Do That!I particularly enjoy that last part.There’s something wonderful about watching an intelligent person discover that a thing they thought was impossible yesterday is suddenly within their reach.I still practice law. I still think like a financier. But increasingly, I build like an engineer.Please reach out to me here or by email for my full CV. Due to ai, spammy sales practices and bots, I no longer publish my full bio here. Ironically it has led to more connections with deeper value and greater understanding of my professional network.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Indian Institute of Technology Madras is one among the foremost institutes of national importance in higher technological education, basic and applied research. A faculty of international repute, a brilliant student community, excellent technical & supporting staff and an effective administration have all contributed to the pre-eminent status of IIT Madras. The campus is located in the city of Chennai, previously known as Madras. Chennai is the state capital of Tamilnadu, a southern state in India.

Huml Health helps substance use disorder treatment teams understand what happens across the full continuum of care, from admission and active treatment to the time between appointments and after discharge.Stress, craving and destabilization can show up in the body and behavior through changes in sleep, heart-rate patterns, activity, autonomic arousal and voice. Huml analyzes meaningful changes from each patient’s personal baseline and combines them with validated assessments, helping care teams recognize when a clinical check-in may be warranted.During treatment, Huml creates a longitudinal audit trail of objective data. This strengthens clinical documentation and gives utilization-review teams additional evidence to demonstrate medical necessity. It helps payers understand why continued care may be warranted and supports the clinically appropriate length of stay for each patient.After discharge, Huml provides ongoing passive monitoring through wearable data, supplemented by scheduled assessments and check-ins. Patients can remain connected to their recovery community without having to continually initiate contact or explain when something has changed. Alumni coordinators gain a clearer view of who may warrant outreach, allowing them to prioritize their time based on meaningful changes rather than relying solely on fixed call schedules or waiting for a crisis.Rather than giving teams another stream of raw data to monitor, Huml translates these signals into clear, actionable insights that fit into existing clinical workflows.We’re not building another wearable, and we’re not diagnosing from the wrist. We’re helping care teams see more of the recovery journey while keeping clinical judgment and human connection at the center of care.One hour seen. 167 unseen.Wearable insights built for addiction recovery.Learn more at https://huml.health.

basic_profile.name: Keith McCrae
basic_profile.headline: Helping Finance Leaders build elite teams | Building Avexa (AI Career Vault) | Ex-Football Scout | I find the grit others miss.
basic_profile.summary:
I work with senior finance leaders and businesses at moments where judgment matters more than volume.

I’m the founder of Breakout International Recruitment, a specialist firm focused on senior finance hires across international markets. My work sits at the intersection of leadership, narrative, and decision-making, helping organisations make fewer, better hires, and helping finance leaders position themselves clearly in a noisy market.

What differentiates my approach is restraint. I don’t chase mandates, flood shortlists, or sell roles that aren’t real. I spend time understanding where a business is genuinely stuck, what kind of finance leadership it actually needs, and where a candidate’s experience will translate, not just impress on paper.

A large part of my work today involves helping senior finance leaders make sense of their own story - not to polish it, but to make it accurate, usable, and defensible. That work has increasingly pulled me into the overlap between recruitment, career strategy, and AI-led tooling, where I’m currently building new infrastructure focused on signal, not noise.

I tend to work best with:

--> Founders, boards  and leadership teams who value clarity over speed

--> Finance leaders navigating transition, complexity, or misalignment

--> Situations where fewer conversations, handled properly, lead to better outcomes

If you’re facing a hiring or career decision where the stakes feel high and the usual approaches aren’t quite landing, a short, direct conversation is often the best place to start.

I moved into cybersecurity consulting, leading GTM and sales efforts, building pipelines, and bringing structure to founder-led sales.Across these experiences, I noticed a recurring problem: complex enterprise deals involve multiple teams, but the context needed to execute them is fragmented across documents, people, and systems. Teams repeatedly search for information, recreate responses, and rely on the same subject-matter experts. Deal context and lessons learned are often lost between pursuits.That led me to co-found Anseru AI.We start with RFPs and security questionnaires - the earliest structured statements of what a buyer needs, how a vendor will be evaluated, and what must be proven. Sales, pre-sales, security, legal, finance, and AI agents work from the same deal context to assess fit and risks, coordinate workflows and decisions, and learn from outcomes. Each pursuit feeds intelligence back into the system, helping teams make better decisions and execute the next deal more intelligently.Outside work, I enjoy adventure sports, backpacking, basketball, and exploring cultures through global Latin dance communities.

current.employee_description:
We are building an AI-native deal intelligence infrastructure layer for modern sales teams. Today, enterprise deal execution breaks down due to fragmented knowledge, missing context, and cross-team misalignment.

Deal context is scattered across multiple tools with no single source of truth. Teams operate in silos, leading to repeated back-and-forth, inconsistent responses, and no clear system to evaluate or progress deals. Most importantly, there’s no memory. Responses are rewritten every time, with no learning from past deals.

The result: slower deal cycles, lower win rates, and significant manual effort.

We’re building a multimodal, multi agentic product that brings structure to this. AI agents bring together context across past deals, internal knowledge, and buyer requirements - generating context aware - accurate, defensible responses and improving deal velocity, with humans in the loop.

We’re starting with RFPs and Security Questionnaires as our wedge.

Currently in stealth, running 3 paid pilots with mid-market teams selling to enterprises and regulated markets.

current.employee_description:
In 2020, at the peak of uncertainty, I founded Paisaking as my first entrepreneurial venture. What started as a freelance hustle quickly turned into a proprietorship company, where I handled everything — client acquisition, campaign execution, and growth delivery.

It was more than just a business — it was my training ground in entrepreneurship. Paisaking taught me:

1. How to survive in a competitive market with limited resources.
2. The importance of resilience when things don’t go as planned.
3. That building something from scratch requires both courage and patience.

After 3 years of growth, challenges, and learning, Paisaking became the foundation for Nextagmedia, my 360° performance marketing agency. The journey wasn’t easy, but it gave me the confidence and clarity to scale into something much bigger.

basic_profile.name: Bill L. Brown
basic_profile.headline: Revenue Operator | Co-Founder & CRO @ AxiomStudio.ai | Sales • Strategic Partnerships • Ecosystems • AI | Startups to Fortune 100
basic_profile.summary: Revenue doesn't have a department. It has an organization. I've spent my career building, fixing, and scaling revenue across startups, global technology companies, Tier 1 enterprise accounts, and complex partner ecosystems, working across three interconnected levers: direct enterprise revenue, revenue leadership, and strategic partnerships and ecosystems. The hardest growth problems rarely belong to one function. They sit between them. Sales and Customer Success. Product and market. Company and customer. Technology and services. Direct and partner motions. Strategy and execution. Across five exits and Fortune 100 companies, I've built and led GTM organizations, accelerated high-growth businesses, transformed underperforming revenue motions, and architected Tier 1, Tier 2, and multi-tier partner ecosystems across technology companies, GSIs, cloud providers, distributors, services partners, and enterprise customers. Whether scaling what works, turning around what doesn't, unlocking what's stalled, opening new markets, or building what's missing, the outcomes include 5× revenue growth, $538M+ in ecosystem revenue, teams reaching 208% of quota, and predictable 7- and 8-figure enterprise deals. Where I can create meaningful impact quickly: A $20M company ready to become a $100M company.A stalled business that needs to restart growth.A hypergrowth company ready to capitalize on momentum.A Fortune 100 organization unlocking a new revenue motion.A startup building its commercial system from scratch. But the numbers reinforce a bigger lesson: Revenue is an organizational outcome produced by an interconnected system. When growth stalls, the problem may show up in Sales while originating somewhere else entirely: customer value, qualification, partner economics, executive alignment, time-to-value, or organizational friction. That's the work that interests me most: understanding the complete commercial system, identifying where the next level of growth can come from, and building the architecture, alignment, partnerships, and operating discipline to create it. Build the system. Align the organization. Create the conditions that allow complex revenue to move.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Parliament is the supreme democratic institution that represents the citizens through an elected body of Members of Parliament (MPs).The Plenum consists of all MPs elected in the same general election. General elections are normally held every four years unless Parliament is dissolved earlier. The interval between two elections is a ‘parliamentary term’. Consecutive parliamentary terms have been numbered in sequence since 1974.The Parliament holds regular Sessions during a parliamentary term while the Constitution of Greece provides for extraordinary and special Sessions as well.The Plenum convenes in regular Session every year on the first Monday of October. The duration of a regular Session cannot be less than five months. Within 30 days from the date of the general elections, the Plenum must be convened in regular Session.The Plenum is mainly responsible for the legislative and the parliamentary control functions. When Parliament is in recess, between two Sessions, part of the legislative and parliamentary control business is exercised by the compositions of the Recess Section.There are three consecutive compositions of the Recess Section each year during the summer recess, each consisting of a third of the total number of MPs.In the Recess Section participate one third 1/3 of the total number of MPs. The composition of the Recess Section changes periodically in order to ensure equal participation of all MPs.

basic_profile.summary: Olga Vox works to align technology, capital, and human potential.A 3x founder and economist, she brings 10+ years of experience in venture strategy, technology growth, and cross-border capital formation across AI, blockchain, and FinTech.She has helped 30+ technology companies grow across the US, Europe, and MENA, supporting $500M+ in fundraising and helping multiple ventures reach billion-dollar valuations. Her work connects founders with investors and aligns investment narratives, strategic partnerships, and market strategy.Through Vox Ventures, her role as a Deal Partner at Boardy VC, and mentorship at Plug and Play, Olga supports founders with company building, fundraising, and growth. Having lived in 7 countries, she brings an international perspective and relationships spanning entrepreneurs, family offices, venture funds, and institutional capital.Today, she is applying that experience to how companies, capital, and communities organize as AI reshapes the economy. Her focus is Web4: the convergence of AI agents, decentralized infrastructure, and new economic systems. She is developing economic and governance models that expand human agency, distribute opportunity, and preserve people’s ability to create, collaborate, and choose.Her work combines research, founder development, cross-disciplinary communities, and experiments in ownership, coordination, and investment. It extends her experience growing technology ventures to the institutions and incentives that determine what gets built, who owns it, and whom it serves.Olga collaborates with founders, researchers, funders, and institution builders to turn these ideas into companies and systems that support long-term human flourishing.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Mission Space is redefining how industries understand and respond to space weather.We are building a dedicated orbital constellation equipped with proprietary sensors designed to measure radiation, plasma, and geomagnetic activity with high precision. Our multi-point, real-time data streams feed into an advanced forecasting model, delivering actionable insights with 200% greater accuracy compared to current industry standards.Our proprietary sensors measure proton flux, electron flux, alpha particles, plasma densities, and magnetic field variations. The first generation of ZOHAR-I payloads is already operational, with spectrometers and Cherenkov detectors providing particle energy measurements across key energy ranges.We are expanding rapidly, deploying additional payloads, including Surface Charge Monitors, X-ray and Gamma-ray Spectrometers, and Plasma Probes, to build the first mid-Earth orbit constellation focused solely on space weather.Mission Space serves four key verticals:•Satellite operators and space traffic management: improving orbital calculations and neutral density modeling•Airlines: safeguarding polar flights from VHF disruptions and radiation risks•Power grid operators: offering localized forecasting for critical infrastructure and regulatory compliance•Frontier technologies: supporting lunar surface missions and next-generation supersonic aviation

current.employer_linkedin_description: Your most valuable AI projects need the data you are least able to share.Nakato is a private layer between that data and the AI models you want to use. It runs inside your environment. Before a request reaches a model, every sensitive detail is swapped for a contextually faithful twin: a stand-in that carries the same meaning without the same risk. The model gets the full picture. Nakato reverses the swap before the answer hits the screen.We call this Reversible Semantic Pseudonymisation, or RSP. The context stays useful. The real data never moves.That means the workflows made impractical by redaction or masking can now go live. Your teams get the accuracy the task needs, and every substitution is auditable.We work with the engineers building these systems and the business owners who need them in production.Tell us about the workflow you have on hold.
current.employee_description: Enabling AI adoption at scale by keeping sensitive data safe, without compromising performance.

basic_profile.name: Sheng Z.
basic_profile.headline: Co-founder and CEO at Stealth AI Startup
basic_profile.summary: At Amazon AGI, I led the research and development of cutting-edge large language and multimodal models that power the next generation of AI capabilities. I’m driven by a vision to reduce the cost of intelligence across the stack, making AI more accessible and beneficial to more people. My work focuses on the thoughtful co-evolution of algorithms and systems—the critical intersection that will advance us toward more capable, efficient, and responsible AI.Building from scratch energizes me. I built the M* team from zero, focusing initially on distributed training and shared representations. Since 2018, this team of tech leaders and hackers developed foundation models that now serve millions through AWS services including Amazon Nova, Amazon Q (CodeWhisperer), Titan, Lex, Comprehend, and Kendra. We contributed to the core technology for scalable and fault resilient infrastructure such as Amazon Bedrock and SageMake HyperPod.Throughout this journey, I’ve maintained a core belief: AI should amplify human agency and ingenuity, not replace it. This principle guides my approach to both research and leadership. My leadership philosophy centers on coaching and enabling team members to grow into leaders themselves, creating a multiplier effect that has accelerated our innovation.I'm an advocate for open source and open collaboration. I have been playing active roles in the open source ecosystem as VP/PMC Chair of Apache MXNet (where I co-authored the Gluon interface), founder of GluonNLP (first to reproduce BERT with record-setting training speeds), member of the Linux AI Foundation’s ONNX Steering Committee, and founding member of the Python Data API Standards Consortium. These roles reflect my belief that accessible tools and standards are essential for an AI future that benefits humanity broadly.I’m now looking to apply this unique combination of foundation model expertise, team building experience, and human-centered vision to lead technical strategy at organizations pushing the boundaries of AGI development—creating intelligence that empowers rather than replaces human potential.All views expressed here are mine and do not represent Amazon.

The ultimate benefit of cloud computing, and AWS, is the ability to leverage a new business model and turn capital infrastructure expenses into variable costs. Businesses no longer need to plan and procure servers and other IT resources weeks or months in advance. Using AWS, businesses can take advantage of Amazon's expertise and economies of scale to access resources when their business needs them, delivering results faster and at a lower cost.Today, Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. Benefitbay is the chosen platform for brokers, employers, and employees that supports secure SOC II Type II end-to-end ICHRA deployment for companies of all sizes.  First available in January of 2020, ICHRA (pronounced ICK-RA), stands for Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangement. With ICHRA, employers can provide an allowance of tax free dollars to their employees who then use those dollars to shop for a health plan that meets their own specific needs. No more one-size-fits-all group package.  Employers can provide wonderful health plans for their team, individually tailored to each person’s needs, with a fixed, predictable cost.  Experts anticipate a seismic shift in the benefits industry from group to individual as ICHRA plans will become a critical company feature when recruiting top talent.  The best candidates will expect the freedom and portability that ICHRA allows. They will expect to be able to change jobs without having to change doctors. And benefitbay is touted as the solution that will finally set this shift in motion by solving the inefficiencies that have slowed ICHRA adoption thus far.Benefitbay is the first-of its-kind, end-to-end solution that enables employers to easily model, deploy and oversee their ICHRA plans, in full compliance with regulation and with full confidence that their employees will have tools and support to select and enroll in the plan that’s right for them.

Mertz Library collection to the plant and fungal specimens in the William and Lynda Steere Herbarium, the largest such collection in the Western Hemisphere.At NYBG, we’re plant people—dedicated horticulturists, enthusiastic educators, and scientific adventurers—committed to helping nature thrive so that humanity can thrive. We believe in our ability to make things better, teaching tens of thousands of kids and families each year about the importance of safeguarding our environment and healthy eating. Our expert scientists work across the city, the nation, and the globe to document the plants and fungi of our world—and find actionable, nature-based solutions to our planet’s dual climate and biodiversity crises. And our eyes are always looking forward as we train the next generation of botanists, gardeners, landscape designers, and environmental stewards, ensuring a green future for all. At NYBG, we know that it’s nature—or nowhere.

past.employee_description:
Relying on herbal remedies, traditional medicine or cultural health practices rather than following the guidance of medical providers can have important implications for health care delivery and outcomes. 

To address health disparities and support cross-cultural understanding, cultural humility and effective patient-provider communication regarding the use of botanical therapies by Latinx and Caribbean immigrant communities in NYC, scientists at The New York Botanical Garden developed a cultural competency training program for health care providers that aims to bridge the communication gap between physicians and patients about the use of botanical therapies to improve the quality of care for underserved populations.

Curricular materials and workshops for physicians and medical students were developed based on on-going ethnobotanical and ethnomedical research in NYC since 2001. Trainings were provided in collaboration with medical schools, hospitals, community clinics and health centers serving Spanish-speaking immigrant patients and the Caribbean and Latinx communities.

Since its inception, hundreds of medical students and practicing physicians have been trained through this program which includes lectures, interactive workshops, guided visits to botánicas (shops that sell medicinal plants) and tours of Caribbean medicinal plant collections in the The New York Botanical Garden’s Enid A. Haupt Conservatory.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The CHILDLINE service, developed and managed by CHILDLINE India Foundation (CIF), is a free 24x7 emergency phone outreach service. Children or concerned adults dial the number 1098, from any phone services in India, and are connected to the CHILDLINE service in their city. CHILDLINE is India’s national-level response to the ratification of the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child (CRC). CHILDLINE teams physically reach children within approx. an hour of the call, provide SOS attention and link children in need of care and protection to organizations run by government departments as well as those run by civil society agencies.Children and youth living alone on urban streets, child labour – especially in the unorganized sector, child abuse, children being victims of the flesh trade, ill treatment of differently-abled children, addiction in children, children in conflict with the law, children in institutions, mental illness in children, HIV/AIDS or other long term diseases in children, children affected by conflicts and disasters or being political refugees, children’s families in crises, female foeticide, undernourishment, illiteracy, trafficking – are among the host of issues plaguing children in India and also represents the range of cases handled by CHILDLINE. Each kind of case requires its own unique protocol to be followed. CHILDLINE works closely with Allied systems- Police, Education and Health departments, Railways and Judiciary in order to resolve cases.Initiated in 1996, CHILDLINE currently operates in 543+ districts and 117+ railway stations, through its unique social-franchise network of over 980+ partner organizations across India, and services over 8-10 million calls and 300,000 interventions a year.

The institute facilitates interdisciplinary research and a seamless flow of knowledge. Several world-renowned centres of excellence are part of IIITH’s research portfolio. It has established various joint collaboration and co-innovation models with an industry outreach spanning significant national and multinational companies. Its innovative curriculum allows students the flexibility of selecting their courses and projects. Apart from academics the institute provides students with a comprehensive environment that promotes art and culture, sports, societal contributions and self-governance. Even undergraduate students get to participate in ongoing research and technology development - an opportunity unprecedented in India. As a result, a vibrant undergraduate programme co-exists along with a strong postgraduate programme.

current.employer_linkedin_description: The Indian Society of Artificial Intelligence and Law (ISAIL.IN) is an artificial intelligence industry forum, founded by Abhivardhan in 2018. Our mission as an independent, not-for-profit industry forum for the analytics & AI industry in India is to promote responsible development of artificial intelligence and its standardisation in India.Enforcing AI standards in the Indian and Indo-Pacific markets is hard. And yet, ISAIL.IN intends to document data and inputs associated with the market tendencies around three facets of artificial intelligence: its adoption, research around it, and its real-life policy implications across as many sectors as possible.This is why, the AiStandard.io Alliance, administered by ISAIL.IN, intends to establish an allies of AI entities in India, Asia and the Global South, to develop market-friendly AI standards, with sector-specific, and sector-neutral contexts.

basic_profile.summary:
Founder, AI Stealth

Formerly, as CIO and and CISO for AMERICAN SYSTEMS, Mr. Neely leads the overall vision, planning, and management of all technology, security and information management-related resources throughout the enterprise.  Mr. Neely began his career at AMERICAN SYSTEMS in 1996, and has been instrumental in the company’s strategic and operational growth, growth… supporting thousands of users distributed at hundreds of locations globally. 

With over twenty years of hands-on experience and a background of intense formal education, Mr. Neely effectively fuses the business and the technology worlds. Mr. Neely’s acute business sense comes from a decade as a “C" level executive in a progressive technology organization, building on the knowledge and insight gained as an alumnus of the Wharton School of Business (University of Pennsylvania) and through executive certifications in Management & Leadership and Strategy & Innovation earned at MIT’s Sloan School of Management. 

On the technical side, Mr. Neely has an engineering background and 20 years of real-world technology experience, building on his Bachelor of Science in Engineering from Virginia Tech, his Masters in Information Technology from Carnegie Mellon’s nationally top-ranked IT Program (graduating summa cum laude), his CIO Certification from CMU and the Federal CIO Council, and his Chief Information Security Officer (CISO/CSO) Certification from Carnegie Mellon’s Cyber Security Lab (Cylab).

Mr. Neely was selected as an InformationWeek 500 winner for Digital Business Leaders & Innovative Users of Technology – coming in at #120, ahead of Microsoft #142, Cisco #152, EMC #161, SAIC #164, SAP #182, and MITRE #212.

CISO of the Year; Selected as one of ExecutiveBiz’s Top 10 CTOs; certified in Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, & CMMI; ISO 9001 and 27001 certs; Fellow of the Wharton School of Business, member of ND-ISAC, DIB-CS, IEEE and TED.

past.employee_description: I worked with Prof Gregory Laughlin on a brown dwarf search which led to the Intel STS Paper Discovery of 16 Nearby Brown Dwarf Candidates in WISE Preliminary Release Data. We reported a discovery of sixteen nearby brown dwarf candidates and seven temperature-speciﬁc (∼200 K ∼ 500 K) populations (∼102 sources) in the WISE Preliminary Release Data. Four of the candidates were between 285 K and 400 K, temperatures akin to that of Earth. Eleven of the candidates were identiﬁed by querying WISE with magnitudes based on a pure blackbody spectrum assumption; the remaining ﬁve resulted from Monte Carlo variant queries generated through application of randomization factors of 50% and 20% to the blackbody magnitudes of the low (∼ 2.8 - ∼5.4µm) and high (7 - 28 µm) wavelength WISE band passes, respectively. The correlation between the spectra of nine of the blackbody candidates and the temperature-equivalent blackbody spectra was within 1%. The respective concurrence of the remaining two was within 15%. The Monte Carlo queries also identiﬁed local interstellar brown dwarf populations (∼ 102 sources) for 7 evenly incremented temperatures between 200 K and 500 K, inclusively. The ratios of the spectra of the 7 Monte Carlo query brown dwarf population returns to band 1 ﬂux values were modeled as third-degree polynomial functions of wavelength.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Genan is one of the largest mechanical recycler of End-of-Life Tyres (ELTs) in the world.We are committed to a sustainable planet, and we believe that true recycling is best achieved through innovation, quality and transparency.Our philosophy is that sustainability is a shared responsibility, and we devote our efforts to continuously finding new and innovative ways to recycle ELTs. Each year, millions of tons of tyres are worn out; yet, although they are no longer fit for the roads, they still represent a massive resource. By shredding, granulating and milling end-of-life tyres and using the rubber granules and powders for various applications, we give tyres a second life. Recycled tyre rubber may even be used for the production of new tyres, substituting virgin material for a sustainable cradle-to-cradle recycling. This is the core of the Genan concept: reusing materials of excellent quality in an environmentally sustainable way, thereby saving resources.Compared to both incineration and civil engineering applications, recycling of ELTs is by far the most environment-friendly and sustainable solution to what would otherwise be a waste problem. The recycling process results in significantly less CO2 emission than the incineration of tyres in e.g. cement kilns: an estimated 1.1 tons less CO2 per 1 ton of tyres – indeed a substantial reduction of global warming potential (GWP). In average, a tyre consists of 75% rubber, 15% steel and 10% textile fibers. When separated through the Genan process technology, all these materials can be recycled. At Genan, sustainability is our core value, and we are constantly optimising our processes and diversifying our products – to the benefit of our customers, the environment and the global community.

 - Language Barriers across non-English speaking regions
 - Lack of Cultural Context in annotation for different markets

That's where our current phase of AI-Sense comes in place in the form of Data Collection and Annotation service provider in order to play a critical role in helping Enterprises with Quality Training data in Non-English Languages as well as Cultural Context in Labelling for their AI Models. With this, we will contribute our part to make India an AI Data Hub of The World.

Our Core Value Propositions are as Follows:  
-Specialized in Speech, Text and Video based Language Services  
-Provides End to End Solutions for Data Annotation with Real-time Monitoring and Validation of Annotations on the platform  
-Enterprise Level Security to Protect Sensitive Client Data  
-Well Trained team of Annotators with a Distributed Network

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Entrepreneurship Cell (E-Cell) is a non-profit organization run by students of IIT Bombay. We create awareness among students & professionals about Entrepreneurship through our various programs like workshops, speaker sessions, business plan competitions, and other such events. We support upcoming Entrepreneurs by providing them necessary resources such as mentors, consultancy, seed funds and networking. We conduct Asia's largest B-Model competition Eureka! with prize money of INR 26 Lakhs and incentives worth 2 crores. The last edition of Eureka! received 43,000+ entries from India and abroad. Eight tracks were formed to allow startups to compete in their own domain. Over the years, Eureka! has received huge attention from national and international media being featured in reputed newspapers like Hindustan Times, Financial Express and Indian Express. E-Summit is the annual flagship event of E-Cell IIT Bombay organized in December each year. The purpose of the summit is to bring together all the stakeholders of the entrepreneurship ecosystem. The summit has an attendance of 50,000+ people, most of them being professionals, entrepreneurs and college students. The two-day event is filled with activities like speaker sessions, on-the-spot funding competitions, networking arena, and other events to encourage the idea of starting up among the attendees. The summit has had speaker sessions from great entrepreneurs like Travis Kalanick, Kiran Majumdar Shaw, Sachin Bansal, Ritesh Agarwal, Bhavish Aggarwal, Bharat Desai, and personalities like Rajat Sharma, Nandan Nilekani, Amitabh Kant, Anurag Kashyap and Ashish Chanchalani.

Mood Indigo, popularly known as Mood-I or MI, is the annual cultural festival of the Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay. Founded in 1971 by a group of music enthusiasts with an initial budget of Rs. 5,000, it has, over a successful journey of 54 years, evolved into Asia's largest college festival. Last year's edition recorded a footfall of over 1.5 lakh attendees across 240+ events, with a reach extending to more than 4,000 colleges nationwide.What distinguishes Mood Indigo is the unwavering dedication of the student team behind it and their commitment to delivering excellence at every step. The festival has been graced by performances and appearances from eminent Indian artistes such as Asha Bhosle, Ustad Zakir Hussain, Shankar–Ehsaan–Loy, and Sonu Nigam, alongside Bollywood personalities including Deepika Padukone, Akshay Kumar, and Aamir Khan. Distinguished leaders such as Kiran Bedi and Shashi Tharoor have also addressed students and visitors at the festival.Expanding its global footprint, Mood Indigo has hosted performances by acclaimed international acts including Porcupine Tree, Simple Plan, the Neal Morse Band featuring Mike Portnoy, Karnivool and Sander Van Doorn.The festival's competitions continue to draw considerable attention, particularly through the 'Live Your Passion' initiative, which offers winners the opportunity to further develop and pursue their respective fields professionally.As a youth-driven festival, Mood Indigo remains committed to engaging young minds on pressing social issues. Through initiatives such as blood donation drives, river-cleaning campaigns, and mental health awareness drives, the festival continues to strive toward meaningful social impact.Follow our page for regular updates.For any details, reach out to:Lakshya Jain | +91 91315 48018 | lakshya@moodi.org | MarketingAkshansh Mittal | +91 99831 78721 | akshansh@moodi.org | Media and Publicity

past.employer_linkedin_description: Abhyuday, IIT Bombay is a student run organization working towards creating a sense of Social Responsibility and Leadership among the youth of India. Abhyuday was conceptualized as a movement by socially conscious students and professors of IIT Bombay in the years 2011 and 2012 in support of the ‘Anti-Corruption’ and ‘Women’s Right’ protests then going on in the country. Deriving its name from the Sanskrit word meaning ‘The Rising’, Abhyuday has established itself as India’s Largest Students Body for Social Development in the mere span of time. Taking forward IIT Bombay’s Senate mandated requirement of participating in Student Gymkhana activities of Sports, Culture and Social Service, Abhyuday serves as an avenue for students to start their journey of self-development while contributing towards the Society. Abhyuday encompasses a large spectrum of activities that aims at modelling the youth to work towards solving World’s Social Problems & our ‘Initiatives’ focus on creating a positive impact on the local communities. The ‘Social Fest’ is a two day extravaganza that celebrates the spirit of Social Good.We invite you to be a part of India’s Largest Student Run Movement for Social Good.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Student Alumni Relations Cell (SARC) is a voluntary organization run by the students of IIT Bombay committed towards the enhancement of relations between students and alumni of IIT Bombay.Throughout the year, we are the organization to turn to if any student wishes to know alumni or if alumni wish to return to the Institute for whatever purpose.Apart from that, we have launched many initiatives which have acted as a common platform for interaction and networking between students and alumni. One of these is the Alumination, usually held during the first weekend of October. It is an open platform for students to freely interact with alumni in person.Alumni-Student Mentorship Programme (ASMP) provides an avenue for students -alumni to have a fruitful relationship. Interested students are allotted alumni mentors who then provide them able guidance regarding their queries.Started in 2008, SARC also provides a priceless opportunity for direct telephonic conversations with alumni through Phonathons. In the last 10 years, SARC has connected to over 30000 alumni through these conversations. These phone calls are often vital stimulants to bring alumni back in touch with their alma mater, their home. These telephonic conversations are simultaneously used to update our huge database periodically.SARC volunteers and team members have the splendid privilege of being a part of all these events in various capacities. One gets to meet and interact with eminent personalities, artists, professionals, researchers and countless others. Indeed, the only thing that is common to all our alumni is their undying love for the institute and their genuine willingness to help it.So to any student or alumna/alumnus reading this, you have but to approach us and we shall be at your service. We hope that SARC continues to play its pivotal role well in the future and serve our institute to the fullest

In 1959 Sir Alastair Pilkington invented the Float Process, which remains the world standard process for flat glass manufacture.Our industry-leading glass coating facility, also in St Helens, gives our glass properties such as Solar Control, Low Emissivity, Electrical Conductivity, and even Bird Safety! The Pilkington brand is synonymous with technical excellence and service in the glass industry.We distribute our glass to an international customer base, either as stock or as bespoke processed products, direct from St Helens or through our network of nationwide branches.Our parent company, NSG Group, has set a target of reducing greenhouse gas emissions by 30% by 2030 compared to 2018 levels and has been certified as a Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). As part of this, we aim to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050. We've been taking huge strides in decarbonisation, but being part of an energy-intensive industry, we must focus on how else we can make change.NSG Group are always looking for the next generation of glass manufacturing and coating technology experts to ensure we remain Best-in-Glass. From Pilkington UK's manufacturing sites in St Helens to NSG Group's European Research and Development Technical Centre in Lathom, Lancashire, find your career with us today at https://www.nsg.com/en/careers/ukFollow this LinkedIn page to be the first to hear about company and career updates.For more information about our product range visit www.pilkington.co.uk.

basic_profile.name: Doron Fetman
basic_profile.headline: Co-Founder, EFFX AI | Award-winning Entrepreneur & Venture Builder | Collector of Culture | Champion of Innovation
basic_profile.summary: Co-Founder of EFFX AI. Entrepreneur, strategic advisor, venture builder, investor, and operator with nearly three decades of experience building, scaling, transforming, and exiting companies across food technology, consumer products, digital platforms, creative services, and AI-enabled business transformation.At EFFX AI, I advise founders, operators, and leadership teams on growth, transformation, innovation, AI integration, strategic partnerships, and venture creation. The firm runs on three pillars: EFFX Advisory transforms and scales existing businesses, EFFX Ventures builds companies, and EFFX Intelligence powers both through our proprietary AI operating system.My career began in the restaurant industry before co-founding the nation's first kosher food concession network across major U.S. sports stadiums. In 2006, I helped pioneer the food automation category by developing the market for a NASA-licensed technology capable of heating frozen food in under 60 seconds through vending machines, years before autonomous food became mainstream.In 2013, I founded Eff Creative Group and helped grow it into a 4x Inc. 500 company with operations in New York, Singapore, and Hong Kong. Along the way, our teams launched more than 100 digital platforms and products, earned 45+ industry awards, supported organizations ranging from startups to public companies, and completed a successful acquisition before evolving into what is now EFFX AI.Throughout my career, I have been drawn to industries experiencing friction, disruption, or transformation. Whether through technology, operational redesign, AI, partnerships, or venture creation, my focus has always been the same: build stronger foundations, create scalable systems, and help ambitious organizations execute with clarity and speed.Today, I divide my time between advising select clients, building ventures, evaluating strategic opportunities, and helping companies build more valuable businesses.

current.employer_linkedin_description: EFFX helps companies build stronger, more valuable businesses.Companies don't come to EFFX looking for another consulting firm. They come to us when they need experienced operators who can identify what's limiting business performance, align leadership around the right opportunities, and build the fix alongside them. Strategy and execution as one engagement, not two purchases.Unlike traditional consulting firms that separate strategy, technology, branding, and implementation across multiple engagements, EFFX brings those capabilities together in one integrated team.The work spans three pillars:EFFX Advisory transforms and scales existing businesses through business transformation, organizational restructuring, brand strategy, technology, and product.EFFX Ventures builds companies. Most are our own, built from opportunities we recognized before there was a market for them. Others we build alongside founders and operating teams, with an equity stake and accountability for the outcome.EFFX Intelligence powers both, designing and deploying the proprietary operating system that automates the core functions of a business.We work with founder-led businesses, executive teams, family offices, private equity firms, portfolio companies, and established companies preparing for their next stage of growth.EFFX was founded by Toby Hassan-Fishman and Doron Fetman, formerly of Eff Creative Group, a four-time Inc. 500 company with operations in New York, Singapore, and Hong Kong.
current.employee_description:
Co-Founder of EFFX AI, an advisory, implementation, and venture-building firm helping companies build stronger, more valuable businesses.

At EFFX, we work with founders, CEOs, executive teams, family offices, private equity firms, investors, and portfolio companies at pivotal moments of growth, transformation, and change.

Our role is to identify what is limiting performance, align leadership around the right opportunities, and help execute the strategy, systems, technology, and operating infrastructure required to move the business forward.

EFFX operates across three integrated pillars:

EFFX Advisory transforms businesses through strategic advisory, business transformation, organizational restructuring, brand and product strategy, technology strategy, and senior executive counsel. Our award-winning Turnformation™ model combines business recovery and transformation as one mandate, addressing sources of value destruction while simultaneously building the people, processes, systems, and capabilities required to create future value.

EFFX Ventures builds companies through venture creation, incubation, strategic partnerships, growth acceleration, and hands-on operating support.

EFFX Intelligence powers systems. We design and deploy custom AI operating infrastructure around how a company actually works, using its data, workflows, tools, and institutional knowledge to automate operations, improve decision-making, increase accountability, and expand organizational capacity.
My focus is helping leadership teams unlock business value, accelerate sustainable growth, and build the infrastructure required for what comes next.

I have been building, operating, scaling, and transforming companies since 1998. My approach remains simple: understand the real problem, build the right infrastructure, and execute with accountability.

AI is part of how we work. It is not the reason companies hire us. The outcome is a stronger, more valuable business.

basic_profile.name: Felipe Dellacqua
basic_profile.headline: Starting a new AI company... Tech Entrepreneur, Enterprise Sales B2B, Former CRO/CMO, 2x Exit 1x IPO
basic_profile.summary: 22 years. 4 companies founded. 2 exits. 1 IPO (NYSE: VTEX · US$3.7B)I started building early — and never stopped.Primordia was my first major bet: in 3 years, we built Brazil's first SaaS e-commerce platform for the fashion sector and reached 80% market share. It was acquired by VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) in 2014. From there, I joined VTEX as an executive partner — and spent the next 7 years leading Brazilian market consolidation, with 50%+ organic growth year over year, a full transition from mid-market to enterprise clients, Series B and C rounds led by SoftBank, Tiger Global, and Lone Pine Capital, and ultimately a NYSE IPO at a US$3.7B valuation. After the IPO, I kept building. I joined Adventures — a startup backed by a R$50M Series A from Provence Capital, as an operating partner. I led the turnaround of Infracommerce (BVMF: IFCM3), a public company on the Brazilian stock exchange, from the entry of Pátria Investimentos through its sale to Geribá Investimentos. And I led the unification of sales and marketing across Deal Group, a technology firm recognized as a leader in the ISG AI quadrant, with operations in Brazil, Europe, Africa, and the United States.  Each cycle gave me something different: building from zero, scaling with institutional capital, operating through crisis, executing enterprise across multiple countries. These are layers that few professionals carry in a single trajectory.  Alongside the executive path, I've always believed knowledge needs to move. That's why I've taught MBA courses at some of Brazil's most respected universities — UNICAMP, FGV, ESPM, Impacta, and FIAP — covering e-commerce, go-to-market strategy, cross-border commerce, and digital business. Throughout this journey, I've also worked as a growth and sales advisor to startups in the digital ecosystem — including Trinio, Retail Hub, and companies within the Confi portfolio (founded by Pedro Chiamulera, creator of ClearSale). The work was always the same: help founders turn a great product into predictable revenue. Now I'm taking everything I've built, learned, and observed — and putting it into the most ambitious chapter yet. I'm co-founding an artificial intelligence company with a clear goal: to become the largest enterprise AI platform in Latin America. Details coming soon. What I can say now: the problem we're solving is real, the business model is defensible, and the team has the track record and the hunger to execute.  If you invest in technology and AI in Brazil or across LATAM — we'll be opening an investment round very soon.

basic_profile.name: Amy Daali, PhD
basic_profile.headline: Founder & CEO at Stealth AI Startup
basic_profile.summary: Amy Daali, Ph.D. is an AI founder, engineer, and researcher working at the intersection of artificial intelligence, medicine, and women’s health.She is currently building a stealth AI startup focused on women’s health and is the author of Women, Health & AI, a Substack publication exploring the gaps medicine has yet to solve for women, emerging research frontiers, and how AI and technology can improve women’s healthcare.Amy holds a Ph.D. in Engineering from the University of Texas and has more than a decade of experience applying artificial intelligence, deep learning, and engineering across medical, technical, and business environments. Her background spans biomedical imaging, computer vision, deep learning, healthcare technology, and applied AI.Previously, Amy founded Lucea AI, where she worked with executives and organizations on AI strategy, implementation, and education. She is also the founder of Moonshot 4 Her, a platform created to support technical women building companies.Her interest in AI and medicine began early in her career during a postdoctoral fellowship at the University of Texas Health Science Center San Antonio, where she developed computational models using biomedical imaging data to study and predict cancer progression in glioblastoma patients.She later served as Engineering Director at Invictus Medical, leading the development of advanced noise-reduction technology designed to improve the acoustic environment of neonatal incubators.At USAA, Amy developed deep learning models using Keras and GPU-enabled TensorFlow on large-scale imagery datasets. She also contributed to the patent “Predictive Mapping for Routing Telephone Calls,” which applied AI to optimize call routing using factors including sentiment, user experience, and topic performance.Amy is an advocate for increasing the participation of women in technology and entrepreneurship. She has spoken about AI at conferences and events including the Data Science Salon Conference, the Women in Data Science Conference, and the IEEE Smart City Summit, and regularly contributes to conversations about AI, human intelligence, women’s health, and the future of technology.

basic_profile.name: Theo Zätterström 🎉
basic_profile.headline: Hjälper grundare med 2 till 10 msek ARR att bygga säljmaskineriet innan de anställer en säljchef.
basic_profile.summary: Pipen växer men besluten puttas framåt. Du har visat demon för samma person tre gånger, skickat offerten, mejlat två gånger till och sen blir det knäpptyst.Du vet att något inte funkar.Du vet bara inte var.Du säljer på pris och features för att du inte kan sätta en siffra på vad kundens problem kostar. Du mäter bokade demos och firar dem, fast hälften aldrig borde ha varit en demo.Säljet ligger i excel, i ditt huvud och i mejl du skriver för hand efter varje möte. Styrelsen frågar varför inget stängs och du har inget bättre svar än att det tar tid i din bransch. Under tiden går kassan ner och planen är att anställa någon som ska lösa säljet.Men om du inte själv vet var det fastnar, vad ska den personen kopiera?Mina två första säljjobb slutade nästan med att jag fick sparken. Sen bytte jag till ett bolag där vd och säljchef hade byggt ett system för hur man säljer. Det tog mig nio dagar att stänga en av bolagets största affärer. Systemet gjorde jobbet, inte jag.Det är det The Scalability Diagnostic svarar på. Tre veckor. Jag intervjuar dig och de som säljer, går igenom dina affärer, din pipeline och dina säljmöten, och du får ett svar på var det läcker och vad du ska göra först.Hittills: 70+ techbolag, bland andra Stratsys, Trapets, Wint, Visma, Headcount, Position Green, Netigate, Kundo, Ebbot och Screens. Winrate upp 50 procent eller mer hos flera av dem. Själv har jag sålt för över 100 miljoner innan jag började hjälpa andra.En vd sa efteråt: "Det är första gången den ekonomiska köparen och business usern pushar igenom det tillsammans utan några riktiga invändningar."För dig som är grundare eller vd på ett techbolag med betalande kunder och 2 till 10 MSEK ARR, utan säljchef.Inte för dig som redan vet exakt vad problemet är, eller hoppas att nästa runda löser det.Skriv "info" i ett DM för mer information.

basic_profile.name: Trey Layton
basic_profile.headline: Founder & CEO, Stealth AI Company | Partner, Capellas Partners | 39 patent filings in autonomous intelligence, model integrity & compression | Former CTO, VCE and Dell EMC
basic_profile.summary: I build the systems AI runs on, and the frameworks that tell executives whether their AI investment is actually working. Three decades in enterprise infrastructure, most of it spent at the point where a new architecture either scales or quietly fails. As CTO of VCE, I helped build converged infrastructure into a multibillion-dollar category and the foundation of what became hyperconverged systems. At Dell EMC I ran engineering for data center automation. At Penguin Solutions I led the software and product organization behind ICE ClusterWare and ClusterWare AIM, and directed DevOps for some of the largest AI superclusters in operation. In 2026 I turned that experience into invention. I founded a stealth deep-tech AI company and filed 36 patent applications with the USPTO in a single year, across three problems that get harder as AI systems scale: how independent systems come to trust each other without a central authority, how you verify that a model in production still behaves the way it did when you shipped it, and how you move far more data than the network was ever built to carry. Ninety more are in the pipeline. As a Partner at Capellas Partners, I advise boards, private equity firms, and CEOs on AI strategy, technical diligence, and the sequencing decisions that determine whether AI investment compounds or stalls. That work produced three more patent-pending products: Estate Lens, which grounds engineering estate analysis in provenance and a falsifiable thesis; Signal, for advisory-grounded multi-source intelligence; and Keel, for self-correcting software. It also produced two frameworks I publish openly. The AI Maturity Index assesses enterprise AI readiness across ten operational domains and five stages, and includes an AI-washing detection protocol for boards that suspect the maturity being reported to them is not the maturity that exists. The AI-Native Development Organization, a four-part series, argues that AI does not accelerate the traditional development organization so much as remove the constraint that organization was built around, and works through what to rebuild in its place. The through-line: most AI failure is not a technology problem. It is a sequencing problem. Organizations automate what they should have deleted, scale what they never operationalized, and buy capability they have not earned the right to use. I work with leaders who would rather find that out early. Before any of this: U.S. Army Intelligence Analyst, CENTCOM. It is still the most useful training I have had in telling signal from noise.

current.employee_description:
I advise boards, private equity firms, and Fortune 500 executives on AI strategy, technical diligence, M&A integration, and the sequencing decisions that determine whether AI investment compounds or stalls. My work spans supply chain, financial services, telecommunications, enterprise software, and consumer markets.

Built and published:
 
• The AI Maturity Index — a framework assessing enterprise AI readiness across ten operational domains and five stages of maturity, built on the finding that AI maturity is never one number. A company can be Stage 4 in development tooling and Stage 1 in customer service, and usually is. The companion Scoring Guide supplies domain scoring criteria, measurable indicator checklists, cross-domain leverage scoring, a board reporting framework, and an AI-washing detection protocol for identifying inflated maturity claims before capital moves against them.
 
• The AI-Native Development Organization — a four-part series on what changes structurally when AI assumes the bulk of code production: the requirement precision inversion, the sequencing discipline that prevents automating a process you should have deleted, why the tool rather than the interface is now the durable asset, and what a good developer looks like now.
 
Patent-pending products developed through this practice:
 
• Estate Lens — provenance-bound engineering estate analysis producing a falsifiable decision thesis rather than an opinion. 30 claims, 16 figures.
• Signal — advisory-grounded multi-source intelligence with self-managing collection and accountability-partitioned engagement execution. 35 claims across 7 independent methods.
• Keel — self-correcting software with multi-source self-capture of internal failures and source-grounded automated remediation. 28 claims.

current.employee_description:
I founded a deep tech AI company building system-level capability in autonomous intelligence, secure distributed architecture, and large-scale data efficiency. The work spans early research, prototype system design, and a durable IP foundation for AI infrastructure.
 
In our first year we filed 36 patent applications with the USPTO, with all priority dates locked. The portfolio organizes into five invention families. More than 90 inventions are under development, with a subset progressing through filing.
 
I am deliberately not detailing those filings while they remain in provisional status. What I will say is the shape of the thinking behind them.
 
We assume AI systems will run distributed rather than centralized, which makes trust between independent parties a design problem rather than an administrative one. We assume those systems will have to prove their own integrity continuously rather than be trusted by assertion. And we assume the cost of moving data between them is the constraint most of the industry is still treating as fixed.
 
Those three assumptions determine what we build, and what we decline to build.
 
My role is technical direction and research sequencing: deciding which of those inventions earns the next increment of effort, and holding the architecture honest before we scale outward.

Halifax Rugby League Club was formed way back in 1873. It was a Rugby Union club in those days, as all rugby clubs were before the birth of Rugby League in 1895, and was very successful in that code. After becoming the first ever winners of the Yorkshire Cup in 1878, Halifax went on to win it on four further occasions. Several players were supplied for the Yorkshire County side in these years, and five were picked for the full England Rugby Union team.The club moved into their previous home of Thrum Hall in 1886, their home for the next 112 years until the move in 1998 to the re-developed 'Shay Stadium' to ground-share with local footballing neighbours, Halifax Town AFC (now FC Halifax Town).Halifax were founder members of the Rugby League (then known as the Northern Union) in 1895. They continued to be very successful, producing one of their best ever teams in the early years of the twentieth century. In season 1902-03 they achieved the 'double' by winning the Challenge Cup and finishing top of Division One. They won the cup again the following season, and were the first ever Championship Play-off winners in season 1906-07.We look forward to our supporters, players, staff and sponsors joining us on Linkedin. If you would like to learn anything more about Halifax Rugby League please message us

basic_profile.name: John Kim
basic_profile.headline: Sr. Advisor, Permira; Board Member, Owlet. Former: EVP/CPO PayPal, President Expedia Marketplace, President Vrbo
basic_profile.summary:
As Executive Vice President, Chief Product Officer, John Kim leads the consumer and merchant product and engineering teams working to advance PayPal's position as a leader in digital payments and commerce for consumers and merchants around the globe.

John brings a wealth of product management and technical experience to PayPal. Prior to joining PayPal, John served as President of Expedia Marketplace. In that role, he oversaw strategy, product, technology, and operations for all of Expedia Group's business lines – including lodging, air, car, cruise and activities – bringing Expedia Group's products to life for its customers and suppliers. Previously, John served as President of Platform & Marketplaces at Expedia Group where he led the development of artificial intelligence, user experience, research, ecommerce, marketplaces and yield management, data and development platforms across Expedia Group's customers, partners and employees.

Previously, Kim served as the President of Vrbo, where he led strategy and operations of one of the world’s leading alternative accommodations marketplaces. Joining Vrbo in 2016, Kim led the company’s transformation from a subscription-based advertising model to a modern e-commerce business powered by the latest advances in data science and technology. During Kim’s tenure, Vrbo was recognized by Business Insider as one of the top 25 tech companies to work for, by The Muse as one of the top innovators to work for, and by Hired.com as one of the top employer tech brands.

Before joining Vrbo, Kim served as Expedia’s Chief Product Officer and helped Expedia become one of the world’s most successful travel companies. He led the company’s overall global product development for hotel, air, car, and activities across Expedia.com, Orbitz, Travelocity, Wotif, and AirAsiaGo. The initiatives Kim led contributed to multiple years of double-digit growth in conversion. Kim has more than two decades of experience in product development, marketing, and general management at tier-one, venture-backed startups, medium-sized companies, and globally known brands including Yahoo!, Overture, Accenture, Bank of America, and Pelago. 

Kim is a vocal advocate for diversity and was appointed to advise President George W. Bush on economic policies impacting Asian Americans and Pacific Islander small businesses. He graduated from the University of California, Santa Barbara, and received his MBA from the University of Chicago Booth School of Business.

Welcome to Vrbo, helping people everywhere travel better together.

basic_profile.name: De'Angello Harris
basic_profile.headline: Founding CBO @ Stealth AI | GTM Strategy, Revenue & Strategic Partnerships | US & APJ
basic_profile.summary: I'm the Founding Chief Business Officer at a stealth AI startup in San Francisco, building the commercial engine around the technology. I lead customer development, strategic partnerships, investor relationships, and talent as we turn technical innovation into a scalable business. Right now, that means building our founding engineering team alongside our YC alum technical co-founder.For 15+ years I've built commercial operations from the ground up across Singapore and Australia, working hands-on with founders and executive teams on go-to-market, revenue and scaling their organizations. Most recently I opened Think & Grow's Singapore business from zero, then spearheaded its APJ go-to-market from Sydney. We were the embedded GTM leads for startups and scaleups entering new markets (Stripe, Square, Spotify, Peloton and Dropbox), closing their first customers and revenue from the US to APJ.Before that I spent seven years at Randstad helping companies like Grab/Uber, Airbnb, Gemini, Alibaba and ByteDance build their engineering, data and product teams across APAC. It taught me that even the best strategy goes nowhere without the right people behind it. As a German-American who’s lived and worked across Germany, the US, Singapore and Australia, I’ve learned that what works in one market rarely translates directly to the next. Now I’m applying that mindset to a space where the playbook is still being written: AI.If you're in product or an engineer who wants to be early at something ambitious, I'm always up for a coffee in SF :)

current.employee_description:
Building the next frontier of AI: Artificial Collective Intelligence.

Cognisee is a frontier AI lab building the missing cognitive layer for AI: systems that surface, structure, and activate tacit context across humans, agents, machines, and institutions.

Building toward a future where:

• The productivity paradox breaks: AI moves beyond individual productivity gains to measurable organizational lift by turning tacit context, expert judgment, and institutional memory into system-wide performance.

• Expertise no longer disappears: Critical judgment, operating knowledge, and failure patterns become durable cognitive assets, enabling hard-won know-how to compound across teams, systems, and time.

• Autonomy becomes trustworthy: Agents and machines act with tacit context, uncertainty awareness, and governed escalation, moving from brittle automation to context-grounded execution.

• Physical AI gains real-world competence: Robots and machines learn skilled action from embodied, contextual, expert know-how, addressing expertise and skills-transfer gaps in critical sectors.

basic_profile.name: João Ferrão dos Santos
basic_profile.headline: We help CMOs rollout EGC to attract clients and talent. Our content agent and mentoring help teams grow organically and appear in AI search results. Ex-VC, Rocket Internet.
basic_profile.summary:
Hello! You probably know me as the guy who went viral testing ChatGPT4 as a CEO. I've been in startups for 12 years. My team and I raised 45 million EUR and launched a venture capital fund in 2018 (msm.vc), to invest in early stage tech building a better world.

We talked to about 2,000 startups every year.

I was surprised by how often founders struggled to sell their vision in a clear and exciting way. 

Coming up with better suggestions on the spot felt easy - I had found superpower #1.

In 2023, I went all-in on LinkedIn and generated 10M views in 3 months, mixing technology with creative writing. I was surprised with the results, turns out lots of people enjoyed my writing. Superpower #2.

Today I mostly do two things:

1. Growth Mentoring for founders - how to get a 'yes' from VCs, GTM strategy and going viral.

2. Underdog Founders - I interview entrepreneurs disrupting industries without prior experience in them and winning against all odds. Just startup journeys and learnings, no fluff.

Founders need to meet 4 criteria to be featured here and on Substack:

1 - No big prior exit.
2 - New to the market you are trying to disrupt.
3 - Survived rejections from clients and VCs.
4 - Clear metrics proving you found product-market fit (revenue, growth, big clients)


Can you give me an example of how you help founders? Sure:

-Fundraising Advisory: 
Process, Pitch, Presentation. 
How to use your data to build investor interest.
Best practices and common mistakes.

-Value Proposition Design:
Explain the product to a 5-year old (ELI5), identify who actually cares and why it smashes the status quo, in a simple and quantified sentence.

-Content and Go-to Market Strategy:
Walk us through your current marketing channels and sales process so we can show you what we'd do to generate leads and go viral with your target audience.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The InSITE Fellowship is a highly competitive leadership development program comprised of exceptional graduate students at top universities, including Columbia, NYU, Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Georgetown, and several medical research institutions. InSITE Fellows and alumni make up a global network of entrepreneurs and leaders in technology and venture capital.InSITE was founded in 1999 with a mission to create a community of passionate leaders who share common values and have the desire, ability, and network to support innovative companies and projects around the nation. We identify talented students from a diverse range of backgrounds and connect them with hand-picked, high-potential emerging companies in a variety of industries. Students meet with founders and company leaders, identify key challenges and opportunities, set deliverables, and complete semester-long projects that contribute to real growth.Each semester, the New York chapter of InSITE receives over 150 applications for eight projects. After careful due diligence, the InSITE community selects those projects it sees as most promising and most viable. Projects vary, depending on the individual company’s most pressing need. past.employer_linkedin_description: The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) is the military of the State of Israel, responsible for the nation's defense and security. Founded in 1948, the IDF ranks among the most battle-tested armed forces in the world, having had to defend the country in six major wars. At the age of 18, men and women are required to do mandatory military service in one of the IDF's three branches - Ground Forces, Air Force, and Navy. The Israel Defense Forces is unique in its inclusion of mandatory conscription of women. Men and women of all ranks serve side by side in various positions such as pilots, captains, combat soldiers, intelligence, doctors, technicians and much more. This national service brings together Israelis from all sectors of society, religions and backgrounds. The IDF is considered to be one of the world's most technologically-advanced militaries and contributes greatly to Israel's thriving culture of tech start-ups and cutting-edge innovation.

basic_profile.name: Rafael Fleck de Souza
basic_profile.headline: Chief Marketing Officer | Business Strategy | Growth, Revenue & Innovation | Building something new
basic_profile.summary: Growth doesn’t happen by accident — it is built through strategy, data, technology, and consistent execution.Over the past 10+ years, I have worked across marketing, growth, customer success, product, innovation, and advisory, building a broad business perspective that goes beyond traditional marketing. Throughout this journey, I have led teams of 20+ professionals, directly managed over R$8M in paid media, and guided investments exceeding R$40M, always with a focus on scalable growth and data-informed decision-making.I know how to lead the strategic direction and execution of the growth engine, overseeing Marketing, Sales, Expansion, Education, Automation, and AI.My work sits at the intersection of business strategy, revenue growth, operational efficiency, and technology adoption.My background combines growth marketing, performance, leadership, product thinking, and execution. In recent years, I have also been deeply involved in automation and artificial intelligence, designing systems and workflows that improve productivity, support better decisions, and make operations more scalable. On a daily basis, I work with tools such as n8n, Make, Lovable, and Eleven Labs, integrated with AI platforms including ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, and open source models in Ollama and OpenRouter.Now I'm learning about the Hermes agent, and two solutions, Maestri, and Warp.I'm algo passionate about creating products in Cursor, Antigravity, and Codex using agent frameworks like AIOS and Opensquad.What interests me most is building growth engines, improving how teams operate, and connecting strategy, technology, and execution in a way that creates measurable business impact.Core areas of expertise: Growth Marketing, Performance Marketing, Marketing Leadership, Go-to-Market, Revenue Growth, Automation, AI, Innovation, and Cross-functional Leadership.I’m always interested in connecting with people building ambitious companies, scalable operations, and smarter ways to grow.

past.employee_description:
As Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), I oversaw and led the strategic direction and execution of our comprehensive marketing initiatives across various areas, with a primary focus on driving the company’s growth.

My role included providing strategic direction for the business in all matters related to marketing, including growth strategy, branding, positioning, expansion, and other areas.

I designed the entire business expansion plan using a franchise model and built a team from the ground up that carried out the entire plan as intended; by the end of my tenure, we had reached 10 franchised locations and the plan was running at full speed.

Following the acquisition of an AI startup, I led the in-house Automation and AI team. Through various initiatives, we were able to significantly increase efficiency across all areas of the business. We skillfully developed in-house solutions to replace third-party systems, which saved us thousands of dollars and provided us with solutions tailored specifically to our needs.

Under my leadership, the company grew more than 10 times in 2.5 years starting with less than US$ 40k in monthly revenue and reaching more than US$ 320K.

I directly led the Marketing, Expansion, Education, Automation, and Artificial Intelligence teams. During my first year, I also led the sales team.

basic_profile.name: Sarthak Gupta
basic_profile.headline: Co-Founder at Stealth AI Startup
basic_profile.summary:
I am a final-year B.Tech Information Technology student with a strong focus on AI-powered application development and Agentic AI systems, where backend engineering meets intelligent automation. My work centers on integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into real-world products—not as experiments, but as scalable, production-ready features.

I primarily develop using Python and Node.js, building backend services, RESTful APIs, and system workflows that enable AI-driven decision-making, analysis, and automation. I enjoy designing architectures where AI components plug cleanly into core systems, ensuring reliability, performance, and extensibility.

I have hands-on experience building AI-integrated applications, including an AI-powered GitHub repository analyzer and an AI-based code debugging assistant. These projects involved LLM integration, API orchestration, prompt engineering, real-time analysis, and delivering meaningful insights to users. Through this work, I developed a practical understanding of how AI agents can reason, use tools, and operate within structured backend pipelines.

Alongside AI development, I have a solid foundation in Data Structures & Algorithms, OOP, DBMS, and SDLC, with experience across SQL, Firestore, Git, Postman, and frontend technologies like React.js for end-to-end collaboration. I am currently expanding my expertise in Agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, focusing on autonomous workflows and intelligent backend systems.

Beyond technical execution, I bring strong leadership and communication skills developed through internships, hackathons, and student leadership roles. I have been shortlisted twice for Smart India Hackathon, secured 2nd place in IEEE Innovate Hackathon, and held multiple coordination roles managing teams and large-scale events.

I am actively seeking opportunities in AI-driven backend development, agentic systems, or software roles focused on intelligent applications, where I can contribute, learn fast, and build impactful AI-powered products.

📌 Tech Stack: Python, Node.js, Express.js, LLMs, Agentic AI, LangChain, REST APIs, SQL, Firestore, Git, React.js
