basic_profile.name: Shubham Chauhan
basic_profile.headline: Building AI-Native Products | ex-Microsoft PM | IIT KGP • IIMA
basic_profile.summary:
Senior Product Manager (Technical) | AI Platforms · Developer Ecosystems · M365 Copilot | IIT-KGP · IIMA

Senior Product Manager – Technical with 8+ years across engineering, product, and entrepreneurship, building scalable platforms at the intersection of AI, developer ecosystems, and enterprise software. CS from IIT Kharagpur, MBA from IIM Ahmedabad.

🔷 Microsoft 365 & Copilot (Senior PM – Technical)
Owned developer platform strategy, third-party integrations, and extensibility for M365 - scaling to 250+ partner apps, ~5M MAU, and ~100M monthly API calls across ~40K enterprise tenants, while preventing churn of multi-million-dollar enterprise accounts via the Kaizala→Teams migration. A highlight: stepped in mid-flight to lead a high-visibility 0→1 initiative originally scoped for my manager's level, driving alignment across 10+ cross-functional teams in 5 geographies, architecting a unified design system and compliance framework, and landing a feature in Satya Nadella's Build keynote - the org's first. Later drove API plugin development for M365 Copilot, enabling natural-language access to enterprise REST APIs to advance agentic AI workflows.

🔷 Founder (Climage & Curio Daily)
Built 0→1 products end-to-end with modern AI tools. Ran 50+ prototype tests to validate (and ultimately killed) an early hypothesis on weak PMF signal, then pivoted decisively. Currently building Curio Daily: an AI-native personal news agent powered by a 7-agent Python/LLM pipeline, with ~84% gross margin unit economics.

🔷 Samsung Research Institute (Software Engineer)
Part of a global Android engineering team shipping to 500M+ devices. Built Analytics Logs capturing behavioral data from 10M+ Galaxy S8 devices; achieved 95% storage optimization via file virtualization (Project Infinity).

Core strengths:
→ AI & emerging tech: Generative AI · RAG · AI agents · LLM-powered workflows
→ Platform thinking: API/SDK design · Developer ecosystems · Cross-client architecture
→ Product execution: Strategy · Roadmap · GTM · Experimentation · KPI frameworks
→ Leadership: Cross-functional influence · Stakeholder management · Executive alignment

Open to Senior PMT / Principal PM roles in AI platforms, developer tools, enterprise SaaS, or consumer tech.

basic_profile.name: Rishi Sreedhar
basic_profile.headline: ⟨ Materials | AI4Science | Tensor Networks ⟩ Researcher
basic_profile.summary:
Hi there, I am a researcher working on using tensor network and machine learning techniques to solve problems in combinatorial optimization, quantitative finance, and quantum chemistry. I am also invested in identifying prospects of a near-term quantum advantage.

Tensor Network techniques provide an extremely versatile and intuitive perspective on entanglement in quantum systems. This applies more generally to correlations in both classical and quantum multipartite systems, too, and has helped me develop a classical, quantum-inspired, approximation of the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA). TN techniques are also excellent tools to tackle the "curse of dimensionality" problems arising in computational finance and chemistry.

I also hold the privilege of being the founder and chair of QIndia, a 1250+ member community of quantum researchers and enthusiasts working to build an open quantum ecosystem in India. I enjoy scientific outreach aimed at making abstract ideas accessible to diverse audiences, and have organized and been a part of multiple such events to date.

I love meeting people and so do reach out if you'd like to discuss quantum research or tech in general. The quantum ecosystem is small which provides us with the unique opportunity to steer its growth towards kindness. 

Areas of Interest: Stochastic Processes, Quantitative Finance, Quantum Inspired Algorithms, Quantum Information Theory, Tensor Networks, Machine Learning (Quantum and Classical), Ab-initio Codes, Density Functional Theory, Machine Learning for quantum chemistry.

Skills: Scientific software development, Python, Matlab, Linux, SIESTA,  PyTorch, Tensor Network, Technical outreach.

basic_profile.summary: I build the commercial system behind emerging technology. My career has centered on one recurring problem: a company has something valuable — a differentiated product, technology, market position, or strategic opportunity — but the revenue system has not yet caught up. That is where I do my best work. Over 20+ years, I have helped companies turn ambiguity into repeatable enterprise growth across AI, robotics, SaaS, fintech, professional services, and complex B2B markets. The industries changed. The assignment stayed consistent: clarify the opportunity, build the GTM motion, earn enterprise trust, and create the operating system that can scale. A few examples: • Built AI-enabled GTM, CRM, automation, forecasting, and revenue systems across 40+ implementations, contributing to 215% revenue growth in under 12 months.• Led commercialization for an AI-powered fintech platform, building relationship infrastructure across 1,400+ investors, allocators, lenders, and partners while supporting $34M+ in capital and strategic activity, including a $15M Series A.• Helped close a multimillion-dollar enterprise robotics transaction with Telefónica S.A.• Built and rebuilt commercial motions producing 70.61% revenue growth, retention improvement from 54% to 83%, $3.6M in new revenue, +41% conversion, and +73% closed-won performance. I have operated as a founder, President, Chief Business Development Officer, Chief Growth Officer, sales leader, advisor, and revenue architect. The titles matter less than the pattern: • Find the constraint.• Create clarity.• Build the system.• Move the number. My leadership style is hands-on where the signal matters and systems-oriented where scale matters. I move comfortably between the CEO conversation, enterprise deal, GTM model, CRM workflow, operating dashboard, team coaching, and product-market feedback loop. The strongest fit is a founder-, CEO-, CRO-, board-, or investor-backed company where innovation has begun to outrun the commercial system—and leadership needs someone who can connect strategy, enterprise GTM, partnerships, RevOps, AI, and execution into one growth engine.

basic_profile.summary: I spent nearly two decades inside regulated financial institutions. I now help companies prepare for the scrutiny that comes with selling to them.I founded Stealth AI Startup because knowing you need to be compliant is different from having the people, controls and evidence to demonstrate it.We are an AI-native compliance-readiness practice for startups and growing businesses facing customer requirements, audits or compliance deadlines. We do the work: gap assessments, policies, control implementation and audit-evidence preparation. For companies that need ongoing support, we stay involved as a fractional security and compliance function.Stealth AI Startup prepares. Independent auditors and certification bodies assess and certify. That distinction matters. My background spans commercial banking in Nigeria and seven years at the Business Development Bank of Canada (BDC). I led a 20-person team, recovered $200K in lost income and originated more than $20M in commercial lending across 20+ mid-market and large accounts. I also supported PCI DSS and ISO 27001 recertification work and coordinated with risk, legal and credit teams on complex files.That experience shapes the questions I bring to technology conversations. Where does the data go? Who can access it? What happens if a provider fails? Can we show that a control works, rather than simply point to a policy?My work now includes AI governance and the relationship between architecture, cost and risk. I bring a banking and compliance perspective to those decisions, working alongside technical teams to connect implementation with what customers, auditors and regulators need to see.I am a Fellow of the Chartered Institute of Bankers of Nigeria (CIBN), Canada Regional Leader for FinOps Weekly and a contributor to Cloud Security Alliance working groups on AI controls and safety. I also serve as a Deal Partner and Pro Advisory Board member at Boardy, and Venture Scout at LvlUp Ventures and ADIN, connecting founders with investors and operators.If a customer requirement or compliance deadline is holding up your next contract, let’s talk.

basic_profile.name: Sujal Kumar Poddar
basic_profile.headline: Founder: GWF & Phantom Pen | Finance Major | SDG-4 Advocate | Research in Algorithmic Pricing & Sustainability Policy | Debater & Polo Player |
basic_profile.summary:
Hi, I’m Sujal — a finance major, founder, and full-time curious human who believes that data, debate, and a little bit of wit can change the world.

At 20, I’m wearing many hats (sometimes a polo helmet too 🐎). I founded Phantom Pen, a content and academic solutions venture helping entrepreneurs and students put their ideas into words. I also lead God’s Wish Foundation, where we’re on a mission to make SDG-4 (Quality Education) more than just a goal — we’re making it a reality, one initiative at a time.

My current academic jam? Algorithmic price discrimination and sustainability policy — a fancy way of saying I like asking tough questions about fairness, pricing, and the planet. I’m pursuing this through research, fellowships like EPAYF, and the occasional late-night deep dive into economic theory and climate politics.

I’ve led teams in fundraising, content strategy, and edtech sales, and love bringing storytelling into every space I work in — whether that’s pitching an idea, debating at IIM Indore (national finalist!), or writing policy briefs.

Outside the spreadsheets and research papers, you’ll probably find me:
📣 At a debate podium
🐎 Riding stallions at Calcutta Polo Club
📚 Reading Victorian literature (Oscar Wilde is my spirit animal)

Let’s connect if you’re into finance, education, policy, or the occasional intellectual rabbit hole. I’m always down to collaborate, learn, or just share good ideas.

basic_profile.name: Raheel Anwar
basic_profile.headline: Technology Business Builder | Strategy, GTM & Customer Growth | AI, Infrastructure & Security | Ex-Juniper, Snowflake, Exabeam
basic_profile.summary: Every enterprise has a post-sale organization. Almost none of them know what it is actually capable of. We are at an inflection point. The companies that will win the next decade are not the ones with the best product. They are the ones that figured out how to make every customer successful at scale, before the customer knew they needed help, before the risk became visible, before the renewal conversation became a negotiation. That is not an operational problem. That is an intelligence problem. Over 20 years I have led this function at enterprise scale, accountable for portfolios up to $800M and organizations of 100+ across cloud, SaaS, and security markets. At Snowflake and Exabeam I did not manage post-sale. I rebuilt it. Redesigned how teams are structured, how data flows, how AI surfaces risk before humans see it, and how the function shows up in a board conversation about revenue rather than just retention. The function has gone by many names across my career. Customer Success. Support. Technical Account Management. Professional Services. The title has never been the point. The point is what happens after a customer signs, and whether the organization behind that moment is built to deliver value or just manage it. I have not only led that transformation from the inside. I have built toward it from the outside as well, which changed how I see the problem entirely. What I saw from both sides is this: most enterprises are deploying AI into their customer facing operations without the governance, trust, and identity architecture to make it safe, explainable, and accountable at scale. The gap is not a technology problem. It is a leadership problem. The leaders who close it will define what enterprise looks like for the next decade.

Lead Investor and end-to-end Venture Building Lead at Blue Route Technologies for Neurodevelopment, a HealthTech spin-off co-founded with DOBLE A Pediatrics and Neurodevelopment and powered by GooVentures®.

• Leading fundraising, investor storytelling, pitch deck development, and public and private funding strategies.

• Coordinating clinical validation and regulatory readiness under MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485.
• Defining the go-to-market strategy, strategic partnerships, and international expansion.

🎯 Impact

• Potential to reduce diagnostic journeys from over 24 months to just a few weeks.
• Integration of clinical expertise, AI, and digital therapies into a single platform.
• Building a HealthTech company designed for clinical validation, certification, investment, and international growth.

past.employer_linkedin_description: DevRev helps companies resolve customer and employee requests from start to finish. Nobody asked for a ticket number. They asked for access, an answer, or a fix.Getting there takes more than one system. The policy may be in a knowledge base, the history in a ticket, and the action somewhere else. DevRev connects those pieces through Shared Memory so AI can investigate and act across the tools a company already uses, within its permissions and approval rules.Computer works alongside people to find answers, investigate issues, and take permitted actions. Agents take on defined jobs and carry out the steps. Routine requests can be resolved automatically. When a person needs to decide, they get the facts and the work already done.The systems of record stay put. The work doesn’t have to. DevRev moves requests through investigation and action instead of leaving customers and employees with a promising link and a long wait.The numbers matter, tooOn Enterprise-Bench, Computer achieved 94.3% accuracy and used roughly 4.4x fewer tokens per correct answer than a fetch-based agent using the same model. Its token use stayed roughly flat as the dataset grew 256x.In an airline payment-support workflow, cases that took up to 30 minutes were resolved in under 3. In an employee IT rollout, 54% of requests were resolved automatically at launch.If we’re going to call it self-service, it should actually finish something.DevRev is headquartered in Palo Alto, with eight global offices. We’re backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield, with $150M+ raised. Founded by Dheeraj Pandey, former co-founder and CEO of Nutanix [NASDAQ: NTNX], and board member at Adobe [NASDAQ: ADBE], alongside Manoj Agarwal, former SVP of Engineering at Nutanix.

Licious began in 2015 when Abhay Hanjura and Vivek Gupta set out to transform a $55Bn category that was largely unbranded, inconsistent, and untouched by modern food standards. Their vision was simple - bring honesty, hygiene, and joy to meat and seafood buying in India. What followed was a category-defining shift powered by India’s only fully integrated 0–4°C cold chain, global FSSC 22000 certification, backward integration through bio-secure poultry farms, and rigorous control over freshwater fish and seafood.With five state-of-the-art processing centres and an annual capacity of 36,000 tonnes, Licious now serves India’s top metros - Bengaluru, NCR, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai and Kolkata - through a strong online presence, expanding retail stores, and fast-growing quick commerce partnerships, including 30-minute delivery across major urban clusters. Over the years, the brand has reached 4.5 million customers, earning unmatched trust, quality leadership and a loyal following in a category long defined by guesswork.This unwavering focus on quality, innovation, and consumer obsession has made Licious India’s first D2C unicorn. Today, it stands as the country’s most loved, iconic D2C meat brand - elevating everyday meals, setting new benchmarks for safety and freshness, and building an ecosystem where farmers, meat technicians, supply partners and delivery heroes thrive alongside millions of delighted home cooks.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The National Institute for Nuclear Physics (INFN) is the Italian research agency dedicated to the study of the fundamental constituents of matter and the laws that govern them, under the supervision of the Ministry of Universities and Research. It conducts theoretical and experimental research in the fields of subnuclear, nuclear and astroparticle physics. All of the INFN’s research activities are undertaken within a framework of international competition, in close collaboration with Italian universities on the basis of solid academic partnerships spanning decades. Fundamental research in these areas requires the use of cutting-edge technology and instruments, developed by the INFN at its own laboratories and in collaboration with industries. Groups from the Universities of Rome, Padua, Turin, and Milan founded the INFN on 8thAugust 1951 to uphold and develop the scientific tradition established during the 1930s by Enrico Fermi and his school, with their theoretical and experimental research in nuclear physics. In the latter half of the 1950s the INFN designed and built the first Italian accelerator, the electron synchrotron developed in Frascati, where its first national laboratory was set up. During the same period, the INFN began to participate in research into the construction and use of ever-more powerful accelerators being conducted by CERN, the European Organisation for Nuclear Research, in Geneva. Today the INFN can count on the contribution of a community of 6000 people whose work is recognised internationally not only for their contribution to various European laboratories, but also to numerous research centres worldwide.
past.employee_description: Italian National Institute of Nuclear Physics

Our proprietary, academic-grade consumer research decodes how people actually choose in a category: their goals, trade-offs, and the limits under which a product shouldn't be recommended. We turn that into structured, verifiable product data and render it across the surfaces commerce is shifting toward:• Product Guide – an interactive advisor that leads shoppers to the right product on category and product pages• PDP Content System – per-SKU product content readable by people, Google, and AI agents alike• Consumer research, category trees, and filters – the decision structure underneathEvery value traces back to a verified source. No source, no claim. So nothing is invented, and responsible AI can recommend with confidence. It's infrastructure that complements your content and systems, never a rip-and-replace. And as AI gets better at shopping, it only needs cleaner, decision-grade data. Exactly what we make.For retailers, that means higher conversion and order value, fewer returns, and products that get found in the new AI-driven shopping journey. Consumer minds are stable; channels change fast. Because we build on consumer research, we're ready for whatever comes next.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Opsys has developed the world's most advanced Pure solid-state scanning LiDAR. Opsys’ technology uses fully addressable VCSEL arrays, combined with a single chip addressable CMOS SPAD array. No moving parts allow for a reliable solution that can operate 24/7. This ensures there are no mechanical failures over time, which increases the sensors’ lifetime expectancy (10+ yrs MTBF) well beyond any other solution on the market today. As such, all Opsys products come with an extended 5-yr warranty. The ALTOS (Advanced LiDAR Technology Opsys Sensor) is an all-in-one (perception, analysis & VMS integration) security solution. The Smart 4D LiDAR sensor enables unmatched accuracy (reduces false alarms), whilst built-in edge AI provides alerts in real time. The ALTOS brings all the benefits of LiDAR (e.g. depth perception and being GDPR compliant as no identifiable features are captured) but it is no more expensive than a camera set up. Opsys technology is especially designed to meet the myriads of demands in the security industry, ranging from critical infrastructure to data centers. The ALTOS is already in mass production. The ALTOS-IDIS (Intrusion Detection Intelligent Sensor), unveiled at ISC West 2026, is built on the ALTOS 4D LiDAR platform. Combining volumetric awareness with edge intelligence, ALTOS-IDIS detects, tracks, and classifies objects within defined zones, generating real-time intrusion alarms directly on the sensor without external compute. Given the ALTOS is a PoE, plug and play solution, it is easily scalable, which is particularly important in environments where simplicity, cost efficiency, and flexibility are key. For example, Smart Cities and Intelligent Traffic Systems (ITS). Opsys technology is affordable, accurate and robust and is built to transform legacy systems. All Opsys products are NEMA TS2 certified and BABA compliant. Founded in 2016, the company has major investment, is headquartered in Israel, with offices in USA, APAC & Europe

The ALTOS-IDIS (Intrusion Detection Intelligent Sensor), unveiled at ISC West 2026, is built on the ALTOS 4D LiDAR platform. Combining volumetric awareness with edge intelligence, ALTOS-IDIS detects, tracks, and classifies objects within defined zones, generating real-time intrusion alarms directly on the sensor without external compute. Given the ALTOS is a PoE, plug and play solution, it is easily scalable, which is particularly important in environments where simplicity, cost efficiency, and flexibility are key. For example, Smart Cities and Intelligent Traffic Systems (ITS). Opsys technology is affordable, accurate and robust and is built to transform legacy systems. All Opsys products are NEMA TS2 certified and BABA compliant. Founded in 2016, the company has major investment, is headquartered in Israel, with offices in USA, APAC & Europe

basic_profile.name: Ayush Verma
basic_profile.headline: 150+ Brands. $90M+ Organic Revenue. 15 Years. | SEO, Content & Demand Gen for B2B SaaS
basic_profile.summary: Most growth problems don't look like growth problems. Traffic is up and pipeline isn't. Content ships every week and nothing moves. A channel that worked for two years quietly stops, and nobody can say when it started. I've spent fifteen years working out why. Started in 2011, building blogs and web apps around what people were already searching for — because that was the only way to know something would sell before building it. That question never really changed. What are people searching, why that and not something else, and what makes them stay. Since then: 150+ brands. $90M+ in client revenue driven organically. $10M+ in ads managed, mostly to learn where paid stops being the answer. In-house at Netcore and AiTrillion, agency-side, and independent — which means the advice comes from having sat in every seat rather than one. What I'm building A search intelligence platform for B2B SaaS. Search Console, Analytics, and AI engine tracking joined into one picture, read against a decade of algorithm history. It's the diagnosis I've run by hand a few hundred times, turned into something that runs without me. What I do Ayush Verma & Co. Consulting for founders and leadership teams on SEO, content, demand generation, and go-to-market. Deep engagements, limited in number. I diagnose what's actually blocking growth, then stay through the part where it gets fixed. What I write about here Search intent. Why organic degrades silently. What a decade of Google updates actually taught me, including the parts I got wrong. And what changes now that the first reader of your content is a model rather than a person. Two pro-bono calls a month. Email at hi@ayushverma.co or DM me — it's the fastest way to see what a hundred different businesses are actually stuck on, which is where most of what I know came from. Pune. Occasionally teaching, still.

current.employee_description:
Building a search intelligence platform for B2B SaaS. In stealth since June 2026.
 
The problem: understanding where a brand actually stands in search means pulling from five places that don't talk to each other. Clicks in one tool. Sessions and conversions in another. Prompts and AI citations somewhere else entirely. Nobody has the whole picture, so most teams either pay someone to assemble it every month or work off a partial view and hope.
 
What's being built puts clicks, user data, session data and prompt data in one place — and tells you not just what moved, but why it moved.
 
That last part is where the proprietary work sits. Over 500 experiments in the last six months, built on top of a structured decade of algorithm history — what each change actually went after, what it rewarded, and which sites were exposed. The interpretation layer is ours.
 
The method underneath isn't new. It's the diagnosis I've run by hand for fifteen years across 150+ brands. Understand the product. Look at what's actually happening versus what the team believes is happening. Work out what changed and when. Then decide what gets created and what gets fixed.
 
Most of that is mechanical. This is the attempt to make it run without me.
 
Currently pre-launch, working with early users.
Already at $1500 MRR.
Launching for public soon!

past.employee_description:
I studied and conducted iterative experiments on anticancer effects of cytokine interleukin 24 (IL-24), or melanoma differentiation gene 7 (MDA-7) in a large wet-cell lab in the Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgery department.

I was graciously 100% hosted by Prof. Rajagopal Ramesh, Lab Head and PI, and supervised by him and Dr. Manish Shanker, Research Associate, all part of the Department of Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgery.

My research (I mean our, or really their, but using "my" as I was much more limited in scope in what I focused on) was based on both direct and indirect or unidentified effects of IL-24/MDA-7. Examples in descending order of "directness":

1. Selective apoptosis through various signaling pathways, such as endothelial cells via JAK/STAT and MAPK pathways.
2. Investigated better understood anti-angiogenesis through downregulation of pro-angiogenic factors, such as vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), in addition to lesser-understood basic fibroblast growth factor (bFGF).
3. Investigated its bystander effect, in which IL-24 induces apoptosis on untransfected neighboring cancer cells in addition to the cancer cells themselves when delivered via viral vectors.
4. Preliminary exploration into how the catabolic regulation IL-24 cytokine is orchestrated via ubiquitination and is subsequently mediated by the 26S proteasome complex.

This was one of two, maybe three, things that even remotely interested me academically in high school.

past.employee_title: Head of AI Innovation | Research, Integration of AI Algorithms, Multimodal Data, Distributed Systems
past.employee_description:
Surpassed state-of-the-art multimodal virtual, embodied, and physical (e.g., robotics) AI models on tasks provided in their works and more in (1) success rate, (2) training speed, (3) inference speed, (4) memory footprint, (5) generalization, and (6) robustness. See below for examples.

For generalization, we evaluate models on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks. For out-of-distribution, we include both tasks that are within the convex hull of seen tasks to test for interpolation and tasks that are outside of this to test for extrapolation.

For robustness, we evaluate models in various overarching cases. These include (a) general and localized brittleness without adversarial intent, (b) adversarial attacks of different levels of sophistication, a (i) fully-automated, (ii) human-in-the-loop, and (3) fully-human iterated attacks, and (c) data or feedback (e.g., RLHF) decay or misalignment.

Some models (all 2022 or later except for one from 2021) that our algorithms outperform include
1. GATO 
2. BC-Z
3. BC-Z XL (BC-Z scaled up to have same number of parameters as RT-1)
4. Multi-Game Decision Transformer
5. RT-1
6. RT-1-X,
7. RT-1-X-MAX, 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗼𝘄𝗻 fully-trained, maximum performance version of Google DeepMind's RT-1 model. We begin with DeepMind's publicly released RT-1-X model checkpoint and fully train it over a large number of different seeds.
8. RT-1-X-MAX-ENS, 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗼𝘄𝗻 ensemble of several of 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗼𝘄𝗻 RT-1-X-MAX models
9. RT-1-X-MAX-ENS-OPT-ENT, 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗼𝘄𝗻 maximum-performance version of 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗼𝘄𝗻 RT-1-X-MAX-ENS models. Maximum performance resulted from a notion of optimal entropy over model predictions comprising the ensemble.

All RT-1-X(-...) models were trained on the Open X-Embodiment Dataset. We're grateful to the authors, institutions, and sponsors of this dataset for moving us closer to foundation models for robotics, and we're further grateful to Google DeepMind for publicly-releasing their RT-1-X model checkpoint.

From building practice management software and helping doctors go digital to pioneering telemedicine before the pandemic, launching Clinic Excellence Scores for greater transparency, and now rolling out AI-powered tools to support clinical decision-making, Practo has stayed at the forefront of innovation. As technology becomes integral to healthcare, Practo plays a crucial role in helping doctors manage and securely store health data. Practo encrypts all data with 256-bit encryption, uses HIPAA-compliant data centres, and is ISO 27001 certified, making it one of the few healthcare companies to achieve this level of security. Demonstrating its commitment to the highest standards of medical quality and patient care, Practo became the first digital healthcare company to receive QAI accreditation for its medical quality. This prestigious accreditation underscores Practo's dedication to excellence in healthcare.Now operating in 22+ countries, Practo recently expanded its consumer platform to the UAE, building on its existing presence on the provider side. The platform has, to date, connected over 50 crore patients and now brings together more than 5 lakh doctors and healthcare providers across 900 cities. In the UAE alone, Practo now has over 50,000 monthly active users, with 3,000 healthcare facilities and 31,000+ doctors already live. This expansive reach and robust infrastructure generate a staggering ₹3,500 crore+ of value every year, underscoring Practo’s growing impact not just in India but across the global healthcare landscape.

basic_profile.summary: 𝗜 𝘄𝗮𝘀𝗻'𝘁 𝗽𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝗯𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗲 𝗮 𝗖𝗘𝗢. 𝗜 𝘄𝗮𝘀 𝗷𝘂𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗿𝘆𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝗳𝗶𝗴𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗵𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴𝘀 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸.⠀As a child, I asked "Why?" far more often than my teachers appreciated. I took things apart, questioned established answers, and read so much that my school librarian eventually suggested I find another library.⠀I almost became a doctor. But my father promised me a computer if I chose engineering.⠀𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗯𝗮𝗯𝗹𝘆 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗼𝘀𝘁 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝘂𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝗵𝗲 𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗿 𝗯𝗼𝘂𝗴𝗵𝘁. 😄⠀That curiosity took me through IBM, AT&T Bell Labs, Emerson, and the worlds of telecommunications, AI, robotics, and deep technology.⠀Along the way, I've built products, invented things, led teams, mentored entrepreneurs, invested in startups, and worked with remarkable people.⠀I've also had failures, sleepless nights, and discovered that the universe doesn't particularly care about my business plans.⠀𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗴𝗼𝗼𝗱 𝗻𝗲𝘄𝘀? 𝗜'𝗺 𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗰𝘂𝗿𝗶𝗼𝘂𝘀.⠀Today, I explore the frontiers of AI, particularly how rethinking its foundations could make technology more efficient, accessible, and meaningful.⠀Through 𝗧𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗮𝗺 𝗖𝗮𝗽𝗶𝘁𝗮𝗹, our family office, we invest in founders who dare to imagine a different future.⠀I believe great founders aren't necessarily those with polished presentations. They're the ones who care so deeply about a problem that walking away isn't an option.⠀Sometimes, what a founder needs most isn't another investor. It's someone who believes in them when things get difficult.⠀I'm a Forbes Technology Council member, inventor, researcher, entrepreneur, and occasionally a student again. I recently completed my M.Tech in AI because apparently, decades in technology weren't enough homework. 😊⠀𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗼𝗹𝗼𝗴𝘆 𝗶𝘀 𝗳𝗮𝘀𝗰𝗶𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴. 𝗣𝗲𝗼𝗽𝗹𝗲 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝘄𝗵𝘆 𝗶𝘁 𝗺𝗮𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘀.⠀My father taught me that even if I had to clean a floor, I should do it better than anyone else in the world. That lesson has stayed with me.⠀𝗗𝗼𝗻'𝘁 𝗰𝗵𝗮𝘀𝗲 𝘀𝘂𝗰𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀. 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝘀𝗲 𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴.⠀If you're a researcher challenging conventional wisdom, an entrepreneur chasing an impossible idea, or someone who believes the world can be better, I'd love to connect.⠀I don't promise to have all the answers. But I can almost guarantee I'll have a few questions. 😊⠀𝗦𝘁𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗰𝘂𝗿𝗶𝗼𝘂𝘀. 𝗦𝘁𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴. 𝗝𝘂𝘀𝘁 𝗴𝗲𝘁𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗲𝗱.

basic_profile.name: Leena Nair (She/Her)
basic_profile.headline: Founder & Chief Executive Officer @ Black Panda | Healthcare | Education | Tech
basic_profile.summary: Leena Nair is the Co-Founder and CEO of Black Panda, a business-building company that partners with founders and organisations to validate, build, operate, and scale businesses across healthcare, education, AI, technology, and global services.With over 20 years of leadership experience, Leena has built and scaled operations across startups and multinational organisations, specialising in business strategy, operational excellence, commercialisation, customer experience, Global Capability Centres (GCCs), and growth. Before founding Black Panda, she held leadership positions with organisations including Zocdoc and CureMD, where she led large-scale operations, digital transformation initiatives, and global delivery teams.In 2023, Leena co-founded Black Panda after recognising a recurring pattern across the startup ecosystem: most businesses do not fail because they lack ideas, but because they struggle to validate, operationalise, commercialise, and scale them effectively. Black Panda was created to bridge that gap by combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution, working as an extension of founders and leadership teams rather than as traditional consultants.Today, Black Panda has worked with more than 100 businesses across India and internationally, supporting ventures from early-stage validation through profitable growth. The company has built deep expertise in healthcare, education, AI, and technology, while helping businesses develop scalable operating models, productisation strategies, franchise systems, go-to-market plans, sales functions, marketing engines, and fractional leadership capabilities.Leena is also leading the development of ZAII, Black Panda’s AI-powered business operating platform. Built using insights from years of real-world consulting and operating experience, ZAII is designed to help founders diagnose business challenges, identify the highest-impact opportunities, and make better strategic and operational decisions through practical, guided intelligence.Her work is driven by a simple belief: great businesses are not built by chance. They are built through disciplined execution, continuous learning, and systems that allow people and organisations to grow sustainably. Through Black Panda, Leena’s mission is to help founders build businesses that are resilient, scalable, and built to last while making world-class business expertise accessible to entrepreneurs everywhere.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Elementyl Intelligence is a boutique AI consulting practice built on a straightforward premise: the way you build AI is just as important as what you build with it.Founded by Anne Cantera, a practitioner with 20+ years in UX and conversation design, the practice brings together a curated team of specialists across agentic AI, voice and conversation design, and custom AI solutions. No generalists. No juniors on your account. The people doing your work are the right people for your work.The ethical framing here is not a marketing layer. It shows up in how engagements are structured. Responsible AI strategy means auditing not just what a system can do but what it should do, who it might harm, and what safeguards are non-negotiable before deployment. It means building human intervention into agent workflows by design, not as an afterthought.Services span the full implementation arc: AI strategy and readiness assessment, agent design and orchestration, conversation and voice AI, IVR modernization, corporate training, and custom solutions tailored to your actual context. Elementyl serves small to mid-size businesses across industries, with a particular depth in high-stakes conversation experiences where a poorly designed AI costs real people real time and trust.The practice also holds an education mandate. VoiceofAI.io, Elementyl's free bootcamp for designers and non-technical builders, reflects a belief that responsible AI literacy should not be gated behind enterprise budgets.The tagline is not accidental: Responsible AI Consulting by Design. Design is the operative word. Ethics, safety, and human experience are not compliance checkboxes. They are the methodology.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Elementyl Intelligence is a boutique AI consulting practice built on a straightforward premise: the way you build AI is just as important as what you build with it.Founded by Anne Cantera, a practitioner with 20+ years in UX and conversation design, the practice brings together a curated team of specialists across agentic AI, voice and conversation design, and custom AI solutions. Our mission is to help more people start better startups.ODF is a program we created over four years ago to help those at the exploration stage of starting a company. So far, we've helped over 1000 companies get started and raise over $2 billion.Starting a company is really exciting, but there are so many things you need to figure out in order to actually build one.- "Who might I start my company with?"- “What might we build?”- “Who might our initial customers be?”- “Should we raise funding soon, or should we try to bootstrap in the beginning?"These and many more questions are what we refer to as the "missing pieces"—the things you need to figure out to know if starting a company is right for you and what company you should ultimately build.With ODF, we bring together 80 to 100 people who are at the very same stage as you. They're all exceptionally talented, and they're all trying to figure it out together.

These challenges can include high latency on the network, support of end point mobility, loss of connectivity, unpredictable bandwidth bottlenecks and distributed coordination of systems and clients.  With an architecture that enables end-user clients or near-user edge devices to carry out computation, communication, control and storage, fog computing can enable rapid innovation, client-centric objectives, pooling of local resources, and real-time processing in cyber-physical systems.  OpenFog's global membership of industry-university organizations are collaborating to create an open, interoperable and secure horizontal architecture for fog computing.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The U.S. National Science Foundation (NSF) is an independent federal agency created by Congress in 1950 "to promote the progress of science; to advance the national health, prosperity, and welfare; to secure the national defense..." With an annual budget of more than $8 billion, NSF is the funding source for approximately 20 percent of all federally supported basic research conducted by America’s colleges and universities. In many fields, such as mathematics, computer science, and the social sciences, NSF is the major source of federal backing. NSF awards about 11,000 new awards per year, with an average duration of three years -- to fund specific research proposals that have been judged the most promising by a rigorous and objective merit-review system. In the past few decades, NSF-funded researchers have won more than 200 Nobel Prizes as well as other honors too numerous to list. NSF funds equipment that is needed by scientists and engineers but is often too expensive for any one group or researcher to afford. Another essential element in NSF's mission is support for science and engineering education, from pre-K through graduate school and beyond. There are many exciting careers at NSF, not only in science, technology, education and mathematics (STEM), but also in business and operations. For more information, please visit us at http://nsf.gov/careers/.NSF welcomes opportunities to engage with you on our LinkedIn page. Please see our Comment Policy [http://www.nsf.gov/social/policies.jsp ] for more information.

current.employer_linkedin_description: For the last two decades, electrical neurostimulation has been an established therapy widely used as a last resort for patients with various neurological and psychiatric illnesses. Typically in cases where pharmacological options have been exhausted and where neurostimulation offers a more reversible option compared for example to surgical lesioning of the brain.Today this technology is used in Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS), Spinal Cord Stimulation (SCS) and Vagal Nerve Stimulation (VNS), however, all have limitations that prevent a broader usage.Existing technologies are highly invasive, requires implanted batteries and are so far depending on physician intervention to adjust and ensure optimal treatment.Cenexum’s solution combines key features for safe and effective treatment and patient convenience. These are:- Intelligent and stand-alone miniatured implantable device enabling bio-inspired data processing and stimulation in a closed loop- Wireless communication via mild electrical impulses between microscale-implant device and external unit- Wirelessly powered implantable device enabling long lasting solution for the patient without need for implanted battery- Less complexity for neurosurgeons and the patient- Suitable for implantation at the core location of the disease to treat

past.employer_linkedin_description: About Aarhus UniversityAarhus University is a leading international research university covering all scientific areas with a staff of 11.000 employees and 44.500 students, the majority are post-graduate students enrolled on Master’s and PhD programmes. Aarhus University is among the top 100 universities in the world. The aim of the university is to sustain and enhance a high standard in both research and education, which has placed it among the international elite. Aarhus University was established in 1928 as a small private initiative. It has since grown to become a leading public research university with international reach covering all academic fields and address basic, applied and strategic research as well as the research-based consultancy provided to public authorities and private business. One of Aarhus University’s focus areas is talent development. An activity considered so important that it is singled out as one of the four core activities in the Aarhus University strategy alongside excellent research, world-class education and inspiring research-based consultancy. Research at Aarhus University is both organised in traditional departments under the four faculties and in interdisciplinary research centres. In addition, Aarhus University researchers engage in research collaboration under the auspices of Knowledge Management Centres with external partners such as government organisations, private enterprises, NGOs and Aarhus University’s wide range of international partner universities.

Det gäller att matcha förutsättningarna med ett införandeprojekt som är anpassat efter situationen. past.employer_linkedin_description: IFEN GmbH, a Bavarian based company,  provides innovative and leading edge GNSS testing products for the satellite navigation market, for example•GNSS Simulators•RF Signal generators•Test Receivers•GPS, QZSS, SBAS, GALILEO Signal Simulation•navigation test environments•and many more.IFEN, founded in 1998, was starting up with service contracts on EGNOS development, later also on Galileo. The scope of activities for service contracts covers GNSS system studies and analysis, development of algorithms, software and facilities, even up to turnkey systems like the Galileo test range GATE. Service contracts in all fields of GNSS remain an important source of work, turnover and know-how for us until today. Since 2003, IFEN is also working on navigation products, with the first commercial GNSS RF-signal simulator available in the end of 2007. As a result of our entrance to the commercial market, our growth in staff and experience was boosted tremendously. This not at least as a consequence of our role as a reliable but flexible, small but strong player committed to service and usability on a market that was dominated by a quasi-monopolistic competitor for a long time before. Today IFEN is positioned as a provider of leading-edge software and hardware products for RF satellite navigation. The primary products are the NavX family of GNSS test solutions and the SX scientific software receiver.

basic_profile.name: Maria Axente
basic_profile.headline: Making the invisible visible | Seeing around the corners of technological change | Founder, Responsible Intelligence
basic_profile.summary:
I founded Responsible Intelligence to help AI companies, investors, and enterprises turn Responsible AI into growth, not red tape.

My work today is centred on advisory - supporting AI builders to prove they are enterprise-ready, helping investors protect and grow their portfolios, and guiding leaders who need to bring trust into their systems without losing momentum.

Alongside this, I am shaping the roadmap for a platform that will set Responsible AI as the new standard for growth. The advisory work funds it, informs it, and keeps me close to the real challenges companies face. Every engagement, every blind spot uncovered, every conversation with leaders becomes part of the foundation for what I’m building.

I’ve spent years at the frontlines of this field leading Responsible AI at PwC, advising NATO, UNICEF, and governments, and working with global enterprises navigating AI risk. The same truth emerged everywhere: when Responsible AI is treated as paperwork, companies stall, but when it is embraced as strategy aligned with organisational goals and vision, they scale and grow. Sustainably

Responsible Intelligence is how I act on that truth. It delivers impact for clients today, while quietly building the platform that will carry this vision forward in the years to come.

basic_profile.name: Eugina Jordan
basic_profile.headline: CEO and Founder YOUnifiedAI I 9 granted patents/16 pending I TechCrunch Startup Battlefield 200
basic_profile.summary: I build categories, companies, and technologies that change how businesses operate.I began my career answering phones in telecom. Today, I’m an inventor with more than two dozen patents and patent applications across my career, an award-winning former B2B CMO, a TEDx speaker, and a founder building the operating layer that disconnected businesses have been missing.I’m the Founder and CEO of YOUnifiedAI. We eliminate the manual reconciliation required to understand revenue, cash, customers, and operations across disconnected business systems. Built for franchises, multi-location operators, and service SMBs, YOUnifiedAI connects the accounting, CRM, payroll, scheduling, payments, dispatch, and other tools businesses already use. Our normalization and governance layer resolves entities and relationships across those systems, giving operators accurate answers and automated workflows—without replacing their software or hiring analysts.Our first live franchise operation is already recovering 5–7 hours per week. We are working with paying SMB customers, franchise operators, and public-sector stakeholders to solve real operational reconciliation problems: from lead-to-revenue tracking and unpaid invoices to payroll validation and operational reporting.YOUnifiedAI’s momentum includes:→ Selected for TechCrunch Startup Battlefield 200 as one of the world’s most promising early-stage startups—making YOUnifiedAI the first South Carolina-based company selected → Named Most Fundable Company through the Launchpad Accelerator→ Accepted into Google for Startups→ Selected for SC FORGE → Nine YOUnifiedAI patent applications pending across correlation, normalization, governance, and agentic orchestration→ Partnerships and market access supporting SMB and franchise adoption→ A growing library of more than 200 specialized AI agents and workflowsBefore founding YOUnifiedAI, I spent 23 years building and scaling enterprise technology companies.I helped scale a startup from $0 to  $30M in revenue, built the positioning and partner strategy that contributed to Starent Networks’ $2.9B acquisition by Cisco, led communications surrounding Starent’s IPO and NASDAQ opening bell, and designed and executed Cisco’s “Tomorrow starts here” global rebrand.I also helped create and commercialize the Open RAN category, work that taught me how transformative technologies move from being questioned to becoming inevitable.I’ve spent my career connecting networks. Now I’m connecting businesses.Let’s talk about how YOUnifiedAI can help your business.

basic_profile.name: Muhammad Aly
basic_profile.headline: Connecting Elite Product, AI & Engineering Talent with the World’s Top Hedge Funds, HFTs & AI Firms | Durlston Partners | Dubai
basic_profile.summary:
I've called the UAE home for the past 12 years, but my recruitment journey spans 18 years across APAC and MENA. Over that time, I've built a reputation as the go-to person for scaling digital and product teams across some of the region's most ambitious organisations. Now, I'm taking that same approach, and the same network, into hedge funds, HFTs, and AI-driven firms, where my focus is squarely on product, AI, and engineering talent.

My core focus is product, AI, and engineering talent. I work on senior and strategic appointments across product management, AI/ML engineering, software engineering, and technical leadership. Whether it's a Head of Product, a Principal ML Engineer, or a Founding CTO, I know how to find and engage the kind of people who don't just fill a role; they define it.

At Durlston Partners, we have partnered with some of the world's most sophisticated investment firms, quant shops, and AI-native businesses, as well as the fast-moving startups that are building the next generation of intelligent products. That's where I thrive: high-stakes, high-performance environments where the calibre of the hire genuinely moves the needle.

What sets me apart? My network. It's not just global; it's personal. I've had coffee, Zoom calls, or shisha with talent in every major tech and finance hub: product leaders in London, quant engineers in Singapore, AI researchers in San Francisco, and technical founders in Dubai.

To stay ahead in a shifting landscape, I'm constantly learning, experimenting with the latest AI tools, building side projects, and speaking with industry leaders about what's shaping the future of intelligent systems and the teams that build them.

When I'm not recruiting, I'm probably on a padel court, building Lego (with a collection that rivals most toy stores), collecting sneakers, or deep in conversation over shisha. If you want a competitive game of padel, or a chat about AI, product, and tech over a shisha or some good food, flick me a private message.

basic_profile.summary: I am a founder and builder focused on creating the infrastructure layer for the AI economy. Through my ventures, I am building AI infrastructure and AI-first companies that enable businesses and developers to access, integrate, and scale advanced AI capabilities through unified, reliable, and scalable platforms. current.employee_description:
The Trilateral Commission is a global membership organization that for decades has brought together senior policymakers, business leaders, and representatives of media and academe to discuss and propose solutions to some of the world’s toughest problems. Founded in 1973 by David Rockefeller, the Commission has long been an important venue to incubate ideas and form relationships across sectors and geographies.

Yet with changing times and the proliferation of similar groups, the leadership of the organization – across its three pillars of North America, Europe, and Asia – has critically examined the Commission and instituted changes in order to rejuvenate the Commission and increase its impact. In particular, we have sharpened our mission and returned to our roots as a group of countries sharing common values and a commitment to the rule of law, open economies and societies, and democratic principles. We acknowledge that, today, our societies are grappling with difficult social, economic, technological, and political issues that are causing deep cleavages at home.

current.employer_linkedin_description: KROG is a universal mathematical framework that brings clarity, transparency, and determinism to any rule-based system.After 30 years of research, KROG answers four fundamental questions:🔵 K — Knowledge: What can you KNOW?🟢 R — Rights: What CAN you do?🟠 O — Obligation: What MUST you do?🟣 G — Governance: HOW are decisions made?The framework is built on deontic modal logic and validated by category theory. It provides:7 T-types (agent states) — what agents can/must/cannot do35 R-types (relationships) — mathematically exhaustive bilateral patternsModal operators — P() permissions, O() obligations, F() prohibitionsCross-domain reasoning — the same patterns work from physics to financeKROG serves as a meta-language. Domain-specific rule languages like ODRL, LegalRuleML, and OWL all map to KROG's relationship types, enabling cross-domain reasoning that wasn't possible before.The KROG Theorem: (K ∩ R ∩ O) ⊆ GKnowledge, Rights, and Obligations must operate within Governance.We work with organizations building:✓ AI agent authorization systems✓ Smart contracts with legal grounding✓ Business workflow compliance✓ Privacy and consent management✓ Game mechanics and DeFi protocolsIf ambiguity costs your organization time, money, or trust—KROG provides the mathematical foundation for rules that actually work.🌐 krogrules.com📧 hello@signatu.com

basic_profile.summary: I started my career sleeping on concrete bricks. I got paid pennies for 15 hours of work, seven days a week. That job ended in late 2017 when GST and demonetization hit the construction industry. Then during the COVID pandemic I welcomed my daughter into this world, and started a delivery business with my wife, I built from nothing. We baked cakes, delivered groceries, and made it work for seven months. And when restrictions lifted, people went back to shops and the business disappeared overnight. Sitting with that, I asked myself one question: what would actually make me hireable? That question sent me into a rabbit hole; LinkedIn, resumes, job search outreach, and eventually I realized that an interview is also a sales conversation. A resume is also sales deck. I dove into sales systems and psychology. I became obsessed with understanding why most outreach fails and what actually moves a qualified prospect toward a conversation. I started writing resumes for people who felt stuck. I started building outbound systems for companies whose pipeline had dried up. The same problem kept showing up on both sides. Most people and most companies are not failing because of a lack of effort. They are doing the right things with no system underneath. So I built systems. Today I run The Ascension Company. On the GTM side, I have generated $50M+ in pipeline for B2B clients, expanded total addressable markets by 10x through data enrichment and outbound automation, and helped drive Sendr.ai to the number two spot on Product Hunt. On the career side, I have grown my LinkedIn audience to 75K+ followers organically, written 1,000+ resumes and reviewed thousands more improved, and coached jobseekers at every career stage, plus helped my clients land jobs at some of the largest companies in the world. If you are a founder or sales leader who wants outbound that works, DM me. Also DM me if you are a professional figuring out your next career move.

past.employee_description:
My first full-time role. A construction site. Early mornings. Cement dust. Sinusitis that made every shift a physical challenge. 6,500 rupees a month for 15 hours of work, seven days a week.

I supervised construction of commercial complexes from blueprint to build. I interpreted architectural, structural, electrical, and plumbing drawings. I ensured quality workmanship across block work, DPC, steel mesh, and concrete works. I managed contractor coordination, material inspections, and safety compliance. I maintained daily work records, material stock, and time sheets.

GST and demonetization hit the industry hard in late 2017, and I was laid off. That door closed and I started looking for a different one.

I taught science to 9th and 10th graders, maths to 6th graders, and English and Home Science to 11th graders. Around 200 students and 30 staff across a dual curriculum covering religious education and CBSE academics.

I designed lessons, administered tests, tracked student performance, and watched people grow over time.

Teaching confirmed something outbound later reinforced: clarity of communication is a skill you build, not a trait you either have or don't.

I led a school and managed a team of 25 staff. The job taught me that operational discipline is the same whether you are running a construction site or a classroom.

I increased company performance by over 20% in one year through operational improvements. Employee performance went up 15% through relationship building and clearer accountability structures. I saved 500+ administrative hours annually through better scheduling and process design, and saved two additional hours of combined employee time daily by reorganizing the office layout. I standardized all internal and client-facing documentation across branding, tone, and templates.

No job with a newborn daughter at a city in lockdown.

I started a delivery service out of necessity. My wife taught me to bake, we hand-delivered cakes and donuts across town, collaborated with local wholesalers, and built something real in seven months.

But when the restrictions were lifted, people went back to shops, and the need disappeared overnight.

Sitting with that uncertainty, I asked myself a question that changed everything: what would actually make me hireable? What is LinkedIn? Do resumes really matter?

That question led to everything that came after.

basic_profile.summary: I build and run companies where technology changes how business works. I started in 1999, rode the internet, cloud and mobile waves, and now spend my days on applied artificial intelligence (AI).  As CEO of Talent Garden Italy I lead campuses, advanced digital education and B2B transformation programs for corporates, with one priority: a disciplined, scalable business built for what comes next.  With Antifragile, the advisory and seed investment firm I founded in 2016, I advise boards and public institutions on AI adoption and invest in early-stage companies. basic_profile.headline: Commercial growth & transformation architect & hands-on operator | Scales disruptor tech/mission-led organisations(B2C/B2B) after ​years of marketing/sales success growing small to large | AI-wise | Passionately curious
basic_profile.summary: A mission-focused, results-driven commercial transformer, I offer extensive global client-side/agency hands-on and management experience (B2B2C, B2C) of driving growth and exceeding OKRs for technology pioneers, impact organisations and disruptors. Inherently curious, I was an early proponent of digital technology and pioneered AI-driven, agile sales and marketing. Having launched professional versions of Adobe flagship products when digital was in its infancy, I led the team that introduced one of the 1st e-commerce systems at PhotoDisc, a start-up subsequently taken over by Getty Images because of its sales success (£1M/day in profits when I left). I then helped grow Alamy, an amateur content provider marketplace acquired in 2021 by PA Media, from £9K ARR when I joined the Board to £48M ARR four years later. Reflecting on my lifelong interest in health, I went on to help the NHS save  £ millions and improve outcomes by introducing the first interactive symptom checkers/body maps. I also initiated online patient research/monitoring when transitioning WPP agencies to digital, pioneered online wellbeing-at-work (Barclays) and launched the 1st healthy nutrition apps (British Heart Foundation). Additionally, I successfully introduced digital solutions and agile operational processes into legacy, regulated biotech and nutrition/food industries. Recently, I have focused on helping impact/disruptor tech SMEs thrive, with successes including B2C/B2B SaaS SkinVision($1B+valuation) and chronic health SaMD Wellthy Therapeutics (acquired with 10M+ reach), and MacRabur, an award-winning sustainable polymer provider whose products are now used in 30+ countries. I’ve also mentored C-level entrepreneurs through Virgin Startup/LinkedIn (selected from thousands), and start-up/scale-up hubs for the NHS and Hatch Enterprise. My commitment to mentorship extends into my spare time; I am a qualified England Athletics running coach and a Parkrun 'pacer'. I am told that I 'make things happen' and that I am an 'inspirational, energetic, empathetic leader'.  I've been lucky enough to collaborate with great people during my career, many of whom I have worked with more than once. I also thrive on team building and making a difference with others in challenging, uncertain circumstances with limited resources. I feel it is also essential to keep on learning; I achieved a distinction for a Fast-Track MBA I studied for while working full-time and have upgraded AI qualifications.

basic_profile.name: Marshall Berenbaum
basic_profile.headline: Senior Technical Recruiter/Talent Acquisition Specialist | Connecting People & Opportunities!
basic_profile.summary: It would be nice to say that I always dreamed of being a Technical Recruiter/Talent Acquisition Specialist(Headhunter), I have to be honest - as a kid, I was probably more interested in video games and sports!  However, as someone who's naturally empathetic and loves solving puzzles, I found myself drawn to the world of recruiting (the real story is I kind of stumbled into it) but the truth is, I couldn't be happier with where it's led me.My approach comes down to trying my best to understand the intrinsic needs of both candidates and clients.  While I specialize in the tech industry, I will never shy away from a challenge and navigating the fast-paced, ever evolving world with enthusiasm and adaptability.  Whether it's a cutting-edge startup or an established tech giant, I work tirelessly to ensure the right talent finds the right role!Here’s what I do best: *Help tech startups and global companies scale by finding top-tier talent across Engineering, AI/ML, Product, Cybersecurity, Big Data, and more.*Partner with stakeholders to solve hiring puzzles, refine recruiting strategies, and deliver measurable results through data-driven insights.*Guide hiring teams to navigate market challenges, from streamlining processes to fostering diverse, high-performing teams.*Provide candidates with an exceptional experience, supporting them through every stage of their career journey.*I’m also a people-focused leader, with 10 years of experience managing and mentoring recruitment teams. I love coaching others to achieve success and creating systems that make hiring smarter, faster, and more effective.Outside of work, you'll find me exploring nature and spending quailty time with my family, I also enjoy food, and the culinary world, both in restaurants and in my own kitchen.  I'm always up for adventure, and I once went spear-fishing in Mexico and managed to get a Jack-fish within the first hour of our excursion... it was the most sumptuous fish I've ever eaten in my life.  As a proud parent of three wonderful kids, family time is a huge priority. If you’re a founder or hiring leader looking for guidance - or a professional exploring your next big opportunity - let’s connect.  I’m here to listen to your story, offer advice, and, if I can’t help directly, point you in the right direction.

basic_profile.summary:
𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟭: 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐡𝐨𝐨𝐝
I suffered in my health for the first 16 years because at a deeper level, I didn’t know my self-worth and thus, I feel kids born in challenging families actually have a better chance to win in life. I wanted that chance; thus, I left home & that comfort at 16. 

𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟮 : 𝐌𝐮𝐦𝐛𝐚𝐢 𝐭𝐨 𝐌𝐢𝐚𝐦𝐢 - 𝐟𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐦𝐲 𝐯𝐨𝐢𝐜𝐞

Landing up in Mumbai was the Universe’s plan; I found ‘vada pavs’ and my voice. I was there when the legendary floods hit on July 26th 2005 & I saw the city fight- we all walked…the next walk in life though was a ‘7 sea leap’- to Miami, USA. One man-Xose Alvarez Alfonso, changed my life FOREVER- I lost my friend, my advisor, & the 2nd most beautiful spirit I know to cancer, but I committed to helping others. I went from being a sick introvert with doctors in childhood to being fit, positive, and capable- all because of that 1 man. I got more American than my peers & I experienced some of the best life has to offer in travel & philosophy. 

𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟯: 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐄𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐮𝐫 (𝐑𝐚𝐠𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐡𝐞𝐬)

I sold door to door from San Jose to San Fran in 2009 (no salaries, pure comission). Doing that in an economy like that for 1 year, I realized I can be an entrepreneur. So, I came back to India, sold for a while via cold calling, in person meetings, & online to eventually start my 1st business into food & coffee. I failed and fell right on the floor with $100 remaining & a credit card debt of $700…..I went to the beach, and I made the decision to start MotivationalDiaries.com in 2015 under depression….the rest, as they say, is history. I fought every day in circumstances on the dark side which build character, make you realize value of each & every penny, and build humility. I got there because I fought every day…

𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐰𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐧𝐞𝐜𝐭 ?

If you have a purpose & if you have had mental & emotional circumstances to overcome, I think you & I connecting is written. I know what it means to be rich from family, but poor inside; I know what it means to be poor in money, but rich in soul; and in this chapter of my life, I now understand what it means to be rich as self-made and healthy-emotionally, physically & spiritually. I still have to fight everyday with the ‘poverty’ out there to go to my next level, but I try to do that through my meditations, my workout & my work as a sales & leadership coach to CEOs & their teams which fuel positive energy in me. I am at coach@motivationaldiaries.com

basic_profile.headline: CEO and Founder YOUnifiedAI I 9 granted patents/16 pending I TechCrunch Startup Battlefield 200
basic_profile.summary: I build categories, companies, and technologies that change how businesses operate.I began my career answering phones in telecom. Today, I’m an inventor with more than two dozen patents and patent applications across my career, an award-winning former B2B CMO, a TEDx speaker, and a founder building the operating layer that disconnected businesses have been missing.I’m the Founder and CEO of YOUnifiedAI. We eliminate the manual reconciliation required to understand revenue, cash, customers, and operations across disconnected business systems. Built for franchises, multi-location operators, and service SMBs, YOUnifiedAI connects the accounting, CRM, payroll, scheduling, payments, dispatch, and other tools businesses already use. Our normalization and governance layer resolves entities and relationships across those systems, giving operators accurate answers and automated workflows—without replacing their software or hiring analysts.Our first live franchise operation is already recovering 5–7 hours per week. We are working with paying SMB customers, franchise operators, and public-sector stakeholders to solve real operational reconciliation problems: from lead-to-revenue tracking and unpaid invoices to payroll validation and operational reporting.YOUnifiedAI’s momentum includes:→ Selected for TechCrunch Startup Battlefield 200 as one of the world’s most promising early-stage startups—making YOUnifiedAI the first South Carolina-based company selected → Named Most Fundable Company through the Launchpad Accelerator→ Accepted into Google for Startups→ Selected for SC FORGE → Nine YOUnifiedAI patent applications pending across correlation, normalization, governance, and agentic orchestration→ Partnerships and market access supporting SMB and franchise adoption→ A growing library of more than 200 specialized AI agents and workflowsBefore founding YOUnifiedAI, I spent 23 years building and scaling enterprise technology companies.I helped scale a startup from $0 to  $30M in revenue, built the positioning and partner strategy that contributed to Starent Networks’ $2.9B acquisition by Cisco, led communications surrounding Starent’s IPO and NASDAQ opening bell, and designed and executed Cisco’s “Tomorrow starts here” global rebrand.I also helped create and commercialize the Open RAN category, work that taught me how transformative technologies move from being questioned to becoming inevitable.I’ve spent my career connecting networks. Now I’m connecting businesses.Let’s talk about how YOUnifiedAI can help your business.

past.employee_description:
UNLIMITED is a leadership book for women, people of color, and immigrants aspiring to become leaders in corporate America. UNLIMITED is the Winner of 3 awards: 
--Winner of the International Impact Awards, 
--distinguished favorite in the leadership category at the Independent Press Awards,
-- literary excellence winner in the business category with PenCraft Awards.

This book is a guide to how to become a leader supported by inspiring stories from underrepresented people who have successfully climbed up the corporate ladder. The book features success stories across a diverse set of industries: telecom, including sports, pharma, entertainment, and finance. These accomplished leaders started from the bottom and worked their way up to the executive level by shattering the limitations imposed on them. They refused to let their background, gender or race hold them back and instead claimed their rightful place at the table. Readers will discover the secrets to breaking through barriers and achieving their full potential in their careers and will be given frameworks and steps how they can achieve it themselves.

Accompanying each chapter are journaling exercises and frameworks that provide readers with practical tools to apply the lessons they learn. UNLIMITED delivers a powerful message of empowerment and encourages readers to take responsibility for their success, overcome obstacles, & realize their full potential.

Eugina wrote this book with the hope of changing the face of leadership and bringing more diverse faces to the workplace. Whether someone is just starting their career, in the middle of it, or an ally who wants to help others succeed, this book is the inspiration & practical guidance needed to be successful.

If you are an ally, this book will show you how you can help, so we can all shape a more inclusive future for all of us.

Purchase here https://www.amazon.com/UNLIMITED-Seventeen-Success-Workplace-Designed/dp/B0C87SCZNL/

current.employer_linkedin_description: Gamers now spend more time watching games than playing them. 8.5 hours watching. 7.4 hours playing. 200 billion hours a year, stuck behind glass.That's not a content problem. That's a format problem.Ludeo built the technology to solve it. Our GGM (Generative Gameplay-state Model) turns any gaming video, stream, or text description into an instantly playable moment in the real game. The GGM generates a game state data file - the game's art is never touched. That file loads into a dedicated cloud-hosted game build and renders in the real engine. Nothing approximated. Nothing modified. The real game, instantly.Trusted by the studios that define the industry. 50+ patent claims filed. Built by a team with decades inside Activision Blizzard, Microsoft Gaming, and Disney.Audio was for listening. Video was for watching. Ludeo is for playing.

basic_profile.summary: I started my career sleeping on concrete bricks. I got paid pennies for 15 hours of work, seven days a week. That job ended in late 2017 when GST and demonetization hit the construction industry. Then during the COVID pandemic I welcomed my daughter into this world, and started a delivery business with my wife, I built from nothing. We baked cakes, delivered groceries, and made it work for seven months. And when restrictions lifted, people went back to shops and the business disappeared overnight. Sitting with that, I asked myself one question: what would actually make me hireable? That question sent me into a rabbit hole; LinkedIn, resumes, job search outreach, and eventually I realized that an interview is also a sales conversation. A resume is also sales deck. I dove into sales systems and psychology. I became obsessed with understanding why most outreach fails and what actually moves a qualified prospect toward a conversation. I started writing resumes for people who felt stuck. I started building outbound systems for companies whose pipeline had dried up. The same problem kept showing up on both sides. Most people and most companies are not failing because of a lack of effort. They are doing the right things with no system underneath. So I built systems. Today I run The Ascension Company. On the GTM side, I have generated $50M+ in pipeline for B2B clients, expanded total addressable markets by 10x through data enrichment and outbound automation, and helped drive Sendr.ai to the number two spot on Product Hunt. On the career side, I have grown my LinkedIn audience to 75K+ followers organically, written 1,000+ resumes and reviewed thousands more improved, and coached jobseekers at every career stage, plus helped my clients land jobs at some of the largest companies in the world. If you are a founder or sales leader who wants outbound that works, DM me. Also DM me if you are a professional figuring out your next career move.

past.employee_description:
My first full-time role. A construction site. Early mornings. Cement dust. Sinusitis that made every shift a physical challenge. 6,500 rupees a month for 15 hours of work, seven days a week.

I supervised construction of commercial complexes from blueprint to build. I interpreted architectural, structural, electrical, and plumbing drawings. I ensured quality workmanship across block work, DPC, steel mesh, and concrete works. I managed contractor coordination, material inspections, and safety compliance. I maintained daily work records, material stock, and time sheets.

GST and demonetization hit the industry hard in late 2017, and I was laid off. That door closed and I started looking for a different one.

I taught science to 9th and 10th graders, maths to 6th graders, and English and Home Science to 11th graders. Around 200 students and 30 staff across a dual curriculum covering religious education and CBSE academics.

I designed lessons, administered tests, tracked student performance, and watched people grow over time.

Teaching confirmed something outbound later reinforced: clarity of communication is a skill you build, not a trait you either have or don't.

I led a school and managed a team of 25 staff. The job taught me that operational discipline is the same whether you are running a construction site or a classroom.

I increased company performance by over 20% in one year through operational improvements. Employee performance went up 15% through relationship building and clearer accountability structures. I saved 500+ administrative hours annually through better scheduling and process design, and saved two additional hours of combined employee time daily by reorganizing the office layout. I standardized all internal and client-facing documentation across branding, tone, and templates.

No job with a newborn daughter at a city in lockdown.

I started a delivery service out of necessity. My wife taught me to bake, we hand-delivered cakes and donuts across town, collaborated with local wholesalers, and built something real in seven months.

But when the restrictions were lifted, people went back to shops, and the need disappeared overnight.

Sitting with that uncertainty, I asked myself a question that changed everything: what would actually make me hireable? What is LinkedIn? Do resumes really matter?

That question led to everything that came after.

basic_profile.summary:
𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟭: 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐡𝐨𝐨𝐝
I suffered in my health for the first 16 years because at a deeper level, I didn’t know my self-worth and thus, I feel kids born in challenging families actually have a better chance to win in life. I wanted that chance; thus, I left home & that comfort at 16. 

𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟮 : 𝐌𝐮𝐦𝐛𝐚𝐢 𝐭𝐨 𝐌𝐢𝐚𝐦𝐢 - 𝐟𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐦𝐲 𝐯𝐨𝐢𝐜𝐞

Landing up in Mumbai was the Universe’s plan; I found ‘vada pavs’ and my voice. I was there when the legendary floods hit on July 26th 2005 & I saw the city fight- we all walked…the next walk in life though was a ‘7 sea leap’- to Miami, USA. One man-Xose Alvarez Alfonso, changed my life FOREVER- I lost my friend, my advisor, & the 2nd most beautiful spirit I know to cancer, but I committed to helping others. I went from being a sick introvert with doctors in childhood to being fit, positive, and capable- all because of that 1 man. I got more American than my peers & I experienced some of the best life has to offer in travel & philosophy. 

𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟯: 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐄𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐮𝐫 (𝐑𝐚𝐠𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐡𝐞𝐬)

I sold door to door from San Jose to San Fran in 2009 (no salaries, pure comission). Doing that in an economy like that for 1 year, I realized I can be an entrepreneur. So, I came back to India, sold for a while via cold calling, in person meetings, & online to eventually start my 1st business into food & coffee. I failed and fell right on the floor with $100 remaining & a credit card debt of $700…..I went to the beach, and I made the decision to start MotivationalDiaries.com in 2015 under depression….the rest, as they say, is history. I fought every day in circumstances on the dark side which build character, make you realize value of each & every penny, and build humility. I got there because I fought every day…

𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐰𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐧𝐞𝐜𝐭 ?

If you have a purpose & if you have had mental & emotional circumstances to overcome, I think you & I connecting is written. I know what it means to be rich from family, but poor inside; I know what it means to be poor in money, but rich in soul; and in this chapter of my life, I now understand what it means to be rich as self-made and healthy-emotionally, physically & spiritually. I still have to fight everyday with the ‘poverty’ out there to go to my next level, but I try to do that through my meditations, my workout & my work as a sales & leadership coach to CEOs & their teams which fuel positive energy in me. I am at coach@motivationaldiaries.com
