basic_profile.name: Ido Jonathan Engel
basic_profile.headline: CEO | AI & Cloud GTM | Digital Natives & Enterprise | Former Microsoft Cloud & AI Leader | Founder & Operator | Strategic advisor | Speaker.
basic_profile.summary: I build and scale technology businesses at the intersection of AI, cloud and go-to-market.My career has taken me across both sides of the table — from building companies as a founder to leading Cloud & AI businesses at Microsoft, working with founders, technology leaders and enterprises as they adopt and scale new technologies.At Microsoft, I built a first dedicated Digital Native business, working closely with Israel's startup and scale-up ecosystem, and later led AI go-to-market across Southeast Europe. Earlier in my career, I held roles spanning software development, presales, sales and business leadership — experience that shaped how I approach technology businesses today.I believe the best technology conversations start with the problem rather than the product: understand what the customer is trying to achieve, go deep enough technically to challenge how it should be built, and then create the commercial path that gets it into production and creates measurable value.As a founder myself, I've experienced the other side of that conversation — building products, finding product-market fit, raising capital, acquiring customers, scaling teams and making difficult decisions with imperfect information.Across those experiences, the principles I value have remained remarkably consistent: integrity, accountability, curiosity, persistence and trust. The best business relationships — and the best companies — are built for the long term.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Factify controls what your AI agents are allowed to act on - and keeps a full record of every decision they make with it.Most enterprises are ready to move agents into critical workflows. So legal keeps a human in the loop, the pilot never becomes production, and the efficiency gain disappears.Factify sits between your existing systems and your agents. Before any information reaches an agent, it's checked against your policies in real time. Approved facts go through. Everything else is blocked or flagged for human review. basic_profile.name: Devin Deich, MBA / MHA , IBDC.D.,  FACHDM, ACHE
basic_profile.headline: Board Member | Chief Executive | Expert in Strategy, Regulatory, Operations, Business Development Growth in Digital, Mental Health, Managed Care | I Help Companies Modernize Healthcare to Positively Impact Patient Lives.
basic_profile.summary:
As a Board Member and Executive Leader, I assist in guiding organizational Strategy, Risk, Human Capital Development, and Global Growth across multiple healthcare industry verticals. I enjoy strategically navigating the operational and regulatory government agency, payer, provider, and patient landscape. I have a passion for mentoring and coaching with the purpose of instilling empowering leadership qualities to foster empowered, high-performing teams that drive high growth and sustain operational excellence. And have crafted a deep knowledge of clinical operations and business planning, combined with the healthcare regulatory environment in top Fortune organizations and early-stage startups, leading to remarkable innovations, and national best practices to generate billions in new business revenue. More importantly, making a positive impact on 10s of millions of patients' lives and countless family members.

I have accumulated extensive national operational and global regulatory experience encompassing nearly all patient population groups from all walks of life, focusing heavily on chronic conditions and overseeing Medicaid, Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Commercial, and Tricare. Providing strategic guidance to dozens of C-Level executive teams to effectively evaluated and implemented, innovation and technology solutions that enhance interoperability under multiple reimbursement models.

I welcome impactful discussions on collaboration, strategy, leadership, potential partnerships, and innovative industry change that improves care delivery and empowers providers and patients.

past.employee_title: Enterprise Senior Director of National Clinical Transformation & Business Development
past.employee_description:
ACHIEVEMENTS CONTINUED

STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIPS / CONTRACT NEGOTIATIONS
Tasked by enterprise executive leadership to lead the development and implementation of national population health and value-based care models for high-risk/high-need chronic condition population groups in Medicaid/Medicare/Commercial markets. Within the first 120 days, I created a go-to-market strategy, identified target entities, formed value propositions, onboarded and mentored teams, and executed provider agreements under fee-for-service, at-risk, and shared savings contracts. During the first 2.5 years, I secured contracts worth $5B annually with 4,000 CBOs, including Rural Health Clinics (RHCs), Accountable Care Organizations (ACOs), Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), and Clinically Integrated Networks (CINs). UHG and its subsidiaries adopted these tactics and have continuously improved to secure business throughout the organization.

DATA & ANALYTICS / OPERATIONALIZATION
I established operational, clinical, contracting, and predictive modeling KPIs aligned under the UHG, UHC, and Optum framework in accordance with the Affordable Care Act. I oversaw operations and business ROI justification for the unfunded department and navigated complex/regulated state and federal compliance/service offering requirements. I served as an enterprise subject matter expert resource for UHG, UHC health plans, and Optum leadership, advising on objects and key results with clinical key performance indicators and developing analytics, clinical forecasting, financial models, and reporting delivery systems. These efforts became national best practices and SOPs, driving clinical outcomes to improve patient care and reducing annual costs by hundreds of millions of dollars. I also assisted in crafting state legislative language to advance patient-centric, whole-person clinical care at the community level under value-based care models.

basic_profile.name: Dr. Kieran Arasaratnam
basic_profile.headline: | AI Advisor | Professor of Practice | 18yrs in Trading Floor | Macro Trading | Investment Banking | Finance Expert | Blockchain | Social Impact |
basic_profile.summary:
With over 18 years of experience in the banking sector, Kieran Arasaratnam is a Professor of Practice and co-director of Gandhi Center for Inclusive Innovation at Imperial College Business School in London. He is an expert in financial innovation, risk management, and emerging markets, having worked for Barclays Capital, Morgan Stanley, and HSBC across Europe, US, and Asia. He has led and contributed to various initiatives that have transformed the finance industry, such as blockchain, data science, and AI.

Kieran leverages his knowledge of finance and technology to build a global network that affects positive social change, especially in the areas of education, healthcare, energy, and economic development. He works with international partners, government policies, and local communities to address the root causes of global inequality and poverty. He is passionate about harnessing innovation, public policy, and social science to create solutions that improve the lives of millions of people around the world.

AIDA Lab is a groundbreaking initiative fostering collaboration between academia and industry in the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and related fields to modern finance and investment strategies. We bridge the gap by creating a vibrant research environment where leading academics and industry experts work together to develop and implement cutting-edge solutions for real-world challenges.

The AIDA-Health Lab is a revolutionary initiative that unites academic experts and industry leaders to advance the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and associated technologies in healthcare and medical fields. Our mission is to cultivate a collaborative research space where top scholars and industry professionals come together to develop and implement innovative solutions, creating practical applications to address the pressing issues in modern healthcare.

current.employer_linkedin_description: At Imperial Business School, we are not just part of a world-leading university, but a world-changing one. current.employee_title: Module Leader: Blockchain and Applications (MSc in Financial Technology)
current.employee_description:
Module Aim

Empower students with an understanding of blockchain / distributed ledger technology from first principles, opportunities and challenges that this innovation presents. At the end of the course student will be equipped with the skills necessary to use blockchain technology to optimise existing processes, innovate business models and create new markets.

Learning Outcomes

At the end of this course, students will gain an understanding of:

The core value proposition of blockchain technology; how its etymology drives the new zeitgeist
The canonical technology (Bitcoin& Ethereum), their challenges along with current thinking about how to overcome them
How to raise capital from and value the token-based economy
Impact of blockchain on enterprise business models
Strategy to utilise Blockchain models to reinvent business processes, reduce transactional friction and create new markets
The constantly evolving legal and regulatory challenges Blockchain technology presents.

basic_profile.summary: I build businesses, not just campaigns.Over the last decade, I have operated at the intersection of brand, performance and commerce; scaling some of India’s largest consumer businesses and high-growth brands.At Flipkart, I led digital media strategy for one of the most competitive categories, managing ~₹200 Cr annual budgets and driving large-scale launches, including flagship moments like The Big Billion Days. past.employee_description:
Led AI and Computer Vision initiatives within Samsung's Camera and ARCore team, owning the complete lifecycle from research and architecture to production deployment while mentoring a team of 15+ engineers.

Designed and deployed production-grade AI agents using LangChain, Vertex AI, CrewAI, Firebase Studio, and n8n to automate enterprise workflows. Led the development of an on-device multimodal visual assistant as a next-generation alternative to cloud-based Gemini API calls for Samsung's Circle to Search by integrating NanoVLM, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Mixture of Complementary Prompts (MCP). Built optimized Android inference pipelines for vision-language models, enabling privacy-preserving, low-latency multimodal understanding across camera, gallery, and screenshots through efficient deployment of distilled LLMs.

Worked extensively on deploying large Computer Vision and Generative AI models on mobile devices, including object detection, segmentation, pose estimation, depth estimation, tracking, multimodal reasoning, and diffusion-based image generation. Optimized heavy vision and diffusion models using quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, operator fusion, and hardware acceleration to achieve real-time performance within mobile compute and memory constraints. Developed Android-native inference pipelines using TensorFlow Lite, PyTorch, ONNX, MediaPipe, OpenCV, and GPU/NPU acceleration for production-scale deployment.

Led research and development in Augmented Reality, Spatial Computing, and 3D Vision, delivering features including precise height and dimension measurement, depth-aware air doodling, touchless interaction, live stickers, emoji effects, and advanced scene understanding using ARCore. Explored novel multimodal interaction techniques, text-to-3D generation, and real-time spatial perception to translate cutting-edge research into production experiences that did not previously exist on mobile devices.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Jinn Labs is on a mission to transform retail security and operations through AI-native vision agents. Our flagship product detects and deters theft in real-time—starting with employee theft, the most overlooked and costly category. Purpose-built for convenience stores, gas stations, and small-format retail, our system integrates with existing camera infrastructure and POS systems to generate actionable insights without human monitoring. Now expanding into mid-size and large-format retailers, we bring the most advanced agentic framework for AI vision models—enabling intelligent, autonomous decision-making at the edge and unlocking new levels of operational efficiency and security across the retail landscape.
past.employee_description:
I lead the technical vision, architecture, and execution of an edge-native AI platform that transforms existing retail camera infrastructure into intelligent, real-time behavioral analytics. Our mission is to democratize enterprise-grade computer vision for independent retailers by delivering low-latency, privacy-first intelligence that runs directly on edge devices, eliminating dependence on cloud-based inference.

I drive engineering across AI, computer vision, edge infrastructure, and distributed systems, leading cross-functional teams responsible for building production-scale behavioral intelligence. Our platform combines pose estimation, gesture understanding, multi-object tracking, action recognition, and spatio-temporal reasoning to detect retail shrink, suspicious activities, and operational anomalies in real time. My responsibilities span the complete AI lifecycle, including data strategy, annotation pipelines, model development, optimization, quantization, accelerated edge inference, MLOps, and large-scale deployment of video analytics systems.

Beyond product delivery, I define the long-term technology roadmap, establish engineering practices, and translate state-of-the-art AI research into scalable, commercially viable solutions. By embedding intelligence directly into the physical environment rather than treating AI as a cloud service, we enable faster decision-making, stronger privacy guarantees, lower infrastructure costs, and a new generation of intelligent retail operations.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Your most valuable AI projects need the data you are least able to share.Nakato is a private layer between that data and the AI models you want to use. It runs inside your environment. Before a request reaches a model, every sensitive detail is swapped for a contextually faithful twin: a stand-in that carries the same meaning without the same risk. The model gets the full picture. Nakato reverses the swap before the answer hits the screen.We call this Reversible Semantic Pseudonymisation, or RSP. The context stays useful. The real data never moves.That means the workflows made impractical by redaction or masking can now go live. Your teams get the accuracy the task needs, and every substitution is auditable.We work with the engineers building these systems and the business owners who need them in production.Tell us about the workflow you have on hold.

past.employee_description:

The research entailed a meta-analysis of advanced neuroimaging techniques to explore how somatic therapies—acupuncture, electrostimulation, acupressure therapy, moxibustion and related embodiment-focused interventions—modulate neural activity in the brain, particularly in relation to sensory processing, emotional regulation, and stress resilience.

The findings contribute to a growing body of knowledge on the therapeutic potential of mind-body practices and their capacity to prevent disease and promote wellness across a wide range of health conditions.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The New York Botanical Garden has been a connective hub among people, plants, and the planet since 1891. We’re also stewards of globally significant research collections, from the LuEsther T. Mertz Library collection to the plant and fungal specimens in the William and Lynda Steere Herbarium, the largest such collection in the Western Hemisphere.At NYBG, we’re plant people—dedicated horticulturists, enthusiastic educators, and scientific adventurers—committed to helping nature thrive so that humanity can thrive. We believe in our ability to make things better, teaching tens of thousands of kids and families each year about the importance of safeguarding our environment and healthy eating. Our expert scientists work across the city, the nation, and the globe to document the plants and fungi of our world—and find actionable, nature-based solutions to our planet’s dual climate and biodiversity crises. And our eyes are always looking forward as we train the next generation of botanists, gardeners, landscape designers, and environmental stewards, ensuring a green future for all. At NYBG, we know that it’s nature—or nowhere.

past.employee_description:
Relying on herbal remedies, traditional medicine or cultural health practices rather than following the guidance of medical providers can have important implications for health care delivery and outcomes. 

To address health disparities and support cross-cultural understanding, cultural humility and effective patient-provider communication regarding the use of botanical therapies by Latinx and Caribbean immigrant communities in NYC, scientists at The New York Botanical Garden developed a cultural competency training program for health care providers that aims to bridge the communication gap between physicians and patients about the use of botanical therapies to improve the quality of care for underserved populations.

Curricular materials and workshops for physicians and medical students were developed based on on-going ethnobotanical and ethnomedical research in NYC since 2001. Trainings were provided in collaboration with medical schools, hospitals, community clinics and health centers serving Spanish-speaking immigrant patients and the Caribbean and Latinx communities.

Since its inception, hundreds of medical students and practicing physicians have been trained through this program which includes lectures, interactive workshops, guided visits to botánicas (shops that sell medicinal plants) and tours of Caribbean medicinal plant collections in the The New York Botanical Garden’s Enid A. Haupt Conservatory.

basic_profile.name: Thomas Pash
basic_profile.headline: CEO / Co-Founder at Stealth AI Startup
basic_profile.summary: Thomas is a proven, award-winning and successful C-level executive and serial entrepreneur with deep experience leading high-growth, sales-driven firms. Over his career, Thomas has founded and or led private equity (PE) and venture capital (VC) funded start-ups to pension fund investment assets to global firms with annual sales in excess of $500 million and market caps of over $2 billion. Thomas' proven success includes building and leading four great firms from early stages to substantial growth to crossing the finish line, or being acquired.Thomas is currently Chief Executive Officer and Co-Founder of ZETTA², a pure-play, agnostic AI-native consultancy using proprietary products, solutions, workflows, and services, alongside leading AI technologies, helping enterprises drive measurable business outcomes. ZETTA² raised a substantial seed round in August of 2026 and officially launches in Fall '26. Prior to ZETTA², Thomas was Chief Executive Officer and Board Director of private equity (PE) backed Hunter St. Hospitality and Pacific Concepts (Formerly Rockpool Dining Group). Hunter St. Hospitality was Australia's largest hospitality and entertainment group with more than 4,000 employees and revenues of $450M. Prior to Hunter St. Hospitality, Thomas was Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer for Genan, Inc., the world’s largest producer of raw materials from scrap tires. Before Genan, Thomas served as Chief Executive Officer of ONTILITY, LLC. ONTILITY was one of the largest and fastest growing solar and renewable energy firms in North America with over $150 million in revenues, 4,000 clients/dealers and over 300 MW of solar pv deployed. Before ONTILITY, he served as Chief Executive Officer of ZettaWorks LLC., a firm that Thomas helped lead from start-up to $50 million in revenues and a successful, high-multiple exit to Perficient in less than four years. Prior to ZettaWorks, he served as COO/CIO/CFO for a Global REIT featuring a $2 billion portfolio of real estate holdings, hotels and resorts, restaurants, retail operations, and multi-residential housing. Thomas is a graduate of Pepperdine University’s prestigious Presidential/Key Executive M.B.A. program, holds a B.S. with honors from The University of Houston, and is a Champion/Master Six Sigma Black Belt. Thomas has also completed more than 75 marathons, ultra-marathons and Ironman triathlons.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Genan is one of the largest mechanical recycler of End-of-Life Tyres (ELTs) in the world.We are committed to a sustainable planet, and we believe that true recycling is best achieved through innovation, quality and transparency.Our philosophy is that sustainability is a shared responsibility, and we devote our efforts to continuously finding new and innovative ways to recycle ELTs. Each year, millions of tons of tyres are worn out; yet, although they are no longer fit for the roads, they still represent a massive resource. By shredding, granulating and milling end-of-life tyres and using the rubber granules and powders for various applications, we give tyres a second life. Recycled tyre rubber may even be used for the production of new tyres, substituting virgin material for a sustainable cradle-to-cradle recycling. This is the core of the Genan concept: reusing materials of excellent quality in an environmentally sustainable way, thereby saving resources.Compared to both incineration and civil engineering applications, recycling of ELTs is by far the most environment-friendly and sustainable solution to what would otherwise be a waste problem. The recycling process results in significantly less CO2 emission than the incineration of tyres in e.g. cement kilns: an estimated 1.1 tons less CO2 per 1 ton of tyres – indeed a substantial reduction of global warming potential (GWP). In average, a tyre consists of 75% rubber, 15% steel and 10% textile fibers. When separated through the Genan process technology, all these materials can be recycled. At Genan, sustainability is our core value, and we are constantly optimising our processes and diversifying our products – to the benefit of our customers, the environment and the global community.

basic_profile.name: Felipe Dellacqua
basic_profile.headline: Starting a new AI company... Tech Entrepreneur, Enterprise Sales B2B, Former CRO/CMO, 2x Exit 1x IPO
basic_profile.summary: 22 years. 4 companies founded. 2 exits. 1 IPO (NYSE: VTEX · US$3.7B)I started building early — and never stopped.Primordia was my first major bet: in 3 years, we built Brazil's first SaaS e-commerce platform for the fashion sector and reached 80% market share. It was acquired by VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) in 2014. From there, I joined VTEX as an executive partner — and spent the next 7 years leading Brazilian market consolidation, with 50%+ organic growth year over year, a full transition from mid-market to enterprise clients, Series B and C rounds led by SoftBank, Tiger Global, and Lone Pine Capital, and ultimately a NYSE IPO at a US$3.7B valuation. After the IPO, I kept building. I joined Adventures — a startup backed by a R$50M Series A from Provence Capital, as an operating partner. I led the turnaround of Infracommerce (BVMF: IFCM3), a public company on the Brazilian stock exchange, from the entry of Pátria Investimentos through its sale to Geribá Investimentos. And I led the unification of sales and marketing across Deal Group, a technology firm recognized as a leader in the ISG AI quadrant, with operations in Brazil, Europe, Africa, and the United States.  Each cycle gave me something different: building from zero, scaling with institutional capital, operating through crisis, executing enterprise across multiple countries. These are layers that few professionals carry in a single trajectory.  Alongside the executive path, I've always believed knowledge needs to move. That's why I've taught MBA courses at some of Brazil's most respected universities — UNICAMP, FGV, ESPM, Impacta, and FIAP — covering e-commerce, go-to-market strategy, cross-border commerce, and digital business. Throughout this journey, I've also worked as a growth and sales advisor to startups in the digital ecosystem — including Trinio, Retail Hub, and companies within the Confi portfolio (founded by Pedro Chiamulera, creator of ClearSale). The work was always the same: help founders turn a great product into predictable revenue. Now I'm taking everything I've built, learned, and observed — and putting it into the most ambitious chapter yet. I'm co-founding an artificial intelligence company with a clear goal: to become the largest enterprise AI platform in Latin America. Details coming soon. What I can say now: the problem we're solving is real, the business model is defensible, and the team has the track record and the hunger to execute.  If you invest in technology and AI in Brazil or across LATAM — we'll be opening an investment round very soon.

basic_profile.name: Amy Daali, PhD
basic_profile.headline: Founder & CEO at Stealth AI Startup
basic_profile.summary: Amy Daali, Ph.D. is an AI founder, engineer, and researcher working at the intersection of artificial intelligence, medicine, and women’s health.She is currently building a stealth AI startup focused on women’s health and is the author of Women, Health & AI, a Substack publication exploring the gaps medicine has yet to solve for women, emerging research frontiers, and how AI and technology can improve women’s healthcare.Amy holds a Ph.D. in Engineering from the University of Texas and has more than a decade of experience applying artificial intelligence, deep learning, and engineering across medical, technical, and business environments. Her background spans biomedical imaging, computer vision, deep learning, healthcare technology, and applied AI.Previously, Amy founded Lucea AI, where she worked with executives and organizations on AI strategy, implementation, and education. She is also the founder of Moonshot 4 Her, a platform created to support technical women building companies.Her interest in AI and medicine began early in her career during a postdoctoral fellowship at the University of Texas Health Science Center San Antonio, where she developed computational models using biomedical imaging data to study and predict cancer progression in glioblastoma patients.She later served as Engineering Director at Invictus Medical, leading the development of advanced noise-reduction technology designed to improve the acoustic environment of neonatal incubators.At USAA, Amy developed deep learning models using Keras and GPU-enabled TensorFlow on large-scale imagery datasets. She also contributed to the patent “Predictive Mapping for Routing Telephone Calls,” which applied AI to optimize call routing using factors including sentiment, user experience, and topic performance.Amy is an advocate for increasing the participation of women in technology and entrepreneurship. She has spoken about AI at conferences and events including the Data Science Salon Conference, the Women in Data Science Conference, and the IEEE Smart City Summit, and regularly contributes to conversations about AI, human intelligence, women’s health, and the future of technology.

basic_profile.name: Theo Zätterström 🎉
basic_profile.headline: Hjälper grundare med 2 till 10 msek ARR att bygga säljmaskineriet innan de anställer en säljchef.
basic_profile.summary: Pipen växer men besluten puttas framåt. Du har visat demon för samma person tre gånger, skickat offerten, mejlat två gånger till och sen blir det knäpptyst.Du vet att något inte funkar.Du vet bara inte var.Du säljer på pris och features för att du inte kan sätta en siffra på vad kundens problem kostar. Du mäter bokade demos och firar dem, fast hälften aldrig borde ha varit en demo.Säljet ligger i excel, i ditt huvud och i mejl du skriver för hand efter varje möte. Styrelsen frågar varför inget stängs och du har inget bättre svar än att det tar tid i din bransch. Under tiden går kassan ner och planen är att anställa någon som ska lösa säljet.Men om du inte själv vet var det fastnar, vad ska den personen kopiera?Mina två första säljjobb slutade nästan med att jag fick sparken. Sen bytte jag till ett bolag där vd och säljchef hade byggt ett system för hur man säljer. Det tog mig nio dagar att stänga en av bolagets största affärer. Systemet gjorde jobbet, inte jag.Det är det The Scalability Diagnostic svarar på. Tre veckor. Jag intervjuar dig och de som säljer, går igenom dina affärer, din pipeline och dina säljmöten, och du får ett svar på var det läcker och vad du ska göra först.Hittills: 70+ techbolag, bland andra Stratsys, Trapets, Wint, Visma, Headcount, Position Green, Netigate, Kundo, Ebbot och Screens. Winrate upp 50 procent eller mer hos flera av dem. Själv har jag sålt för över 100 miljoner innan jag började hjälpa andra.En vd sa efteråt: "Det är första gången den ekonomiska köparen och business usern pushar igenom det tillsammans utan några riktiga invändningar."För dig som är grundare eller vd på ett techbolag med betalande kunder och 2 till 10 MSEK ARR, utan säljchef.Inte för dig som redan vet exakt vad problemet är, eller hoppas att nästa runda löser det.Skriv "info" i ett DM för mer information.

basic_profile.name: Trey Layton
basic_profile.headline: Founder & CEO, Stealth AI Company | Partner, Capellas Partners | 39 patent filings in autonomous intelligence, model integrity & compression | Former CTO, VCE and Dell EMC
basic_profile.summary: I build the systems AI runs on, and the frameworks that tell executives whether their AI investment is actually working. Three decades in enterprise infrastructure, most of it spent at the point where a new architecture either scales or quietly fails. As CTO of VCE, I helped build converged infrastructure into a multibillion-dollar category and the foundation of what became hyperconverged systems. At Dell EMC I ran engineering for data center automation. At Penguin Solutions I led the software and product organization behind ICE ClusterWare and ClusterWare AIM, and directed DevOps for some of the largest AI superclusters in operation. In 2026 I turned that experience into invention. I founded a stealth deep-tech AI company and filed 36 patent applications with the USPTO in a single year, across three problems that get harder as AI systems scale: how independent systems come to trust each other without a central authority, how you verify that a model in production still behaves the way it did when you shipped it, and how you move far more data than the network was ever built to carry. Ninety more are in the pipeline. As a Partner at Capellas Partners, I advise boards, private equity firms, and CEOs on AI strategy, technical diligence, and the sequencing decisions that determine whether AI investment compounds or stalls. That work produced three more patent-pending products: Estate Lens, which grounds engineering estate analysis in provenance and a falsifiable thesis; Signal, for advisory-grounded multi-source intelligence; and Keel, for self-correcting software. It also produced two frameworks I publish openly. The AI Maturity Index assesses enterprise AI readiness across ten operational domains and five stages, and includes an AI-washing detection protocol for boards that suspect the maturity being reported to them is not the maturity that exists. The AI-Native Development Organization, a four-part series, argues that AI does not accelerate the traditional development organization so much as remove the constraint that organization was built around, and works through what to rebuild in its place. The through-line: most AI failure is not a technology problem. It is a sequencing problem. Organizations automate what they should have deleted, scale what they never operationalized, and buy capability they have not earned the right to use. I work with leaders who would rather find that out early. Before any of this: U.S. Army Intelligence Analyst, CENTCOM. It is still the most useful training I have had in telling signal from noise.

current.employee_description:
I advise boards, private equity firms, and Fortune 500 executives on AI strategy, technical diligence, M&A integration, and the sequencing decisions that determine whether AI investment compounds or stalls. My work spans supply chain, financial services, telecommunications, enterprise software, and consumer markets.

Built and published:
 
• The AI Maturity Index — a framework assessing enterprise AI readiness across ten operational domains and five stages of maturity, built on the finding that AI maturity is never one number. A company can be Stage 4 in development tooling and Stage 1 in customer service, and usually is. The companion Scoring Guide supplies domain scoring criteria, measurable indicator checklists, cross-domain leverage scoring, a board reporting framework, and an AI-washing detection protocol for identifying inflated maturity claims before capital moves against them.
 
• The AI-Native Development Organization — a four-part series on what changes structurally when AI assumes the bulk of code production: the requirement precision inversion, the sequencing discipline that prevents automating a process you should have deleted, why the tool rather than the interface is now the durable asset, and what a good developer looks like now.
 
Patent-pending products developed through this practice:
 
• Estate Lens — provenance-bound engineering estate analysis producing a falsifiable decision thesis rather than an opinion. 30 claims, 16 figures.
• Signal — advisory-grounded multi-source intelligence with self-managing collection and accountability-partitioned engagement execution. 35 claims across 7 independent methods.
• Keel — self-correcting software with multi-source self-capture of internal failures and source-grounded automated remediation. 28 claims.

current.employee_description:
I founded a deep tech AI company building system-level capability in autonomous intelligence, secure distributed architecture, and large-scale data efficiency. The work spans early research, prototype system design, and a durable IP foundation for AI infrastructure.
 
In our first year we filed 36 patent applications with the USPTO, with all priority dates locked. The portfolio organizes into five invention families. More than 90 inventions are under development, with a subset progressing through filing.
 
I am deliberately not detailing those filings while they remain in provisional status. What I will say is the shape of the thinking behind them.
 
We assume AI systems will run distributed rather than centralized, which makes trust between independent parties a design problem rather than an administrative one. We assume those systems will have to prove their own integrity continuously rather than be trusted by assertion. And we assume the cost of moving data between them is the constraint most of the industry is still treating as fixed.
 
Those three assumptions determine what we build, and what we decline to build.
 
My role is technical direction and research sequencing: deciding which of those inventions earns the next increment of effort, and holding the architecture honest before we scale outward.

Halifax Rugby League Club was formed way back in 1873. It was a Rugby Union club in those days, as all rugby clubs were before the birth of Rugby League in 1895, and was very successful in that code. After becoming the first ever winners of the Yorkshire Cup in 1878, Halifax went on to win it on four further occasions. Several players were supplied for the Yorkshire County side in these years, and five were picked for the full England Rugby Union team.The club moved into their previous home of Thrum Hall in 1886, their home for the next 112 years until the move in 1998 to the re-developed 'Shay Stadium' to ground-share with local footballing neighbours, Halifax Town AFC (now FC Halifax Town).Halifax were founder members of the Rugby League (then known as the Northern Union) in 1895. They continued to be very successful, producing one of their best ever teams in the early years of the twentieth century. In season 1902-03 they achieved the 'double' by winning the Challenge Cup and finishing top of Division One. They won the cup again the following season, and were the first ever Championship Play-off winners in season 1906-07.We look forward to our supporters, players, staff and sponsors joining us on Linkedin. If you would like to learn anything more about Halifax Rugby League please message us

basic_profile.name: John Kim
basic_profile.headline: Sr. Advisor, Permira; Board Member, Owlet. Former: EVP/CPO PayPal, President Expedia Marketplace, President Vrbo
basic_profile.summary:
As Executive Vice President, Chief Product Officer, John Kim leads the consumer and merchant product and engineering teams working to advance PayPal's position as a leader in digital payments and commerce for consumers and merchants around the globe.

John brings a wealth of product management and technical experience to PayPal. Prior to joining PayPal, John served as President of Expedia Marketplace. In that role, he oversaw strategy, product, technology, and operations for all of Expedia Group's business lines – including lodging, air, car, cruise and activities – bringing Expedia Group's products to life for its customers and suppliers. Previously, John served as President of Platform & Marketplaces at Expedia Group where he led the development of artificial intelligence, user experience, research, ecommerce, marketplaces and yield management, data and development platforms across Expedia Group's customers, partners and employees.

Previously, Kim served as the President of Vrbo, where he led strategy and operations of one of the world’s leading alternative accommodations marketplaces. Joining Vrbo in 2016, Kim led the company’s transformation from a subscription-based advertising model to a modern e-commerce business powered by the latest advances in data science and technology. During Kim’s tenure, Vrbo was recognized by Business Insider as one of the top 25 tech companies to work for, by The Muse as one of the top innovators to work for, and by Hired.com as one of the top employer tech brands.

Before joining Vrbo, Kim served as Expedia’s Chief Product Officer and helped Expedia become one of the world’s most successful travel companies. He led the company’s overall global product development for hotel, air, car, and activities across Expedia.com, Orbitz, Travelocity, Wotif, and AirAsiaGo. The initiatives Kim led contributed to multiple years of double-digit growth in conversion. Kim has more than two decades of experience in product development, marketing, and general management at tier-one, venture-backed startups, medium-sized companies, and globally known brands including Yahoo!, Overture, Accenture, Bank of America, and Pelago. 

Kim is a vocal advocate for diversity and was appointed to advise President George W. Bush on economic policies impacting Asian Americans and Pacific Islander small businesses. He graduated from the University of California, Santa Barbara, and received his MBA from the University of Chicago Booth School of Business.

past.employee_description:
Our mission: Connect travelers to the people and places they love, giving them the space they need to drop the distractions of everyday life and simply be together.

About Vrbo: In 1995, Vrbo introduced a new way for people to travel together, pairing homeowners with families and friends looking for places to stay. We were grounded in one purpose: To give people the space they need to drop the distractions of everyday life and simply be together.

Since then, we’ve grown into a global community of homeowners and travelers, with unique properties in 190 countries around the world. Vrbo makes it easy and fun to book cabins, condos, beach houses and every kind of space in between.

Vrbo is part of HomeAway and the Expedia Group family of brands and offers homeowners and property managers exposure to over 750 million visits to Expedia Group sites each month.

What we believe: Only in a vacation home can you have those private dinner conversations with loved ones that go long into the night, or more space for those fun, silly moments that bring you closer together.

People are increasingly forced to choose work over life — screen time over family time. We could all use more connection with the people we love.

But too often, it doesn't happen. Planning a trip with family and friends is too stressful. Too time consuming. Too hard. There’s always an excuse not to go. Planning a trip should feel as effortless and enjoyable as being on one.

Welcome to Vrbo, helping people everywhere travel better together.

Rippling is a workforce management system that eliminates the friction from running a business. Today, most companies struggle with everything from routine tasks, like running payroll, to cross-functional planning, like aligning on headcount. That’s because all their data related to people, processes, and systems is scattered in a hundred places. Rippling has every application you need to run your business—from applicant tracking and payroll to IT and expenses—in one place. But unlike other systems, Rippling sits on top of a unified platform. Data flows dynamically between Rippling’s applications, giving every team a shared source of truth, the power to automate processes, and access to the insights they need. This allows your business to execute better, faster.Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock.Get help: rippling.com/contactLicensing details: https://app.rippling.com/licensing

basic_profile.name: De'Angello Harris
basic_profile.headline: Founding CBO @ Stealth AI | GTM Strategy, Revenue & Strategic Partnerships | US & APJ
basic_profile.summary: I'm the Founding Chief Business Officer at a stealth AI startup in San Francisco, building the commercial engine around the technology. I lead customer development, strategic partnerships, investor relationships, and talent as we turn technical innovation into a scalable business. Right now, that means building our founding engineering team alongside our YC alum technical co-founder.For 15+ years I've built commercial operations from the ground up across Singapore and Australia, working hands-on with founders and executive teams on go-to-market, revenue and scaling their organizations. Most recently I opened Think & Grow's Singapore business from zero, then spearheaded its APJ go-to-market from Sydney. We were the embedded GTM leads for startups and scaleups entering new markets (Stripe, Square, Spotify, Peloton and Dropbox), closing their first customers and revenue from the US to APJ.Before that I spent seven years at Randstad helping companies like Grab/Uber, Airbnb, Gemini, Alibaba and ByteDance build their engineering, data and product teams across APAC. It taught me that even the best strategy goes nowhere without the right people behind it. As a German-American who’s lived and worked across Germany, the US, Singapore and Australia, I’ve learned that what works in one market rarely translates directly to the next. Now I’m applying that mindset to a space where the playbook is still being written: AI.If you're in product or an engineer who wants to be early at something ambitious, I'm always up for a coffee in SF :)

current.employee_description:
Building the next frontier of AI: Artificial Collective Intelligence.

Cognisee is a frontier AI lab building the missing cognitive layer for AI: systems that surface, structure, and activate tacit context across humans, agents, machines, and institutions.

Building toward a future where:

• The productivity paradox breaks: AI moves beyond individual productivity gains to measurable organizational lift by turning tacit context, expert judgment, and institutional memory into system-wide performance.

• Expertise no longer disappears: Critical judgment, operating knowledge, and failure patterns become durable cognitive assets, enabling hard-won know-how to compound across teams, systems, and time.

• Autonomy becomes trustworthy: Agents and machines act with tacit context, uncertainty awareness, and governed escalation, moving from brittle automation to context-grounded execution.

• Physical AI gains real-world competence: Robots and machines learn skilled action from embodied, contextual, expert know-how, addressing expertise and skills-transfer gaps in critical sectors.

• Human agency scales: AI strengthens human judgment, creativity, and decision-making while preserving authorship, accountability, and control.

• Intelligence becomes locally grounded and collectively governed: Nations, institutions, and communities build AI from their own knowledge, languages, tacit context, and governance, moving from data dependency to durable cognitive capability.

Assembled a 60+ person frontier AI team spanning collective intelligence, artificial life, neurocognitive research, knowledge representation, context graphs, robotics, embodied intelligence, human-AI interaction, enterprise AI, sovereign systems, and trustworthy AI. Momentum includes a published foundational white paper, provisional patent filings, research under peer review, commercial partnerships, and relationships across global institutions and applied AI ecosystems.

basic_profile.name: Raheel Anwar
basic_profile.headline: Technology Business Builder | Strategy, GTM & Customer Growth | AI, Infrastructure & Security | Ex-Juniper, Snowflake, Exabeam
basic_profile.summary: Every enterprise has a post-sale organization. Almost none of them know what it is actually capable of. We are at an inflection point. The companies that will win the next decade are not the ones with the best product. They are the ones that figured out how to make every customer successful at scale, before the customer knew they needed help, before the risk became visible, before the renewal conversation became a negotiation. That is not an operational problem. That is an intelligence problem. Over 20 years I have led this function at enterprise scale, accountable for portfolios up to $800M and organizations of 100+ across cloud, SaaS, and security markets. At Snowflake and Exabeam I did not manage post-sale. I rebuilt it. Redesigned how teams are structured, how data flows, how AI surfaces risk before humans see it, and how the function shows up in a board conversation about revenue rather than just retention. The function has gone by many names across my career. Customer Success. Support. Technical Account Management. Professional Services. The title has never been the point. The point is what happens after a customer signs, and whether the organization behind that moment is built to deliver value or just manage it. I have not only led that transformation from the inside. I have built toward it from the outside as well, which changed how I see the problem entirely. What I saw from both sides is this: most enterprises are deploying AI into their customer facing operations without the governance, trust, and identity architecture to make it safe, explainable, and accountable at scale. The gap is not a technology problem. It is a leadership problem. The leaders who close it will define what enterprise looks like for the next decade.

Lead Investor and end-to-end Venture Building Lead at Blue Route Technologies for Neurodevelopment, a HealthTech spin-off co-founded with DOBLE A Pediatrics and Neurodevelopment and powered by GooVentures®.

Blue Route is developing an AI-powered platform for the early detection, clinical assessment, and personalized treatment of neurodevelopmental disorders, with a particular focus on autism spectrum disorder (ASD).

The project combines DOBLE A’s real-world clinical expertise, GooApps®’ technology capabilities, and Goo Ventures®’ scalable venture-building approach. Its goal is to transform traditional assessment and treatment pathways, shorten the time to diagnosis, and enable earlier, more personalized interventions.

📌 Key responsibilities

• Leading the overall vision, strategic positioning, and product roadmap.
• Developing the business plan, financial model, and impact and scalability KPIs.
• Designing the B2C and B2B business model, including digital assessments, therapy subscriptions, and SaaS licensing.
• Leading fundraising, investor storytelling, pitch deck development, and public and private funding strategies.
• Overseeing product development and technology architecture, integrating AI, video-based behavioral analysis, and gamified digital therapies.
• Coordinating clinical validation and regulatory readiness under MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485.
• Defining the go-to-market strategy, strategic partnerships, and international expansion.

🎯 Impact

• Potential to reduce diagnostic journeys from over 24 months to just a few weeks.
• Integration of clinical expertise, AI, and digital therapies into a single platform.
• Building a HealthTech company designed for clinical validation, certification, investment, and international growth.

Outfindo turns verifiable consumer research into the structured product data that modern commerce runs on – for human shoppers today, and AI shopping agents tomorrow.LLMs know what a product is. They don't know which product fits which customer, in which market, for which need, and that judgment doesn't exist in a form Google or an AI assistant can query. So shoppers hesitate, and AI agents skip products or get them wrong. We build the layer that closes that gap.Everything starts with research. Our proprietary, academic-grade consumer research decodes how people actually choose in a category: their goals, trade-offs, and the limits under which a product shouldn't be recommended. We turn that into structured, verifiable product data and render it across the surfaces commerce is shifting toward:• Product Guide – an interactive advisor that leads shoppers to the right product on category and product pages• PDP Content System – per-SKU product content readable by people, Google, and AI agents alike• Consumer research, category trees, and filters – the decision structure underneathEvery value traces back to a verified source. No source, no claim. So nothing is invented, and responsible AI can recommend with confidence. It's infrastructure that complements your content and systems, never a rip-and-replace. And as AI gets better at shopping, it only needs cleaner, decision-grade data. Exactly what we make.For retailers, that means higher conversion and order value, fewer returns, and products that get found in the new AI-driven shopping journey. Consumer minds are stable; channels change fast. Because we build on consumer research, we're ready for whatever comes next.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Opsys has developed the world's most advanced Pure solid-state scanning LiDAR. Opsys’ technology uses fully addressable VCSEL arrays, combined with a single chip addressable CMOS SPAD array. No moving parts allow for a reliable solution that can operate 24/7. This ensures there are no mechanical failures over time, which increases the sensors’ lifetime expectancy (10+ yrs MTBF) well beyond any other solution on the market today. As such, all Opsys products come with an extended 5-yr warranty. The ALTOS (Advanced LiDAR Technology Opsys Sensor) is an all-in-one (perception, analysis & VMS integration) security solution. The Smart 4D LiDAR sensor enables unmatched accuracy (reduces false alarms), whilst built-in edge AI provides alerts in real time. The ALTOS brings all the benefits of LiDAR (e.g. depth perception and being GDPR compliant as no identifiable features are captured) but it is no more expensive than a camera set up. Opsys technology is especially designed to meet the myriads of demands in the security industry, ranging from critical infrastructure to data centers. The ALTOS is already in mass production. The ALTOS-IDIS (Intrusion Detection Intelligent Sensor), unveiled at ISC West 2026, is built on the ALTOS 4D LiDAR platform. Combining volumetric awareness with edge intelligence, ALTOS-IDIS detects, tracks, and classifies objects within defined zones, generating real-time intrusion alarms directly on the sensor without external compute. Given the ALTOS is a PoE, plug and play solution, it is easily scalable, which is particularly important in environments where simplicity, cost efficiency, and flexibility are key. For example, Smart Cities and Intelligent Traffic Systems (ITS). Opsys technology is affordable, accurate and robust and is built to transform legacy systems. All Opsys products are NEMA TS2 certified and BABA compliant. Founded in 2016, the company has major investment, is headquartered in Israel, with offices in USA, APAC & Europe

past.employer_linkedin_description: Vyng has built a next-generation phone platform that visualizes every call.Vyng is an LA-based company that transforms how conversations start on mobile by bringing emotion to the lockscreen. Since Vyng’s launch of Vyngtones last year, it has served over three billion videos in 170 countries and is driving engagement in regions like South Asia and North Africa where smartphone adoption continues to grow rapidly.

past.employee_description:
I worked with wonderful research scientists, research engineers, and product managers to develop AI algorithms, curate data, and leverage distributed computing to create autonomous solutions to challenging problems in complex environments. A few examples include:

• Formulated multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm that trained meta-prompt conversational LLM agents that conversed with humans, parsed human inputs, and identified necessary sequence of actions and target agents to perform said actions, including delegation, within a system of 1000s of simultaneously-trained generalist and expert LLM agents that solved complex problems in highly societal, distributed, and accurate ways.

• Created (first author) semi-supervised lifelong/continual time-series learning algorithm that detects and rapidly adapts to data distribution shifts, avoids catastrophic forgetting, and outperforms the then state-of-the-art baseline algorithm on multiple, diverse benchmarks

• Devised machine learning model that (1) outperformed existing model for $1+ billion business line, and (2) countered firm's beliefs on causality between key features

• Pioneered (first-author) benchmarks for evaluating lifelong/continual learning algorithms on key global asset data and linked these to rigorous quantitative finance approaches

• Produced comprehensive internal Python library for statistical hypothesis testing, goodness of fit calculation, regression validation, statistical model validation, and statistical model section for categorical and numerical data, different assumptions on data, and arbitrary sample sizes

Managed team of AI practitioners to address open research and real-world problems through artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning approaches with qualitative intuition and quantitative rigor.

Taught team about various quantitative financial modeling approaches and empowered them to autonomously review documentation to figure out how to problem solve when formulating a problem, debugging, and testing or validating that algorithms work appropriately.

past.employee_description:
I studied and conducted iterative experiments on anticancer effects of cytokine interleukin 24 (IL-24), or melanoma differentiation gene 7 (MDA-7) in a large wet-cell lab in the Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgery department.

I was graciously 100% hosted by Prof. Rajagopal Ramesh, Lab Head and PI, and supervised by him and Dr. Manish Shanker, Research Associate, all part of the Department of Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgery.

My research (I mean our, or really their, but using "my" as I was much more limited in scope in what I focused on) was based on both direct and indirect or unidentified effects of IL-24/MDA-7. Examples in descending order of "directness":

1. Selective apoptosis through various signaling pathways, such as endothelial cells via JAK/STAT and MAPK pathways.
2. Investigated better understood anti-angiogenesis through downregulation of pro-angiogenic factors, such as vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), in addition to lesser-understood basic fibroblast growth factor (bFGF).
3. Investigated its bystander effect, in which IL-24 induces apoptosis on untransfected neighboring cancer cells in addition to the cancer cells themselves when delivered via viral vectors.
4. Preliminary exploration into how the catabolic regulation IL-24 cytokine is orchestrated via ubiquitination and is subsequently mediated by the 26S proteasome complex.

This was one of two, maybe three, things that even remotely interested me academically in high school.

past.employee_description:
Surpassed state-of-the-art multimodal virtual, embodied, and physical (e.g., robotics) AI models on tasks provided in their works and more in (1) success rate, (2) training speed, (3) inference speed, (4) memory footprint, (5) generalization, and (6) robustness. See below for examples.

For generalization, we evaluate models on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks. For out-of-distribution, we include both tasks that are within the convex hull of seen tasks to test for interpolation and tasks that are outside of this to test for extrapolation.

For robustness, we evaluate models in various overarching cases. These include (a) general and localized brittleness without adversarial intent, (b) adversarial attacks of different levels of sophistication, a (i) fully-automated, (ii) human-in-the-loop, and (3) fully-human iterated attacks, and (c) data or feedback (e.g., RLHF) decay or misalignment.

Some models (all 2022 or later except for one from 2021) that our algorithms outperform include
1. GATO 
2. BC-Z
3. BC-Z XL (BC-Z scaled up to have same number of parameters as RT-1)
4. Multi-Game Decision Transformer
5. RT-1
6. RT-1-X,
7. RT-1-X-MAX, 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗼𝘄𝗻 fully-trained, maximum performance version of Google DeepMind's RT-1 model. We begin with DeepMind's publicly released RT-1-X model checkpoint and fully train it over a large number of different seeds.
8. RT-1-X-MAX-ENS, 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗼𝘄𝗻 ensemble of several of 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗼𝘄𝗻 RT-1-X-MAX models
9. RT-1-X-MAX-ENS-OPT-ENT, 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗼𝘄𝗻 maximum-performance version of 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗼𝘄𝗻 RT-1-X-MAX-ENS models. Maximum performance resulted from a notion of optimal entropy over model predictions comprising the ensemble.

All RT-1-X(-...) models were trained on the Open X-Embodiment Dataset. We're grateful to the authors, institutions, and sponsors of this dataset for moving us closer to foundation models for robotics, and we're further grateful to Google DeepMind for publicly-releasing their RT-1-X model checkpoint.

From building practice management software and helping doctors go digital to pioneering telemedicine before the pandemic, launching Clinic Excellence Scores for greater transparency, and now rolling out AI-powered tools to support clinical decision-making, Practo has stayed at the forefront of innovation. As technology becomes integral to healthcare, Practo plays a crucial role in helping doctors manage and securely store health data. Practo encrypts all data with 256-bit encryption, uses HIPAA-compliant data centres, and is ISO 27001 certified, making it one of the few healthcare companies to achieve this level of security. Demonstrating its commitment to the highest standards of medical quality and patient care, Practo became the first digital healthcare company to receive QAI accreditation for its medical quality. This prestigious accreditation underscores Practo's dedication to excellence in healthcare.Now operating in 22+ countries, Practo recently expanded its consumer platform to the UAE, building on its existing presence on the provider side. The platform has, to date, connected over 50 crore patients and now brings together more than 5 lakh doctors and healthcare providers across 900 cities. In the UAE alone, Practo now has over 50,000 monthly active users, with 3,000 healthcare facilities and 31,000+ doctors already live. This expansive reach and robust infrastructure generate a staggering ₹3,500 crore+ of value every year, underscoring Practo’s growing impact not just in India but across the global healthcare landscape.

basic_profile.headline: 𝗦𝗰𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝘀𝘁 𝗯𝘆 𝗖𝘂𝗿𝗶𝗼𝘀𝗶𝘁𝘆 | 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿 𝗯𝘆 𝗔𝗰𝗰𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗻𝘁 | 𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗼𝗿 𝗯𝘆 𝗢𝗯𝘀𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻 | 𝗖𝗘𝗢 𝗯𝘆 𝗡𝗲𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗶𝘁𝘆 | Investor by Conviction | Building Ideas, Backing Dreamers
basic_profile.summary: 𝗜 𝘄𝗮𝘀𝗻'𝘁 𝗽𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝗯𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗲 𝗮 𝗖𝗘𝗢. 𝗜 𝘄𝗮𝘀 𝗷𝘂𝘀𝘁 𝘁𝗿𝘆𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝗳𝗶𝗴𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗵𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴𝘀 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸.⠀As a child, I asked "Why?" far more often than my teachers appreciated. I took things apart, questioned established answers, and read so much that my school librarian eventually suggested I find another library.⠀I almost became a doctor. But my father promised me a computer if I chose engineering.⠀𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗯𝗮𝗯𝗹𝘆 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗼𝘀𝘁 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝘂𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝗵𝗲 𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗿 𝗯𝗼𝘂𝗴𝗵𝘁. 😄⠀That curiosity took me through IBM, AT&T Bell Labs, Emerson, and the worlds of telecommunications, AI, robotics, and deep technology.⠀Along the way, I've built products, invented things, led teams, mentored entrepreneurs, invested in startups, and worked with remarkable people.⠀I've also had failures, sleepless nights, and discovered that the universe doesn't particularly care about my business plans.⠀𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗴𝗼𝗼𝗱 𝗻𝗲𝘄𝘀? 𝗜'𝗺 𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗰𝘂𝗿𝗶𝗼𝘂𝘀.⠀Today, I explore the frontiers of AI, particularly how rethinking its foundations could make technology more efficient, accessible, and meaningful.⠀Through 𝗧𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗮𝗺 𝗖𝗮𝗽𝗶𝘁𝗮𝗹, our family office, we invest in founders who dare to imagine a different future.⠀I believe great founders aren't necessarily those with polished presentations. They're the ones who care so deeply about a problem that walking away isn't an option.⠀Sometimes, what a founder needs most isn't another investor. It's someone who believes in them when things get difficult.⠀I'm a Forbes Technology Council member, inventor, researcher, entrepreneur, and occasionally a student again. I recently completed my M.Tech in AI because apparently, decades in technology weren't enough homework. 😊⠀𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗼𝗹𝗼𝗴𝘆 𝗶𝘀 𝗳𝗮𝘀𝗰𝗶𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴. 𝗣𝗲𝗼𝗽𝗹𝗲 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝘄𝗵𝘆 𝗶𝘁 𝗺𝗮𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘀.⠀My father taught me that even if I had to clean a floor, I should do it better than anyone else in the world. That lesson has stayed with me.⠀𝗗𝗼𝗻'𝘁 𝗰𝗵𝗮𝘀𝗲 𝘀𝘂𝗰𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀. 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝘀𝗲 𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴.⠀If you're a researcher challenging conventional wisdom, an entrepreneur chasing an impossible idea, or someone who believes the world can be better, I'd love to connect.⠀I don't promise to have all the answers. But I can almost guarantee I'll have a few questions. 😊⠀𝗦𝘁𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗰𝘂𝗿𝗶𝗼𝘂𝘀. 𝗦𝘁𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴. 𝗝𝘂𝘀𝘁 𝗴𝗲𝘁𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗲𝗱.

basic_profile.name: Weston LaBar
basic_profile.headline: CEO & Operating Partner | Scaling PE Logistics Platforms | $3B+ Value Created | Building Industrial AI & Supply Chain Tech
basic_profile.summary: The supply chain moves the world — and I've spent my career at the center of it: building organizations, shaping policy, and forging the relationships that keep goods moving through the most critical port complex in the United States. I'm an award-winning logistics executive, venture investor, and industry strategist with deep roots at the Port of Los Angeles and Port of Long Beach — the gateway for roughly 40% of U.S. containerized imports. My career sits at the intersection of operations, policy, and platform building. As CEO of the Harbor Trucking Association, I built what became the largest drayage-focused trade association in the United States — growing from a regional SoCal organization to a national voice on port operations, freight infrastructure, and clean transportation policy. We shaped legislation, convened the right stakeholders, and put drayage on the national policy map. At Cargomatic, I led enterprise and carrier sales through the company's most aggressive growth phase — scaling revenue from $80M to $400M and establishing the brand as a trusted name in U.S. freight logistics. Today I serve as CSO at Waterfront Logistics, a fast-scaling port logistics platform at LA/LB. I built the brand, architected the commercial organization — growing from a handful of clients to 100+ in year one — and serve as CEO of Quaynote Ventures, the company's digital arm. In parallel, I invest and advise through Ventures 52, my private advisory and angel practice in goods movement, freight tech, and supply chain infrastructure. I'm also developing an AI-driven venture currently raising a seed round. I chair the Long Beach Economic Partnership and Long Beach Workforce Innovation Board — the rooms where decisions get made, and where I've spent years building the trust and access that define real influence. I've been featured in 50+ media appearances across NPR Marketplace, CNBC, Bloomberg, WSJ, CGTN, Yahoo Finance, FreightWaves, Journal of Commerce, and American Shipper — and speak regularly at conferences, such as JOC TPM, Manifest, FreightWaves, and Meeting of the Minds. I host the On The Waterfront podcast, where I sit down with the executives and policymakers shaping global trade. If you're building in logistics, investing in infrastructure, or need a strategic voice with operator credibility and policy reach — let's talk.

current.employer_linkedin_description: DevRev helps companies resolve customer and employee requests from start to finish. Nobody asked for a ticket number. They asked for access, an answer, or a fix.Getting there takes more than one system. The policy may be in a knowledge base, the history in a ticket, and the action somewhere else. DevRev connects those pieces through Shared Memory so AI can investigate and act across the tools a company already uses, within its permissions and approval rules.Computer works alongside people to find answers, investigate issues, and take permitted actions. Agents take on defined jobs and carry out the steps. Routine requests can be resolved automatically. When a person needs to decide, they get the facts and the work already done.The systems of record stay put. The work doesn’t have to. DevRev moves requests through investigation and action instead of leaving customers and employees with a promising link and a long wait.The numbers matter, tooOn Enterprise-Bench, Computer achieved 94.3% accuracy and used roughly 4.4x fewer tokens per correct answer than a fetch-based agent using the same model. Its token use stayed roughly flat as the dataset grew 256x.In an airline payment-support workflow, cases that took up to 30 minutes were resolved in under 3. In an employee IT rollout, 54% of requests were resolved automatically at launch.If we’re going to call it self-service, it should actually finish something.DevRev is headquartered in Palo Alto, with eight global offices. We’re backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield, with $150M+ raised. Founded by Dheeraj Pandey, former co-founder and CEO of Nutanix [NASDAQ: NTNX], and board member at Adobe [NASDAQ: ADBE], alongside Manoj Agarwal, former SVP of Engineering at Nutanix.

basic_info.name: sync. labs
basic_info.description: sync. is a research-driven production company built by scientists, artists, and engineers advancing the future of AI video dubbing, video localization, and AI-powered video editing. Our research focuses on generative facial performance: teaching models to understand and manipulate how people look, move, and express themselves on screen.Our journey began in 2019, when our founders built the world’s first zero-shot AI lip sync model capable of syncing lips to any audio on any video without per-speaker training or fine-tuning - Wav2Lip. That breakthrough laid the foundation for the tools we build today, spanning AI video translation, visual dubbing, dialogue replacement, and lip sync API infrastructure for studios and developers.At sync., research and production operate in a tight feedback loop. We improve our models by working on real titles, real localization workflows, and real production constraints, not just benchmarks. What we ship this week informs what the model learns next. Backed by that foundation, we’re building the infrastructure for the next generation of AI video editing, AI dubbing platforms, and global content workflows.Y Combinator W24.

past.employer_linkedin_description: International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad (IIIT-H) is an autonomous university, founded as a not-for-profit public private partnership (N-PPP) in 1998, and is the first IIIT in India under this model. Over the years, the institute has evolved strong research programmes in various areas, with an emphasis on technology and applied research for industry and society. The institute facilitates interdisciplinary research and a seamless flow of knowledge. Several world-renowned centres of excellence are part of IIITH’s research portfolio. It has established various joint collaboration and co-innovation models with an industry outreach spanning significant national and multinational companies. Its innovative curriculum allows students the flexibility of selecting their courses and projects. Apart from academics the institute provides students with a comprehensive environment that promotes art and culture, sports, societal contributions and self-governance. Even undergraduate students get to participate in ongoing research and technology development - an opportunity unprecedented in India. As a result, a vibrant undergraduate programme co-exists along with a strong postgraduate programme.

current.employer_linkedin_description: sync. is a research-driven production company built by scientists, artists, and engineers advancing the future of AI video dubbing, video localization, and AI-powered video editing. Our research focuses on generative facial performance: teaching models to understand and manipulate how people look, move, and express themselves on screen.Our journey began in 2019, when our founders built the world’s first zero-shot AI lip sync model capable of syncing lips to any audio on any video without per-speaker training or fine-tuning - Wav2Lip. That breakthrough laid the foundation for the tools we build today, spanning AI video translation, visual dubbing, dialogue replacement, and lip sync API infrastructure for studios and developers.At sync., research and production operate in a tight feedback loop. We improve our models by working on real titles, real localization workflows, and real production constraints, not just benchmarks. What we ship this week informs what the model learns next. Backed by that foundation, we’re building the infrastructure for the next generation of AI video editing, AI dubbing platforms, and global content workflows.Y Combinator W24.

past.employee_description:
Developed a novel architecture for OCT image segmentation of the Optic Nerve Head. The model achieved state of the art results in segmentation across multiple OCT machines. 
I also made a significant contribution to another ongoing project by developing tools to better understand the distinguishing features of healthy and glaucoma eyes using Class activation maps (CAMs). Fine-tuned a pretrained ResNet50 model to perform the classification, and highlighted the area of the OCT scan that the CNN focuses on to make its prediction.

past.employee_description:
I worked under Dr. Naveen Garg, Professor, CS, IIT Delhi. I was accepted through the IASc Summer Research Fellowship programme (SRFP). 
I was engaged in developing a better approximation algorithm for the Capacitated K-Center Problem. I was able to come up with several novel ideas and explore various approaches during the research team's constant efforts to solve the problem. 
I also was involved in implementing and analyzing the accuracy of a randomized algorithm for the same problem. The algorithm was analyzed on several practical graph datasets and a detailed report was compiled. I was able to develop a keen taste for research during this period.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Indian Institute of Technology Madras is one among the foremost institutes of national importance in higher technological education, basic and applied research. In 1956, the German Government offered technical assistance for establishing an institute of higher education in engineering in India. The first Indo-German agreement in Bonn, West Germany for the establishment of the Indian Institute of Technology at Madras was signed in 1959.The Institute was formally inaugurated in 1959 by Prof. Humayun Kabir, Union Minister for Scientific Research and Cultural Affairs. The IIT system has sixteen Institutes of Technology. The first of these to be instituted are at Kharagpur (estb. 1951), Mumbai (estb. 1958), Chennai (estb. 1959), Kanpur (estb. 1959), Delhi (estb. 1961), Guwahati (estb. 1994) and Roorkee (estb. 1847, joined IITs in 2001).IIT Madras is a residential institute with nearly 550 faculty, 8000 students and 1250 administrative & supporting staff and is a self-contained campus located in a beautiful wooded land of about 250 hectares. A faculty of international repute, a brilliant student community, excellent technical & supporting staff and an effective administration have all contributed to the pre-eminent status of IIT Madras. The campus is located in the city of Chennai, previously known as Madras. Chennai is the state capital of Tamilnadu, a southern state in India.

past.employee_description:
Masters thesis on, Mobile Air Quality monitoring using low cost sensors to identify hotpots in Chennai city by creating spatio-temporal Air quality maps 

Conducted mobile air quality monitoring using these low cost air quality sensors by travelling through major corridors in Chennai city using public transport. By logging GPS co-ordinates simultaneously, we were able to map the pollution levels using ArcGis software

These mobile air quality monitors can be fitted to public buses to measure pollution levels on real-time with location accuracy which can be used to alert citizens to take alternative routes with lower pollution levels

This data on long term can be used as a part of city development plans

Our research focuses on generative facial performance: teaching models to understand and manipulate how people look, move, and express themselves on screen.Our journey began in 2019, when our founders built the world’s first zero-shot AI lip sync model capable of syncing lips to any audio on any video without per-speaker training or fine-tuning - Wav2Lip. That breakthrough laid the foundation for the tools we build today, spanning AI video translation, visual dubbing, dialogue replacement, and lip sync API infrastructure for studios and developers.At sync., research and production operate in a tight feedback loop. We improve our models by working on real titles, real localization workflows, and real production constraints, not just benchmarks. What we ship this week informs what the model learns next. Backed by that foundation, we’re building the infrastructure for the next generation of AI video editing, AI dubbing platforms, and global content workflows.Y Combinator W24.

Bucker is a mobile app that serves as an assisting layer over the existing clutter of similar apps on your device. --With multiple companies attempting to solve similar problems, all of us have a clutter of similar apps/websites to avail that single service. Booking a cab? You’re most likely going to 2-3 cab service apps before you confirm. Ordering food? You’d run through multiple tabs of price comparators. While part solutions exist for the same in the form of price comparators, deals/couponing websites for desktop, the problem has remained unsolved for the mobile. Combined with smaller screen sizes on mobile, the problem is multi-fold painful as compared to on a desktop.Bucker fixes exactly this. By pulling data across apps and integrating with them, it puts all the information you need to avail a service a tap away. Cab comparisons, coupons while ordering food, cashback while recharging your phone all are one tap away. Bucker’s mission is to create a smarter, more connected mobile world that empowers people to get more of what they want without jumping across apps.

basic_info.name: Ollie
basic_info.description: Ollie is the production eval layer for long-horizon agents.For coding agents, browser and computer-use agents, support agents, knowledge-work agents, and other tool-using systems, completing a workflow is not the same as achieving the correct outcome.The most damaging failures are often silent. Nothing crashes. Latency looks normal. Every tool call appears successful. But the agent skipped a constraint, lost context, followed the wrong path, or delivered the wrong result.Ollie evaluates complete production trajectories—from the user’s initial intent to the agent’s final outcome. It detects recurring behavioral failures across runs, scopes the affected sessions, traces the shared failing path and likely root cause, and gives engineering teams clear answers to three questions:What went wrong?Why did it go wrong?How do we fix it?Ollie then closes the loop between production and evaluation. It generates candidate fixes, tests them against real failed trajectories, keeps engineers in the approval loop, and converts production failures into regression cases for offline eval suites.Every failure discovered in production becomes an opportunity to strengthen both the agent and the tests designed to evaluate it.Ollie is built for staff and principal engineers, AI engineers, applied AI researchers, and platform teams shipping agents at scale. It complements existing observability and evaluation stacks by connecting production failure detection, root-cause analysis, remediation, and regression prevention in one workflow.Catch the silent failure. Find the root cause. Fix the agent. Update the eval. Before customers complain.Learn more at https://tryollie.com/

basic_profile.name: Nikunj Pansari
basic_profile.headline: Co-Founder at Ollie
basic_profile.summary:
I’m building Ollie, the Sentry for AI agents.

In production, agents can sound fine while things silently break across turns, tool calls, state transitions, and downstream writes. These failures are hard to spot, even harder to reproduce, and they don’t show up in your golden dataset.

Ollie learns from real production traces, discovers silent failure modes, and instantly turns them into evals, regression tests, and pre-deployment gates - so your existing evaluation platforms and golden datasets keep growing with novel production failures (often ~10x better over time).
