basic_profile.name: varun naganathan
basic_profile.headline: Founder at Ollie - the self improvement loop for AI agents. Ollie finds issues in your agent runs, fixes them using your coding agents and validates the fix on failure evals | Previously AI Lead @ Microsoft | 2X Founder
basic_profile.summary:
I work at the intersection of reinforcement learning, NLP, and applied agent systems. 

Over the past 2+ years, my focus has moved from just building agents to deeply understanding how agents behave as they change -how prompts, tools, models, and memory interact, where decision boundaries move, and why agents regress in subtle, hard-to-detect ways in multi-turn settings.

I spend most of my time analyzing agent behavior, identifying the surfaces where agents are likely to act out of order, and designing systematic ways to test those behaviors exhaustively. The core problem I care about is not “how to build an agent,” but how to know an agent will keep working as it evolves.

Today, I help teams building conversational and voice agents make their systems more reliable, safer, and easier to ship - by bringing rigor to how agent behavior is measured, tested, and validated across every change to prompts, models, tools, or capabilities.

basic_profile.name: varun naganathan
basic_profile.headline: Founder at Ollie - the self improvement loop for AI agents. Ollie finds issues in your agent runs, fixes them using your coding agents and validates the fix on failure evals | Previously AI Lead @ Microsoft | 2X Founder
basic_profile.summary:
I work at the intersection of reinforcement learning, NLP, and applied agent systems. 

Over the past 2+ years, my focus has moved from just building agents to deeply understanding how agents behave as they change -how prompts, tools, models, and memory interact, where decision boundaries move, and why agents regress in subtle, hard-to-detect ways in multi-turn settings.

I spend most of my time analyzing agent behavior, identifying the surfaces where agents are likely to act out of order, and designing systematic ways to test those behaviors exhaustively. The core problem I care about is not “how to build an agent,” but how to know an agent will keep working as it evolves.

Today, I help teams building conversational and voice agents make their systems more reliable, safer, and easier to ship - by bringing rigor to how agent behavior is measured, tested, and validated across every change to prompts, models, tools, or capabilities.

basic_profile.name: Sarun K S
basic_profile.headline: Principal Engineer at Lifesight | Ex-Co-Founder @ ReportDash
basic_profile.summary: High-impact technical leader and architect with over 10 years of experience building the backbone of AI-first data platforms. My career has been defined by a simple mission: Turning massive, fragmented data into real-time, autonomous intelligence.As the Co-Founder and CTO of ReportDash, I am currently focused on the frontier of Agentic AI. I’ve spent the last few years architecting 'Chat with Data' engines that move beyond simple RAG. By leveraging the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and SSE-driven streaming, I’ve engineered autonomous agents capable of executing complex 20-turn reasoning loops—navigating fragmented datasets to synthesize insights that traditional analytics miss.My foundation is rooted in Petabyte-scale infrastructure. I’ve successfully scaled environments processing 1,000+ requests/sec and built unified Lakehouse architectures utilizing Delta Lake and Apache Iceberg. I believe that for AI to be truly effective, the underlying data infrastructure must be secure, high-concurrency, and 'always-on.'Why I’m here:I’m less interested in traditional networking and more focused on connecting with founders, engineers, and architects where there is genuine technical synergy. Specifically, I am looking to engage with those working on:• Agentic AI Orchestration: Multi-step reasoning and tool-calling (MCP) at scale.• Modern Data Stack Evolution: The intersection of Spark, BigQuery, and Iceberg/Delta.• AI Reliability: Solving for grounding, deterministic outputs, and accuracy in LLMs.I am a firm believer in the 'Founder’s Mindset'—treating infrastructure as a product and every cloud dollar as an investment. If you’re building in the AI/Data space and want to talk shop about technical bottlenecks, architectural trade-offs, or the future of Agentic OS, let’s connect.

basic_profile.summary:
As a creative technologist with over 15 years of experience in developing web and mobile applications, I've always been passionate about solving problems through innovative solutions.

Currently, I am building Lifesight - a revolutionary modern marketing stack designed for the privacy-first era. Focused on optimizing first-party data, Lifesight offers tools to unify siloed data, optimize customer acquisition, and maintain privacy standards for the complete modern marketing capabilities.

Born from deep understanding of challenges in the increasingly stringent privacy regulations and cookie-less world, we offer a fresh approach to empower marketers to create impactful campaigns and personalized customer experiences.

Built with the aim of providing marketers with a unified platform that enables them to track and measure campaign performance accurately, we've spent the last 6 years, proudly assisting brands and agencies worldwide.

With our focus on first-party and zero-party data, we bridge gaps left by third-party data, enabling exceptional marketing for a privacy-centric, cookie-less future.

If you are curious to see what kind of growth is possible using your data, hit me up. I would be happy to walk you through the possibilities Lifesight can help you achieve

basic_profile.name: Anil Singh
basic_profile.headline: Empowering Marketers with AI & Deep Data Insights | Focused on Budget Optimization Strategies | Attributions, MMM & Causal AI
basic_profile.summary:
In today’s complex digital landscape, marketing leaders need more than just data—they need actionable intelligence. I bridge the gap between AI-driven analytics and marketing strategy, enabling brands to optimize spend, improve attribution accuracy, and measure true impact using cutting-edge Causal Inference, MMM, and advanced Measurement methodologies.

🔹 What I Do:
Help marketers make sense of data noise through causal AI, ensuring they invest in the right channels for maximum ROI.
Optimize marketing budgets using advanced econometric modeling and machine learning.
Decode attribution challenges by leveraging state-of-the-art methodologies like Difference-in-Difference, DoubleML, and Bayesian modeling.
Advance the future of marketing analytics, integrating AI to refine MMM strategies for more precise, real-time decision-making.

🔹 What Drives Me:I am passionate about democratizing marketing analytics, making sophisticated AI-driven techniques accessible to CMOs, growth teams, and performance marketers. My work revolves around ensuring that businesses don’t just collect data, but extract the right insights to drive business outcomes.

🔹 Let’s Connect! If you're looking to elevate your marketing strategy with AI, data science, and causal inference, let’s talk!

I'm committed to pushing the boundaries of what's possible in technology, always with an eye on delivering tangible value to our clients.

basic_profile.headline: Empowering Marketers with AI & Deep Data Insights | Focused on Budget Optimization Strategies | Attributions, MMM & Causal AI
basic_profile.summary:
In today’s complex digital landscape, marketing leaders need more than just data—they need actionable intelligence. I bridge the gap between AI-driven analytics and marketing strategy, enabling brands to optimize spend, improve attribution accuracy, and measure true impact using cutting-edge Causal Inference, MMM, and advanced Measurement methodologies.

🔹 What I Do:
Help marketers make sense of data noise through causal AI, ensuring they invest in the right channels for maximum ROI.
Optimize marketing budgets using advanced econometric modeling and machine learning.
Decode attribution challenges by leveraging state-of-the-art methodologies like Difference-in-Difference, DoubleML, and Bayesian modeling.
Advance the future of marketing analytics, integrating AI to refine MMM strategies for more precise, real-time decision-making.

🔹 What Drives Me:I am passionate about democratizing marketing analytics, making sophisticated AI-driven techniques accessible to CMOs, growth teams, and performance marketers. My work revolves around ensuring that businesses don’t just collect data, but extract the right insights to drive business outcomes.

🔹 Let’s Connect! If you're looking to elevate your marketing strategy with AI, data science, and causal inference, let’s talk!

I'm committed to pushing the boundaries of what's possible in technology, always with an eye on delivering tangible value to our clients.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With a 90-year history, Morgan Stanley today operates in 42 countries serving corporations, governments, institutions, families and individuals. Morgan Stanley is a talent business that demands ongoing investment in our people. Key drivers of our success have been the breadth and tenure of our talent, as well as a unique culture and a set of values that guide our employees. We view Morgan Stanley’s talent and culture as a key competitive advantage enabling the Firm to achieve its potential and drive future success.As an integrated firm with scaled capabilities, we partner with clients at every stage of their financial journey. Our ability to do so is grounded in four pillars that define Morgan Stanley: a clear and consistent strategy to help clients raise, manage and allocate capital; a culture grounded in rigor, humility and partnership; financial strength through capital, earnings power and durability; and growth driven by smart, strategic investment globally.These pillars enable Morgan Stanley to provide trusted advice, operate with resilience across market cycles and deliver long-term value to our clients and shareholders.
